// ============================================================
// MED EXCHANGE — MARKETPLACE V1.2 + QR PAYMENT
// ============================================================
// Cloudflare Worker + D1
//
// EXISTING FEATURES PRESERVED:
// - Advanced Search
// - Category filter
// - Course filter
// - Year filter
// - Subject filter
// - Maximum price filter
// - Deals filter
// - Price sorting
// - Natural-language search
// - Seller sessions
// - Item creation
// - Item details
// - Saved Items / Bag local storage
//
// NEW:
// - ₹10 listing/payment fee
// - PhonePe QR payment screen
// - QR retrieved from:
//      1. PAYMENT_QR_URL
//      2. PAYMENT_QR_FILE_ID
//      3. existing bot_settings.payment_qr_file_id
// - Telegram QR proxy without exposing BOT_TOKEN
// - Payment screenshot upload
// - Client-side screenshot compression
// - D1 payment storage
// - Seller payment status
// - Admin payment verification/rejection
// - Admin item approval/rejection
// - /admin dashboard
//
// IMPORTANT:
// - BOT.01 and BOT.02 are NOT touched.
// - Existing med_exchange_* schema is preserved.
// - IDs remain INTEGER.
// - Public IDs displayed as ME-12345.
// - D1 ONLY.
// - No R2 / KV / Images binding required.
// - NO MANUAL D1 MIGRATION REQUIRED.
// - Set ADMIN_SECRET as a Worker secret.
// - Optional PAYMENT_QR_URL Worker variable.
// - Optional PAYMENT_QR_FILE_ID Worker secret/variable.
// - Existing bot_settings.payment_qr_file_id can also be used.
// ============================================================

const APP_NAME = "Med Exchange";
const TAGLINE = "Buy • Sell • Exchange • Connect";
const COLLEGE_SHORT_NAME = "MRV";

const LISTING_FEE = 10;
const MAX_ACTIVE_BOOK_LISTINGS = 10;

const HOME_PAGE = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<meta charset="UTF-8">

<meta name="viewport"
      content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">

<meta name="theme-color" content="#07111f">

<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">

<title>Med Exchange</title>

<link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.webmanifest">

<style>

/* ============================================================
   GLOBAL
============================================================ */

*{
  box-sizing:border-box;
  margin:0;
  padding:0;
}

:root{
  --bg:#07111f;
  --card:rgba(255,255,255,.075);
  --card2:rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  --border:rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --text:#f5f7fb;
  --muted:#9ba8b8;
  --accent:#56d6c9;
  --accent2:#6ca8ff;
  --danger:#ff7272;
  --warning:#ffc857;
  --success:#5ee38a;
  --shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}

html{
  background:var(--bg);
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
  font-family:
    -apple-system,
    BlinkMacSystemFont,
    "SF Pro Display",
    "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 15% -10%,
      rgba(86,214,201,.18),
      transparent 35%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 100% 10%,
      rgba(108,168,255,.15),
      transparent 35%
    ),
    var(--bg);

  color:var(--text);
  min-height:100vh;
}

button,
input,
textarea,
select{
  font:inherit;
}

button{
  border:0;
  cursor:pointer;
}

button:disabled{
  opacity:.55;
  cursor:not-allowed;
}

.app{
  max-width:720px;
  margin:auto;
  min-height:100vh;
  padding-bottom:90px;
}


/* ============================================================
   HEADER
============================================================ */

.header{
  padding:
    calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-top))
    18px
    10px;
}

.brand-row{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
}

.brand{
  font-size:25px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:-.7px;
}

.brand span{
  color:var(--accent);
}

.tagline{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;
  margin-top:3px;
}

.campus-pill{
  padding:9px 12px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  color:#dbe7f5;
  font-size:12px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(15px);
}


/* ============================================================
   SEARCH
============================================================ */

.search-wrap{
  padding:14px 18px 8px;
}

.search-box{
  position:relative;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  padding:15px 16px;
  border-radius:18px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  overflow:hidden;
}

.search-box::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:-35%;
  bottom:0;
  width:35%;
  height:2px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent,
      var(--accent),
      var(--accent2),
      transparent
    );

  animation:searchSweep 3.2s linear infinite;
  opacity:.65;
}

@keyframes searchSweep{

  from{
    left:-35%;
  }

  to{
    left:100%;
  }

}

.search-icon{
  font-size:19px;
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
}

.search-box input{
  width:100%;
  border:0;
  outline:0;
  background:transparent;
  color:var(--text);
  font-size:15px;
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
}

.search-box input::placeholder{
  color:#8391a3;
}


/* ============================================================
   ADVANCED SEARCH
============================================================ */

.advanced-search-wrap{
  padding:4px 18px 4px;
}

.filter-toggle{
  width:100%;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border-radius:15px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  color:#dce6f3;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;

  transition:.18s;
}

.filter-toggle:active{
  transform:scale(.985);
}

.filter-toggle-left{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
}

.filter-toggle-icon{
  font-size:16px;
}

.filter-count{
  display:none;
  min-width:21px;
  height:21px;
  padding:0 6px;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  border-radius:999px;

  background:rgba(86,214,201,.16);
  color:var(--accent);

  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.filter-arrow{
  font-size:13px;
  transition:.2s;
}

.filter-toggle.open .filter-arrow{
  transform:rotate(180deg);
}

.filters-panel{
  display:none;
  margin-top:9px;
  padding:14px;

  border-radius:19px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}

.filters-panel.open{
  display:block;
}

.filter-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:9px;
}

.filter-field{
  min-width:0;
}

.filter-field.full{
  grid-column:1 / -1;
}

.filter-label{
  display:block;
  color:#aebbc9;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:800;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}

.filter-input,
.filter-select{
  width:100%;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  outline:0;
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:11px;

  color:white;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);

  font-size:12px;
}

.filter-input::placeholder{
  color:#68778a;
}

.filter-select option{
  background:#0c1727;
  color:white;
}

.deals-toggle-row{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;

  padding:11px 12px;
  border-radius:12px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.deals-label{
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
}

.deals-sub{
  color:#7f8da0;
  font-size:10px;
  margin-top:2px;
}

.filter-checkbox{
  width:20px;
  height:20px;
  accent-color:var(--accent);
}

.filter-actions{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:8px;
  margin-top:11px;
}

.apply-filter-btn{
  padding:12px;
  border-radius:12px;

  background:var(--accent);
  color:#061514;

  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.clear-filter-btn{
  padding:12px;
  border-radius:12px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  color:white;

  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
}


/* ============================================================
   HERO
============================================================ */

.hero{
  margin:10px 18px 20px;
  padding:23px;
  border-radius:25px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      rgba(86,214,201,.17),
      rgba(108,168,255,.10)
    );

  border:1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}

.hero h1{
  font-size:28px;
  line-height:1.05;
  letter-spacing:-1px;
}

.hero p{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:13px;
  margin-top:9px;
  line-height:1.5;
}

.hero-actions{
  display:flex;
  gap:9px;
  margin-top:17px;
}

.primary-btn{
  flex:1;
  padding:13px 16px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--accent);
  color:#061514;
  font-weight:800;
}

.secondary-btn{
  padding:13px 16px;
  border-radius:14px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  color:white;
  font-weight:700;
}


/* ============================================================
   SECTIONS
============================================================ */

.section{
  padding:0 18px;
  margin-top:22px;
}

.section-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  margin-bottom:11px;
}

.section-title{
  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:800;
}

.section-link{
  color:var(--accent);
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700;
  background:transparent;
}


/* ============================================================
   CATEGORY GRID
============================================================ */

.categories{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:7px;
}

.category{
  min-height:72px;
  padding:9px 7px;
  border-radius:19px;

  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  text-align:left;
  color:white;

  transition:.18s;
}

.category:active{
  transform:scale(.97);
}

.category-icon{
  font-size:20px;
}

.category-name{
  margin-top:5px;
  font-weight:800;
  font-size:10px;
  line-height:1.15;
}

.category-sub{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:8px;
  margin-top:2px;
  line-height:1.15;
}


/* ============================================================
   SEARCH TAGS
============================================================ */

.tags{
  display:flex;
  gap:8px;
  overflow-x:auto;
  padding-bottom:3px;
  scrollbar-width:none;
}

.tags::-webkit-scrollbar{
  display:none;
}

.tag{
  flex:none;
  padding:9px 12px;
  border-radius:999px;

  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  color:#dce6f3;
  font-size:12px;
}


/* ============================================================
   ACTIVE SEARCH SUMMARY
============================================================ */

.search-summary{
  display:none;
  margin-top:9px;
  padding:10px 12px;
  border-radius:13px;

  background:rgba(86,214,201,.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(86,214,201,.16);

  color:#bcd8d5;
  font-size:10px;
  line-height:1.4;
}

.search-summary.show{
  display:block;
}


/* ============================================================
   ITEMS
============================================================ */

.items{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:11px;
}

.item-card{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  display:flex;
  gap:13px;
  padding:13px;

  border-radius:20px;

  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  backdrop-filter:blur(15px);

  transition:.18s;
}

.item-card:active{
  transform:scale(.985);
}

.item-photo{
  width:112px;
  height:128px;
  position:relative;

  border-radius:15px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      rgba(255,255,255,.11),
      rgba(255,255,255,.04)
    );

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  overflow:hidden;
  flex:none;
}

.item-photo img{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;
}

.no-photo{font-size:30px;opacity:.65;}
.premium-ribbon{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:4;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(5,10,18,.82);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);font-size:7px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#fff;}
.premium-discount{display:inline-flex;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,82,82,.13);border:1px solid rgba(255,110,110,.28);color:#ff9191;font-size:9px;font-weight:950;}
.item-price{margin-top:8px;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.item-price .current-price{font-size:22px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.5px;}
.item-price .old-price{font-size:11px;color:#7f8a99;text-decoration:line-through;}
.listing-slider{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;}
.listing-slider::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.listing-slide{width:100%;height:100%;flex:0 0 100%;scroll-snap-align:start;}
.listing-slide img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.photo-count{position:absolute;right:6px;bottom:6px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.68);color:#fff;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;}
.detail-gallery{position:relative;width:100%;height:min(72vw,360px);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:#0a111b;margin-bottom:14px;}
.detail-gallery-track{display:flex;width:100%;height:100%;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;}
.detail-gallery-track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.detail-gallery-slide{flex:0 0 100%;height:100%;scroll-snap-align:start;}
.detail-gallery-slide img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;}
.detail-gallery-count{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:10px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);font-size:10px;font-weight:900;}
.utility-screen{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1200;display:none;background:var(--bg);overflow:auto;padding-bottom:90px;}
.utility-inner{width:min(720px,100%);margin:auto;padding:18px;}
.utility-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.utility-title{font-size:22px;font-weight:950;}
.utility-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px;}
.utility-card{padding:13px;border-radius:19px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:10px;}
.utility-empty{text-align:center;padding:45px 20px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;}
.account-avatar{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:27px;background:rgba(86,214,201,.18);border:1px solid var(--border);}
.share-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid var(--border);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;}
.sold-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,114,114,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,114,114,.3);color:#ffabab;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;}
.sold-card{filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.72;}

.item-content{
  min-width:0;
  flex:1;
}

.item-title{
  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:800;
  line-height:1.25;
}

.item-meta{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:11px;
  margin-top:5px;
  line-height:1.4;
}

.item-price{
  margin-top:8px;
  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.old-price{
  margin-left:5px;
  color:#7f8b9a;
  text-decoration:line-through;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:500;
}

.discount{
  margin-left:5px;
  color:var(--accent);
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:800;
}

.condition{
  display:inline-block;
  margin-top:6px;
  padding:4px 7px;
  border-radius:7px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);

  color:#cbd6e3;
  font-size:10px;
}

.tap-hint{
  margin-top:6px;
  color:#718198;
  font-size:9px;
}

.empty{
  padding:25px 15px;
  text-align:center;

  border-radius:17px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  color:#8190a3;
  font-size:12px;
}


/* ============================================================
   MODAL
============================================================ */

.modal{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:1800;

  display:none;
  overflow-y:auto;

  background:rgba(2,7,14,.88);

  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);

  padding:
    calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-top))
    18px
    calc(25px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}

.modal-card{
  max-width:720px;
  margin:auto;

  padding:18px;

  border-radius:23px;

  background:#0c1727;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}

.modal-top{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:15px;
}

.modal-title{
  font-size:20px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.modal-close{
  width:40px;
  height:40px;

  border-radius:13px;

  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  color:white;
  font-size:20px;
}

.detail-photo{
  width:100%;
  max-height:300px;
  object-fit:cover;

  border-radius:18px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);

  margin-bottom:15px;
}

.detail-price{
  font-size:26px;
  font-weight:900;
  margin-top:8px;
}

.detail-meta{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.6;
  margin-top:8px;
}

.detail-description{
  margin-top:15px;
  padding:13px;

  border-radius:15px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);

  color:#d7e0eb;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

.detail-buttons{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:9px;
  margin-top:14px;
}

.detail-btn{
  padding:13px;
  border-radius:14px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  color:white;
  font-weight:800;
}

.detail-btn.primary{
  background:var(--accent);
  color:#061514;
}


/* ============================================================
   EDIT LISTING
============================================================ */
.edit-listing-note{padding:11px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(86,214,201,.07);border:1px solid rgba(86,214,201,.18);color:#9db3c1;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:12px}
.edit-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:12px}
.edit-save{width:100%;padding:13px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--accent);color:#061514;font-weight:950}
.edit-cancel{width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid var(--border);color:#dce6f0;font-weight:850}
.edit-status{font-size:10px;color:#8291a2;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.45}

/* ============================================================
   SELL SCREEN
============================================================ */

.sell-screen{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:1000;

  overflow-y:auto;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 20% 0%,
      rgba(86,214,201,.13),
      transparent 35%
    ),
    var(--bg);

  padding:
    calc(15px + env(safe-area-inset-top))
    18px
    calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}

.sell-inner{
  max-width:720px;
  margin:auto;
}

.sell-top{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}

.close-btn{
  width:40px;
  height:40px;

  border-radius:13px;

  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  color:white;
  font-size:21px;
}

.sell-heading h2{
  font-size:22px;
}

.sell-heading p{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;
  margin-top:3px;
}

.form-card{
  padding:16px;
  margin-bottom:12px;

  border-radius:20px;

  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.form-title{
  font-weight:800;
  font-size:14px;
  margin-bottom:12px;
}

.label{
  display:block;

  color:#b9c5d3;

  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:700;

  margin-bottom:6px;
}

.input,
.textarea,
.select{
  width:100%;

  border:1px solid var(--border);
  outline:0;

  border-radius:13px;
  padding:12px;

  color:white;

  background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}

.select option{
  background:#0c1727;
  color:white;
}

.field{
  margin-bottom:13px;
}

.field:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.grid2{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:10px;
}

.choice-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:8px;
}

.choice{
  padding:11px 8px;

  border-radius:12px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  color:#d8e1ec;

  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700;
}

.choice.active{
  background:rgba(86,214,201,.16);
  border-color:rgba(86,214,201,.55);
  color:var(--accent);
}

.book-set-controls{margin-top:2px;}
.book-count-row{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:3px;scrollbar-width:none;}
.book-count-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.book-count-btn{flex:0 0 42px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);border:1px solid var(--border);color:#d8e1ec;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;}
.book-count-btn.active{background:rgba(86,214,201,.16);border-color:rgba(86,214,201,.55);color:var(--accent);}
.book-set-editor{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;}
.book-entry{padding:12px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);border:1px solid var(--border);}
.book-entry-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.book-entry-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:950;}
.book-entry-sub{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);}
.book-photo-row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;}
.book-photo-preview{width:70px;height:82px;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;}
.book-photo-preview img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.book-photo-input{min-width:0;flex:1;font-size:10px;}
.book-set-total{padding:14px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(86,214,201,.08);border:1px solid rgba(86,214,201,.18);margin-top:10px;}
.book-set-total-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;}
.book-set-total-price{font-size:24px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.5px;}
.book-set-total-old{color:#7f8a99;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:12px;}
.book-set-discount{display:inline-flex;margin-top:7px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,82,82,.13);border:1px solid rgba(255,110,110,.28);color:#ff9191;font-size:10px;font-weight:950;}
.book-set-note{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4;margin-top:8px;}
@media(max-width:430px){.categories{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px}.category{min-height:68px;padding:8px 5px}.category-icon{font-size:18px}.category-name{font-size:9px}.category-sub{font-size:7px}}

.photo-box{
  border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.18);

  border-radius:15px;

  padding:15px;

  text-align:center;
}

.photo-box input{
  width:100%;
}

.photo-note{
  margin-top:8px;

  color:#718198;

  font-size:10px;
  line-height:1.4;
}

.photo-preview{
  display:flex;
  gap:8px;

  margin-top:10px;

  overflow-x:auto;
}

.photo-thumb{
  position:relative;

  width:82px;
  height:82px;

  border-radius:12px;

  overflow:hidden;

  flex:none;
}

.photo-thumb img{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;
}

.photo-remove{
  position:absolute;

  top:4px;
  right:4px;

  width:22px;
  height:22px;

  border-radius:50%;

  background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);

  color:white;

  font-size:12px;
}

.toggle-row{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;

  padding:12px;

  border-radius:13px;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);
}

.toggle{
  width:47px;
  height:27px;

  border-radius:999px;

  background:#354254;

  position:relative;
}

.toggle::after{
  content:"";

  width:21px;
  height:21px;

  position:absolute;

  top:3px;
  left:3px;

  border-radius:50%;

  background:white;

  transition:.2s;
}

.toggle.active{
  background:var(--accent);
}

.toggle.active::after{
  left:23px;
}

.preview{
  padding:15px;

  border-radius:17px;

  background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.preview-title{
  font-weight:900;
  font-size:17px;
}

.preview-price{
  font-size:21px;
  font-weight:900;
  margin-top:7px;
}

.preview-meta{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:11px;
  margin-top:5px;
}

.save-btn{
  width:100%;

  margin-top:10px;

  padding:15px;

  border-radius:15px;

  background:var(--accent);

  color:#061514;

  font-weight:900;

  font-size:15px;
}


/* ============================================================
   PAYMENT SCREEN
============================================================ */

.payment-screen{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:2200;

  display:none;
  overflow-y:auto;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 50% 0%,
      rgba(86,214,201,.14),
      transparent 38%
    ),
    var(--bg);

  padding:
    calc(15px + env(safe-area-inset-top))
    18px
    calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}

.payment-inner{
  max-width:560px;
  margin:auto;
}

.payment-top{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:18px;
}

.payment-heading h2{
  font-size:22px;
}

.payment-heading p{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;
  margin-top:3px;
}

.payment-card{
  padding:18px;
  border-radius:22px;
  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  margin-bottom:12px;
}

.payment-fee{
  text-align:center;
}

.payment-fee-label{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;
}

.payment-fee-amount{
  margin-top:5px;
  font-size:34px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.payment-qr-wrap{
  margin:18px auto 13px;
  width:min(300px,82vw);
  aspect-ratio:1;
  padding:10px;
  border-radius:20px;
  background:white;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
}

.payment-qr{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:contain;
  border-radius:12px;
}

.payment-instruction{
  text-align:center;
  color:#c7d3df;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

.payment-step{
  display:flex;
  gap:10px;
  align-items:flex-start;
  padding:11px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}

.payment-step:last-child{
  border-bottom:0;
}

.payment-step-num{
  flex:none;
  width:25px;
  height:25px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(86,214,201,.15);
  color:var(--accent);
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.payment-step-text{
  font-size:12px;
  color:#c8d4e1;
  line-height:1.45;
}

.payment-confirm-btn{
  width:100%;
  padding:14px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--accent);
  color:#061514;
  font-weight:900;
}

.payment-upload{
  display:none;
}

.payment-upload.show{
  display:block;
}

.payment-file-box{
  border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:15px;
  text-align:center;
}

.payment-file-box input{
  width:100%;
  margin-top:10px;
}

.payment-screenshot-preview{
  margin-top:12px;
  display:none;
}

.payment-screenshot-preview.show{
  display:block;
}

.payment-screenshot-preview img{
  width:100%;
  max-height:280px;
  object-fit:contain;
  border-radius:15px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}

.payment-submit-btn{
  width:100%;
  margin-top:12px;
  padding:14px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--accent2);
  color:white;
  font-weight:900;
}

.payment-secondary-btn{
  width:100%;
  margin-top:9px;
  padding:13px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  color:white;
  font-weight:800;
}

.payment-status{
  margin-top:12px;
  padding:12px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  color:#cbd7e3;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.5;
  display:none;
}

.payment-status.show{
  display:block;
}

.payment-status.success{
  border-color:rgba(94,227,138,.30);
  background:rgba(94,227,138,.08);
}

.payment-status.warning{
  border-color:rgba(255,200,87,.30);
  background:rgba(255,200,87,.08);
}

.payment-status.error{
  border-color:rgba(255,114,114,.30);
  background:rgba(255,114,114,.08);
}

.payment-item-info{
  padding:12px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);
  margin-bottom:12px;
}

.payment-item-title{
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.payment-item-id{
  color:#8190a3;
  font-size:10px;
  margin-top:4px;
}


/* ============================================================
   BOTTOM NAV
============================================================ */

.bottom-nav{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:500;

  bottom:0;
  left:50%;

  transform:translateX(-50%);

  width:min(720px,100%);

  padding:
    8px
    10px
    calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));

  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);

  background:rgba(8,17,31,.88);

  border-top:1px solid var(--border);

  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
}

.nav-btn{
  padding:7px 3px;

  background:transparent;

  color:#8090a3;

  font-size:10px;

  font-weight:700;
}

.nav-icon{
  display:block;
  font-size:19px;
  margin-bottom:2px;
}

.nav-btn.active{
  color:var(--accent);
}



/* ============================================================
   MARKETPLACE GRID + EXPLORE
============================================================ */
.header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.notification-btn{position:relative;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);color:#fff;font-size:18px}
.notification-badge{position:absolute;top:-5px;right:-5px;min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent2);color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:950;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.notification-badge.show{display:flex}
.market-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.market-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:0;border-radius:18px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);color:inherit;text-align:left;min-width:0;transition:.18s}
.market-card:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.market-photo{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.11),rgba(255,255,255,.04));overflow:hidden}
.market-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.market-photo .listing-slider{position:absolute;inset:0}.market-photo .premium-ribbon{font-size:7px}.market-body{padding:10px}.market-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.25;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.market-price{margin-top:6px;font-size:17px;font-weight:950}.market-meta{margin-top:5px;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.market-condition{display:inline-block;margin-top:7px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#cbd6e3;font-size:8px}
.home-preview-note{margin-top:10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;text-align:center}.view-all-marketplace{width:100%;margin-top:11px;padding:13px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(86,214,201,.12);border:1px solid rgba(86,214,201,.28);color:var(--accent);font-weight:900;font-size:12px}
.marketplace-screen{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1100;display:none;overflow:auto;background:var(--bg);padding:calc(15px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 18px calc(95px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}.marketplace-inner{max-width:720px;margin:auto}.marketplace-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}.marketplace-search{margin:0 0 12px}.marketplace-search .search-box{padding:13px 14px}.marketplace-cats{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px;scrollbar-width:none}.marketplace-cats::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.marketplace-cat{flex:none;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);color:#dce6f3;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}.marketplace-cat.active{background:rgba(86,214,201,.16);border-color:rgba(86,214,201,.45);color:var(--accent)}.marketplace-count{margin:12px 0 10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.notification-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
@media(max-width:360px){.market-grid{gap:8px}.market-body{padding:8px}.market-title{font-size:12px}.market-price{font-size:15px}}

/* ============================================================
   TOAST
============================================================ */

.toast{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:2500;

  left:18px;
  right:18px;

  bottom:85px;

  padding:13px 15px;

  border-radius:14px;

  background:#172235;

  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:var(--shadow);

  color:white;

  font-size:13px;

  display:none;
}

.toast.show{
  display:block;
}


/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
============================================================ */

@media(max-width:430px){

  .hero h1{
    font-size:25px;
  }

  .item-photo{
    width:82px;
    height:82px;
  }

  .filter-grid{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }

  .filter-field.full{
    grid-column:auto;
  }

}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){

  html{
    scroll-behavior:auto;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after{
    animation-duration:.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count:1 !important;
    transition-duration:.01ms !important;
  }

}


/* MRV EXCHANGE — compact Browse Categories (5 across) */
.categories{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:7px!important;width:100%!important}
.category{min-width:0!important;padding:9px 4px!important;border-radius:13px!important}
.category-icon{font-size:19px!important;margin-bottom:3px!important}
.category-name{font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.15!important;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.category-sub{font-size:7px!important;line-height:1.15!important;margin-top:2px!important;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
@media(max-width:420px){.categories{gap:5px!important}.category{padding:8px 2px!important}.category-icon{font-size:17px!important}.category-name{font-size:9px!important}.category-sub{display:none!important}}
.campus-chat-home{margin-top:4px;padding:15px;border-radius:20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(86,214,201,.12),rgba(108,168,255,.13),rgba(190,105,255,.10));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
.chat-home-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}.chat-home-icon{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:24px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11)}.chat-home-title{font-size:17px;font-weight:950}.chat-home-sub{font-size:10px;color:#9eacbd;margin-top:3px}.chat-home-link{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;margin-top:12px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;color:#06121d;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#56d6c9,#6ca8ff);text-decoration:none}

/* PLAIN TEXT / TINY COMPOSER UI */
.messages{gap:2px!important;padding:2px 0!important}
.msg{margin:1px 0!important;padding:5px 8px!important;border-radius:11px!important;max-width:78%!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.msg.me{margin-left:auto!important;max-width:39%!important}
.message-text{font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.28!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
.msg small{display:block!important;margin-top:2px!important;font-size:8px!important;line-height:1!important;opacity:.55!important}
.msg .reacts,.msg .message-actions,.msg [data-copy],.msg [data-react],.msg [data-save],.msg [data-del]{display:none!important}
.compose{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:5px!important;margin:5px 0 6px!important;padding:0!important;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.compose .input,#m{height:32px!important;min-height:32px!important;padding:0 10px!important;border-radius:16px!important;font-size:13px!important;line-height:32px!important;margin:0!important}
.compose .send,#send{width:32px!important;height:32px!important;min-width:32px!important;padding:0!important;border-radius:50%!important;font-size:13px!important;margin:0!important}
.chathead{margin-bottom:5px!important}
.typing{min-height:10px!important;height:10px!important;font-size:9px!important;margin:1px 0!important}
.quick,.stage5bar{display:none!important}
.chat-theme-row,.emojirow,.chatcontrol{display:none!important}
.secondary{min-height:30px!important;padding:6px 9px!important;margin:3px 0!important;font-size:10px!important;border-radius:10px!important}
@media(max-width:600px){.msg{max-width:82%!important;}.msg.me{max-width:41%!important;}padding:4px 7px!important}.message-text{font-size:13px!important}.compose .input,#m{height:30px!important;min-height:30px!important;line-height:30px!important}.compose .send,#send{width:30px!important;height:30px!important;min-width:30px!important}}
</style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="app">

<header class="header">

  <div class="brand-row">

    <div>

      <div class="brand">
        Med <span>Exchange</span>
      </div>

      <div class="tagline">
        ${TAGLINE}
      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="header-actions">
      <button class="notification-btn" onclick="openNotifications()" aria-label="Notifications">
        🔔<span id="notificationBadge" class="notification-badge"></span>
      </button>
      <button class="campus-pill" onclick="chooseCampus()">📍 MRV Campus</button>
    </div>

  </div>

</header>


<!-- ============================================================
     SEARCH
============================================================ -->

<div class="search-wrap">

  <div class="search-box">

    <div class="search-icon">
      ⌕
    </div>

    <input
      id="searchInput"
      type="search"
      placeholder="What are you looking for today?"
      autocomplete="off"
      oninput="searchItems()"
    >

  </div>

</div>


<!-- ============================================================
     ADVANCED FILTERS
============================================================ -->

<div class="advanced-search-wrap">

  <button
    id="filterToggle"
    class="filter-toggle"
    onclick="toggleFilters()">

    <div class="filter-toggle-left">

      <span class="filter-toggle-icon">
        ⚙
      </span>

      <span>
        Advanced Search & Filters
      </span>

      <span
        id="filterCount"
        class="filter-count">
        0
      </span>

    </div>

    <span class="filter-arrow">
      ▼
    </span>

  </button>


  <div
    id="filtersPanel"
    class="filters-panel">

    <div class="filter-grid">


      <div class="filter-field">

        <label class="filter-label">
          Category
        </label>

        <select
          id="filterCategory"
          class="filter-select">

          <option value="">
            All Categories
          </option>

          <option value="Books">
            📚 Books
          </option>

          <option value="Medical Instruments">
            🩺 Medical Instruments
          </option>

          <option value="Accessories">
            🎒 Accessories
          </option>

          <option value="Study Material">
            📝 Study Material
          </option>

          <option value="Other">
            ＋ Other
          </option>

        </select>

      </div>


      <div class="filter-field">

        <label class="filter-label">
          Course
        </label>

        <select
          id="filterCourse"
          class="filter-select">

          <option value="">
            All Courses
          </option>

          <option value="MBBS">
            MBBS
          </option>

          <option value="BDS">
            BDS
          </option>

          <option value="PG">
            PG
          </option>

          <option value="Other">
            Other
          </option>

        </select>

      </div>


      <div class="filter-field">

        <label class="filter-label">
          Year
        </label>

        <select
          id="filterYear"
          class="filter-select">

          <option value="">
            All Years
          </option>

          <option value="1st Year">
            1st Year
          </option>

          <option value="2nd Year">
            2nd Year
          </option>

          <option value="3rd Year">
            3rd Year
          </option>

          <option value="4th Year">
            4th Year
          </option>

          <option value="Other">
            Other
          </option>

        </select>

      </div>


      <div class="filter-field">

        <label class="filter-label">
          Subject
        </label>

        <input
          id="filterSubject"
          class="filter-input"
          type="text"
          placeholder="e.g. Anatomy"
        >

      </div>


      <div class="filter-field">

        <label class="filter-label">
          Maximum Price
        </label>

        <input
          id="filterMaxPrice"
          class="filter-input"
          type="number"
          min="0"
          step="1"
          placeholder="₹ 500"
        >

      </div>


      <div class="filter-field">

        <label class="filter-label">
          Sort By
        </label>

        <select
          id="filterSort"
          class="filter-select">

          <option value="latest">
            🕒 Latest
          </option>

<script>

/* ============================================================
   GLOBAL STATE
============================================================ */

const API_BASE = "";

let selectedCategory = "";
let selectedCondition = "";
let selectedDelivery = "";
let isNegotiable = false;
let selectedPhotos = [];
let bookCount = 1;
let bookEntries = [];

let sellerId =
  localStorage.getItem(
    "med_exchange_seller_id"
  );

let currentItems = [];

let searchTimer = null;

let currentPaymentItemId =
  Number(
    localStorage.getItem(
      "med_exchange_pending_item_id"
    ) || 0
  );

let paymentScreenshotData = "";

let paymentScreenshotMime =
  "image/jpeg";

let paymentConfirmed = false;

let searchState = {

  q:"",
  category:"",
  course:"",
  year:"",
  subject:"",
  maxPrice:"",
  mode:"latest",
  deals:false

};


/* ============================================================
   HELPERS
============================================================ */

function $(id){

  return document.getElementById(id);

}


function getPhotoList(item){let list=[];try{if(item&&item.photo_urls){const x=JSON.parse(item.photo_urls);if(Array.isArray(x))list=x.filter(Boolean);}}catch(e){}if(!list.length&&item&&item.photo_url)list=[item.photo_url];return list.slice(0,10);}
function compressListingPhoto(file){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(!file||!file.type.startsWith("image/"))return reject(new Error("Please select image files only."));const r=new FileReader();r.onerror=()=>reject(new Error("Unable to read photo."));r.onload=()=>{const img=new Image();img.onerror=()=>reject(new Error("Unable to decode photo."));img.onload=()=>{let w=img.naturalWidth,h=img.naturalHeight,max=900;if(w>max||h>max){const sc=Math.min(max/w,max/h);w=Math.round(w*sc);h=Math.round(h*sc);}const c=document.createElement("canvas");c.width=w;c.height=h;const ctx=c.getContext("2d");ctx.fillStyle="#fff";ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);let d=c.toDataURL("image/jpeg",.62);if(d.length>140000)d=c.toDataURL("image/jpeg",.48);if(d.length>190000)d=c.toDataURL("image/jpeg",.36);if(d.length>210000)return reject(new Error("One photo is too large. Please choose a smaller image."));resolve(d);};img.src=r.result;};r.readAsDataURL(file);});}
function escapeHtml(value){

  return String(
    value == null
    ?
    ""
    :
    value
  )
  .replace(
    /&/g,
    "&amp;"
  )
  .replace(
    /</g,
    "&lt;"
  )
  .replace(
    />/g,
    "&gt;"
  )
  .replace(
    /"/g,
    "&quot;"
  )
  .replace(
    /'/g,
    "&#039;"
  );

}


function money(value){

  const n =
    Number(
      value || 0
    );


  return "₹" +
    n.toLocaleString(
      "en-IN",
      {
        maximumFractionDigits:2
      }
    );

}


/* ============================================================
   TOAST
============================================================ */

function showToast(message){

  const toast =
    $("toast");


  toast.textContent =
    message;


  toast.classList.add(
    "show"
  );


  setTimeout(
    function(){

      toast.classList.remove(
        "show"
      );

    },
    3000
  );

}


/* ============================================================
   FILTERS
============================================================ */

function toggleFilters(){

  const panel =
    $("filtersPanel");

  const toggle =
    $("filterToggle");


  const open =
    panel.classList.contains(
      "open"
    );


  if(open){

    panel.classList.remove(
      "open"
    );

    toggle.classList.remove(
      "open"
    );

  }else{

    panel.classList.add(
      "open"
    );

    toggle.classList.add(
      "open"
    );

  }

}


function updateFilterCount(){

  let count = 0;

  if(searchState.category) count++;
  if(searchState.course) count++;
  if(searchState.year) count++;
  if(searchState.subject) count++;
  if(searchState.maxPrice) count++;
  if(searchState.deals) count++;


  const badge =
    $("filterCount");


  if(count > 0){

    badge.textContent =
      String(count);

    badge.style.display =
      "inline-flex";

  }else{

    badge.style.display =
      "none";

  }

}


function readFilters(){

  searchState.category =
    $("filterCategory")
      .value
      .trim();

  searchState.course =
    $("filterCourse")
      .value
      .trim();

  searchState.year =
    $("filterYear")
      .value
      .trim();

  searchState.subject =
    $("filterSubject")
      .value
      .trim();

  searchState.maxPrice =
    $("filterMaxPrice")
      .value
      .trim();

  searchState.mode =
    $("filterSort")
      .value ||
    "latest";

  searchState.deals =
    $("filterDeals")
      .checked;

  updateFilterCount();

}


function applyFilters(){

  readFilters();

  searchState.q =
    $("searchInput")
      .value
      .trim();

  loadItems(
    searchState.mode,
    searchState.q
  );

  updateSearchSummary();

  showToast(
    "🔎 Filters applied."
  );

}


function clearFilters(){

  $("filterCategory").value = "";
  $("filterCourse").value = "";
  $("filterYear").value = "";
  $("filterSubject").value = "";
  $("filterMaxPrice").value = "";
  $("filterSort").value = "latest";
  $("filterDeals").checked = false;

  searchState.category = "";
  searchState.course = "";
  searchState.year = "";
  searchState.subject = "";
  searchState.maxPrice = "";
  searchState.mode = "latest";
  searchState.deals = false;

  updateFilterCount();

  searchState.q =
    $("searchInput")
      .value
      .trim();

  loadItems(
    "latest",
    searchState.q
  );

  updateSearchSummary();

  showToast(
    "Filters cleared."
  );

}


function syncFilterControls(){

  $("filterCategory").value =
    searchState.category || "";

  $("filterCourse").value =
    searchState.course || "";

  $("filterYear").value =
    searchState.year || "";

  $("filterSubject").value =
    searchState.subject || "";

  $("filterMaxPrice").value =
    searchState.maxPrice || "";

  $("filterSort").value =
    searchState.mode || "latest";

  $("filterDeals").checked =
    !!searchState.deals;

  updateFilterCount();

}


/* ============================================================
   SEARCH SUMMARY
============================================================ */

function updateSearchSummary(){

  const summary =
    $("searchSummary");

  const parts = [];


  if(searchState.q){

    parts.push(
      'Search: "' +
      searchState.q +
      '"'
    );

  }


  if(searchState.category){
    parts.push(searchState.category);
  }

  if(searchState.course){
    parts.push(searchState.course);
  }

  if(searchState.year){
    parts.push(searchState.year);
  }

  if(searchState.subject){
    parts.push(
      "Subject: " +
      searchState.subject
    );
  }

  if(searchState.maxPrice){

    parts.push(
      "≤ " +
      money(
        Number(
          searchState.maxPrice
        )
      )
    );

  }

  if(searchState.deals){
    parts.push("Deals only");
  }


  if(searchState.mode === "price_low"){

    parts.push("Low → High");

  }else if(
    searchState.mode === "price_high"
  ){

    parts.push("High → Low");

  }else if(
    searchState.mode === "deals"
  ){

    parts.push("Best Deals");

  }


  if(!parts.length){

    summary.classList.remove("show");
    summary.textContent = "";
    return;

  }


  summary.textContent =
    parts.join(" • ");

  summary.classList.add("show");

}

/* ============================================================
   LOAD ITEMS
============================================================ */

async function loadItems(
  mode,
  q
){

  try{

    if(mode){
      searchState.mode = mode;
    }


    if(
      q !== undefined &&
      q !== null
    ){

      searchState.q =
        String(q);

    }


    readFilters();


    const params =
      new URLSearchParams();


    params.set(
      "mode",
      searchState.mode ||
      "latest"
    );


    if(searchState.q){

      params.set(
        "q",
        searchState.q
      );

    }


    if(searchState.category){

      params.set(
        "category",
        searchState.category
      );

    }


    if(searchState.course){

      params.set(
        "course",
        searchState.course
      );

    }


    if(searchState.year){

      params.set(
        "year",
        searchState.year
      );

    }


    if(searchState.subject){

      params.set(
        "subject",
        searchState.subject
      );

    }


    if(searchState.maxPrice){

      params.set(
        "max_price",
        searchState.maxPrice
      );

    }


    if(searchState.deals){

      params.set(
        "deals",
        "1"
      );

    }


    updateSearchSummary();


    const response =
      await fetch(
        API_BASE +
        "/api/items?" +
        params.toString()
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(!data.ok){

      $("items").innerHTML =
        '<div class="empty">' +
        escapeHtml(
          data.error ||
          "Unable to load items."
        ) +
        '</div>';

      return;

    }


    currentItems =
      data.items ||
      [];


    if(
      searchState.q ||
      searchState.category ||
      searchState.course ||
      searchState.year ||
      searchState.subject ||
      searchState.maxPrice ||
      searchState.deals
    ){

      $("itemsHeading")
        .textContent =
          "Search Results";

    }else if(
      searchState.mode ===
      "deals"
    ){

      $("itemsHeading")
        .textContent =
          "Best Deals";

    }else{

      $("itemsHeading")
        .textContent =
          "🔥 Explore Marketplace";

    }


    renderItems(
      currentItems
    );

    if(window.medExchangeScrollToResults){
      window.medExchangeScrollToResults = false;
      setTimeout(function(){ document.getElementById("itemsHeading")?.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"}); },80);
    }

  }catch(error){

    console.error(error);

    $("items").innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty">' +
      'Unable to connect to Med Exchange.' +
      '</div>';

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   RENDER ITEMS
============================================================ */

function itemCardMarkup(item,index){
  const title=escapeHtml(item.title||"Untitled Item");
  const category=escapeHtml(item.category||"");
  const condition=escapeHtml(item.condition||"");
  const price=Number(item.selling_price||0);
  const original=Number(item.original_price||0);
  const discount=Number(item.discount_percent||0);
  const photos=getPhotoList(item);
  const photo=photos.length ? '<div class="listing-slider">'+photos.map(function(src){return '<div class="listing-slide"><img src="'+escapeHtml(src)+'" alt="'+title+'"></div>';}).join('')+'</div>'+(photos.length>1?'<span class="photo-count">📷 '+photos.length+'</span>':'') : '<div class="no-photo">'+(category==='Medical Instruments'?'🩺':(category==='Accessories'?'🎒':'📚'))+'</div>';
  return '<button class="market-card" onclick="openItem('+index+');return false;">'+
    '<div class="market-photo">'+(discount>0?'<span class="premium-ribbon">✨ DEAL</span>':'')+photo+'</div>'+
    '<div class="market-body"><div class="market-title">'+title+'</div><div class="market-price">'+money(price)+(original>price?'<span class="old-price">'+money(original)+'</span>':'')+'</div>'+
    '<div class="market-meta">'+category+(item.course?' • '+escapeHtml(item.course):'')+'</div>'+
    (condition?'<span class="market-condition">'+condition+'</span>':'')+'</div></button>';
}

function renderItems(items){
  const container=$("items");
  if(!items.length){container.innerHTML='<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">No approved items found for this search.</div>';return;}
  const isSearch=!!(searchState.q||searchState.category||searchState.course||searchState.year||searchState.subject||searchState.maxPrice||searchState.deals||searchState.mode==='deals');
  const visible=isSearch?items:items.slice(0,8);
  container.className='items market-grid';
  container.innerHTML=visible.map(itemCardMarkup).join('')+
    (!isSearch&&items.length>visible.length?'<div style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="home-preview-note">Showing the latest '+visible.length+' listings</div><button class="view-all-marketplace" onclick="openMarketplace()">View All Marketplace →</button></div>':'');
}

async function openMarketplace(){
  $("marketplaceScreen").style.display='block'; document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  $("marketplaceSearchInput").value=''; marketplaceState={q:'',category:''};
  document.querySelectorAll('.marketplace-cat').forEach(function(b,i){b.classList.toggle('active',i===0)});
  await loadMarketplaceItems();
}
function closeMarketplace(){$("marketplaceScreen").style.display='none';document.body.style.overflow='';}
let marketplaceState={q:'',category:''};
function searchMarketplace(){clearTimeout(window.marketSearchTimer);window.marketSearchTimer=setTimeout(function(){marketplaceState.q=$("marketplaceSearchInput").value.trim();loadMarketplaceItems();},220)}
function marketplaceCategory(category){marketplaceState.category=category;document.querySelectorAll('.marketplace-cat').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.category===category)});loadMarketplaceItems();}
async function loadMarketplaceItems(){
  const box=$("marketplaceItems"); box.innerHTML='<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">Loading listings...</div>';
  try{const p=new URLSearchParams();if(marketplaceState.q)p.set('q',marketplaceState.q);if(marketplaceState.category)p.set('category',marketplaceState.category);p.set('mode','latest');const r=await fetch(API_BASE+'/api/items?'+p.toString());const d=await r.json();if(!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Unable to load listings.');const items=d.items||[];currentItems=items;$("marketplaceCount").textContent='Showing '+items.length+' listing'+(items.length===1?'':'s');box.innerHTML=items.length?items.map(itemCardMarkup).join(''):'<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">No listings found.</div>';}catch(e){box.innerHTML='<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">Unable to load marketplace.</div>';}
}
async function openNotifications(){
  $("notificationScreen").style.display='block';document.body.style.overflow='hidden';const box=$("notificationList");box.innerHTML='<div class="utility-card">Loading new listings...</div>';
  try{const r=await fetch(API_BASE+'/api/items?mode=latest');const d=await r.json();const items=(d.items||[]).slice(0,5);box.innerHTML=items.length?'<div class="utility-card"><b>🔔 '+items.length+' New Listings</b><div class="utility-sub" style="margin-top:4px">Tap any item to view details.</div></div>'+items.map(function(item,i){currentItems=items;return itemCardMarkup(item,i);}).join(''):'<div class="utility-card utility-empty">No new listings right now.</div>';box.className='notification-list market-grid';}catch(e){box.innerHTML='<div class="utility-card utility-empty">Unable to load notifications.</div>';}
}


/* ============================================================
   ITEM DETAIL
============================================================ */

async function openItem(index){

  const item =
    currentItems[index];


  if(!item){
    return;
  }


  $("itemModal").style.display =
    "block";

  document.body.style.overflow =
    "hidden";

  $("itemDetail").innerHTML =
    '<div class="empty">' +
    'Loading item details...' +
    '</div>';


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        API_BASE +
        "/api/items/" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          item.id
        )
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(!data.ok){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Unable to load item."
      );

    }


    renderItemDetail(
      data.item
    );


  }catch(error){

    console.error(error);

    $("itemDetail").innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty">' +
      escapeHtml(
        error.message ||
        "Unable to load item."
      ) +
      '</div>';

  }

}


function renderItemDetail(item){

  if(!item){

    $("itemDetail").innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty">Item not found.</div>';

    return;

  }


  const title =
    escapeHtml(
      item.title ||
      "Untitled Item"
    );

  const description =
    escapeHtml(
      item.description ||
      "No description provided."
    );

  const category =
    escapeHtml(
      item.category ||
      ""
    );

  const course =
    escapeHtml(
      item.course ||
      ""
    );

  const year =
    escapeHtml(
      item.year ||
      ""
    );

  const subject =
    escapeHtml(
      item.subject ||
      ""
    );

  const condition =
    escapeHtml(
      item.condition ||
      ""
    );

  const edition =
    escapeHtml(
      item.edition_model ||
      ""
    );

  const location =
    escapeHtml(
      item.location_text ||
      "MRV Campus"
    );

  const seller =
    escapeHtml(
      item.seller_name ||
      "MRV Student"
    );

  const price =
    Number(
      item.selling_price ||
      0
    );

  const original =
    Number(
      item.original_price ||
      0
    );

  const discount =
    Number(
      item.discount_percent ||
      0
    );


  let html = "";


  const detailPhotos=getPhotoList(item);
  if(detailPhotos.length){html+='<div class="detail-gallery"><div class="detail-gallery-track">'+detailPhotos.map(function(src){return '<div class="detail-gallery-slide"><img src="'+escapeHtml(src)+'" alt="'+title+'"></div>';}).join('')+'</div>'+(detailPhotos.length>1?'<span class="detail-gallery-count">📷 '+detailPhotos.length+' photos • swipe</span>':'')+'</div>'; }


  html +=
    '<div class="modal-title">' +
      title +
    '</div>';


  html +=
    '<div class="detail-price">' +
      money(price) +

      (
        original > price
        ?
        '<span class="old-price">' +
        money(original) +
        '</span>'
        :
        ""
      ) +

      (
        discount > 0
        ?
        '<span class="discount">' +
        Math.round(discount) +
        '% OFF</span>'
        :
        ""
      ) +

    '</div>';


  const meta =
    [
      category,
      course,
      year,
      subject,
      condition,
      edition
    ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" • ");


  html +=
    '<div class="detail-meta">' +
      escapeHtml(meta) +
      '<br>' +
      '📍 ' +
      location +
      '<br>' +
      '👤 Seller: ' +
      seller +
      '<br>' +
      '🆔 Item ID: ME-' +
      Number(item.id) +
    '</div>';


  html +=
    '<div class="detail-description">' +
      description +
    '</div>';


  if(
    item.book_set &&
    item.book_set.length
  ){

    html +=
      '<div style="margin-top:15px;font-weight:900;">' +
      '📚 Books in Set' +
      '</div>';

    html +=
      '<div class="detail-description">';


    item.book_set.forEach(
      function(book){

        const bp=Number(book.selling_price||0), bo=Number(book.original_price||0), bd=Number(book.discount_percent||0);
        html += '<div style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);">' +
          '<div><b>' + escapeHtml(book.book_number||"") + '.</b> ' + escapeHtml(book.name||"Book") + '</div>' +
          '<div style="margin-top:4px;font-size:10px;color:#9ba8b8;">' + [book.subject,book.year,book.edition_model,book.condition].filter(Boolean).map(escapeHtml).join(' • ') + '</div>' +
          '<div style="margin-top:5px;font-weight:950;">' + money(bp) + (bo>bp?'<span class="old-price" style="margin-left:7px;">'+money(bo)+'</span>':'') + (bd>0?'<span class="discount" style="margin-left:7px;">'+Math.round(bd)+'% OFF</span>':'') + '</div>' +
          (book.description?'<div style="margin-top:5px;font-size:10px;color:#b9c4d2;">'+escapeHtml(book.description)+'</div>':'') +
          '</div>';

      }
    );


    html +=
      '</div>';

  }


  const contactButtons = [];
  if(item.seller_phone) contactButtons.push('<a class="detail-btn" href="tel:' + escapeHtml(item.seller_phone) + '">☎️ Phone</a>');
  if(item.seller_whatsapp) contactButtons.push('<a class="detail-btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://wa.me/' + String(item.seller_whatsapp).replace(/\D/g,'') + '">💬 WhatsApp</a>');
  if(item.seller_instagram) contactButtons.push('<a class="detail-btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://instagram.com/' + encodeURIComponent(String(item.seller_instagram).replace(/^@/,'')) + '">◎ Instagram</a>');
  if(item.seller_telegram) contactButtons.push('<a class="detail-btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://t.me/' + encodeURIComponent(String(item.seller_telegram).replace(/^@/,'')) + '">✈️ Telegram</a>');
  if(item.seller_snapchat) contactButtons.push('<a class="detail-btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.snapchat.com/add/' + encodeURIComponent(String(item.seller_snapchat).replace(/^@/,'')) + '">👻 Snapchat</a>');
  if(contactButtons.length){
    html += '<div style="margin-top:15px;font-weight:900;">📞 Contact Seller</div>';
    html += '<div class="detail-buttons" style="margin-top:8px;">' + contactButtons.join('') + '</div>';
  }

  html +=
    '<div class="detail-buttons">' +

      '<button class="detail-btn primary" ' +
      'onclick="saveCurrentItem(' +
      Number(item.id) +
      ')">' +
      '♡ Save' +
      '</button>' +

      '<button class="detail-btn" onclick="shareCurrentItem('+Number(item.id)+')">↗️ Share</button>' +

    '</div>';


  $("itemDetail").innerHTML =
    html;

}

/* ============================================================
   SAVED / SHARE / ACCOUNT
============================================================ */
function getSavedItems(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("med_exchange_saved")||"[]");}catch(e){return [];}}
function setSavedItems(x){localStorage.setItem("med_exchange_saved",JSON.stringify(x));}
function saveCurrentItem(id){const n=Number(id),a=getSavedItems(),i=a.indexOf(n);if(i<0){a.push(n);showToast("♡ Saved.");}else{a.splice(i,1);showToast("♡ Removed from Saved.");}setSavedItems(a);if($('savedScreen').style.display==='block')renderSavedItems();}
async function shareCurrentItem(id){const url=location.origin+location.pathname+'?item='+id,title=(currentItems.find(x=>Number(x.id)===Number(id))||{}).title||'Med Exchange Item',text='📚 '+title+' on Med Exchange — '+url;try{if(navigator.share)await navigator.share({title:'Med Exchange',text,url});else{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);showToast('↗️ Listing link copied.');}}catch(e){}}
async function fetchItemById(id){try{const r=await fetch('/api/items/'+id);const d=await r.json();return d.ok?d.item:null;}catch(e){return null;}}
async function renderSavedItems(){const ids=getSavedItems();if(!ids.length){$('savedList').innerHTML='<div class="utility-card utility-empty">♡<br><br>No saved items yet.<br>Tap Save on a listing you like.</div>';return;}$('savedList').innerHTML='<div class="utility-card">Loading...</div>';const items=(await Promise.all(ids.map(fetchItemById))).filter(Boolean);$('savedList').innerHTML=items.length?items.map(x=>{const ph=getPhotoList(x),p=Number(x.selling_price||0),o=Number(x.original_price||0);return '<div class="utility-card"><div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;"><div class="item-photo" style="width:88px;height:88px;">'+(ph[0]?'<img src="'+escapeHtml(ph[0])+'" alt="">':'<div class="no-photo">📚</div>')+'</div><div style="min-width:0;flex:1;"><div class="item-title">'+escapeHtml(x.title||'Item')+'</div><div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:950;margin-top:5px;">'+money(p)+'</div>'+(o>p?'<span class="old-price">'+money(o)+'</span>':'')+'</div></div><div class="actions"><button class="share-btn" onclick="openSavedItem('+x.id+')">👀 View</button><button class="share-btn" onclick="shareCurrentItem('+x.id+')">↗️ Share</button><button class="sold-btn" onclick="saveCurrentItem('+x.id+')">♡ Remove</button></div></div>';}).join(''):'<div class="utility-card utility-empty">Saved listing is no longer available.</div>';}

async function saveEditedListing(id){const selling=Number($('editSelling').value||0),oraw=$('editOriginal').value,original=oraw===''?null:Number(oraw);if(!Number.isFinite(selling)||selling<0)return showToast('Enter a valid selling price.');if(original!==null&&(!Number.isFinite(original)||original<0||selling>original))return showToast('Check the original and selling price.');const contacts=[$('editPhone').value.trim(),$('editWhatsApp').value.trim(),$('editInstagram').value.trim(),$('editTelegram').value.trim(),$('editSnapchat').value.trim()];if(!contacts.some(Boolean))return showToast('Add at least one contact method.');const button=document.querySelector('#editListingContent .edit-save');if(button)button.disabled=true;try{const payload={seller_id:Number(sellerId),title:$('editTitle').value.trim(),description:$('editDescription').value.trim(),edition_model:$('editEdition').value.trim(),course:$('editCourse').value,year:$('editYear').value,subject:$('editSubject').value.trim(),condition:$('editCondition').value,original_price:original,selling_price:selling,is_negotiable:$('editNegotiable').dataset.value==='1'?1:0,delivery_option:$('editDelivery').value,location_text:$('editLocation').value.trim()||'MRV Campus',phone:$('editPhone').value.trim(),whatsapp:$('editWhatsApp').value.trim(),instagram:$('editInstagram').value.trim(),telegram:$('editTelegram').value.trim(),snapchat:$('editSnapchat').value.trim()};const r=await fetch('/api/seller/items/'+Number(id),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(payload)}),d=await r.json();if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Unable to update listing.');showToast('✓ Listing updated.');closeEditListing();$('accountScreen').style.display='block';document.body.style.overflow='hidden';loadAccount();loadItems(searchState.mode);}catch(e){showToast(e.message||'Unable to update listing.');}finally{if(button)button.disabled=false;}}
async function deleteOwnListing(id){const n=Number(id);if(!n)return;if(!confirm('Delete this listing permanently?'))return;try{const r=await fetch('/api/seller/items/'+n+'?seller_id='+Number(sellerId),{method:'DELETE'}),d=await r.json();if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Unable to delete listing.');showToast('🗑 Listing deleted.');loadAccount();loadItems(searchState.mode);}catch(e){showToast(e.message||'Unable to delete listing.');}}
async function deleteMyAccount(){var sid=Number(sellerId||0),pid=Number(localStorage.getItem('mrv_chat_profile_id')||0);if(!sid&&!pid){showToast('No account found on this device.');return}if(!confirm('Delete your account permanently? This cannot be undone.'))return;var button=document.querySelector('#accountScreen .sold-btn');if(button){button.disabled=true;button.textContent='DELETING…'}try{var r=await fetch('/api/account/delete',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({seller_id:sid,profile_id:pid})}),d=await r.json();if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Unable to delete account.');localStorage.removeItem('med_exchange_seller_id');localStorage.removeItem('med_exchange_pending_item_id');localStorage.removeItem('mrv_chat_profile_id');localStorage.removeItem('mrv_chat_stage3');Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(function(k){if(k.indexOf('mrv_chat_')===0||k.indexOf('med_exchange_')===0)localStorage.removeItem(k)});sellerId=null;profileId=0;chatId=0;closeUtilityScreens();document.body.style.overflow='';alert('Your account and associated data have been permanently deleted.');window.location.reload()}catch(e){if(button){button.disabled=false;button.textContent='🗑 Delete Account'}alert(e.message||'Unable to delete account.')}}
async function markItemSold(id){if(!confirm('Confirm that this item has been sold?'))return;try{const r=await fetch('/api/seller/items/'+id+'/sold',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({seller_id:Number(sellerId)})}),d=await r.json();if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Unable to mark sold.');showToast('✓ Marked SOLD.');loadAccount();loadItems(searchState.mode);}catch(e){showToast(e.message||'Unable to mark sold.');}}
