function sellItem(){
  if(!Number(sellerId||0)){ openSellerProfileSetup(); return; }
  $("sellScreen").style.display="block";
  document.body.style.overflow="hidden";
  updatePreview();
  loadBookLimit();
}

function openSellerProfileSetup(){
  var old=$("sellerProfileSetup"); if(old){old.style.display="flex";return;}
  var wrap=document.createElement("div"); wrap.id="sellerProfileSetup";
  wrap.style.cssText="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:rgba(7,10,18,.97);overflow:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:22px 14px;";
  wrap.innerHTML='<div style="width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;background:var(--card,#111827);border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.1));border-radius:24px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);"><div style="font-size:28px;font-weight:950;line-height:1.05;">Create Your Seller Profile 👤</div><div class="sub" style="margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5;">Set up your seller profile once. These details will be used with your items.</div><div class="notice" style="margin-top:14px;">🛍️ This profile is only for students who want to sell items on Med Exchange.</div><div class="field" style="margin-top:18px;"><label class="label">Full Name *</label><input id="sellerProfileName" class="input" maxlength="100" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Enter your full name"></div><div class="field"><label class="label">Course *</label><select id="sellerProfileCourse" class="select"><option value="">Select course</option><option>MBBS</option><option>BDS</option><option>PG</option><option>Other</option></select></div><div class="field"><label class="label">Year *</label><select id="sellerProfileYear" class="select"><option value="">Select year</option><option>1st Year</option><option>2nd Year</option><option>3rd Year</option><option>4th Year</option><option>Intern</option><option>PG</option><option>Other</option></select></div><div class="field"><label class="label">Mobile Number *</label><input id="sellerProfilePhone" class="input" type="tel" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" maxlength="20" placeholder="Enter mobile number"></div><div class="field"><label class="label">College / Campus *</label><input id="sellerProfileCollege" class="input" value="Malla Reddy Vishwavidyapeeth" disabled></div><div class="field"><label class="label">Preferred Meetup Location <span style="font-weight:500;color:#8d9aaa;">(Optional)</span></label><select id="sellerProfileMeetup" class="select"><option value="">Select location</option><option>College</option><option>Hostel</option><option>Library</option><option>Cafeteria</option><option>Other</option></select></div><label class="label" style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:8px;"><input id="sellerProfileAgree" type="checkbox" style="margin-top:3px;"><span>I agree to the Med Exchange Seller Guidelines.</span></label><div id="sellerProfileStatus" style="margin-top:10px;"></div><button id="sellerProfileCreate" type="button" class="primary" style="width:100%;margin-top:14px;">CREATE SELLER PROFILE →</button><button id="sellerProfileCancel" type="button" class="secondary" style="width:100%;margin-top:9px;">CANCEL</button></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(wrap); $("sellerProfileCreate").onclick=createSellerProfileFromUI; $("sellerProfileCancel").onclick=function(){wrap.remove();document.body.style.overflow="";}; document.body.style.overflow="hidden";
  setTimeout(function(){if($("sellerProfileName"))$("sellerProfileName").focus();},80);
}
async function createSellerProfileFromUI(){
  var name=($("sellerProfileName")?.value||"").trim(),course=$("sellerProfileCourse")?.value||"",year=$("sellerProfileYear")?.value||"",phone=($("sellerProfilePhone")?.value||"").trim(),meetup=$("sellerProfileMeetup")?.value||"";
  function err(m){var x=$("sellerProfileStatus");if(x)x.innerHTML='<div class="notice" style="color:#ffb0b0;">'+escapeHtml(m)+'</div>';}
  if(name.length<2)return err("Enter your full name."); if(!course)return err("Select your course."); if(!year)return err("Select your year."); if(phone.replace(/\D/g,"").length<10)return err("Enter a valid mobile number."); if(!$("sellerProfileAgree")?.checked)return err("Please agree to the Seller Guidelines.");
  var b=$("sellerProfileCreate");if(b){b.disabled=true;b.textContent="CREATING…";}
  try{var r=await fetch(API_BASE+"/api/seller/session",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({name:name,course:course,year:year,phone:phone,meetup_location:meetup})}),d=await r.json();if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||"Unable to create seller profile.");sellerId=String(d.user_id);localStorage.setItem("med_exchange_seller_id",sellerId);wrap.remove();document.body.style.overflow="hidden";$("sellScreen").style.display="block";updatePreview();loadBookLimit();showToast("✓ Seller profile created. You can now sell your item.");}catch(e){err(e.message||"Unable to create seller profile.");if(b){b.disabled=false;b.textContent="CREATE SELLER PROFILE →";}}
}function closeSell(){

  $("sellScreen").style.display =
    "none";

  document.body.style.overflow =
    "";

}


/* ============================================================
   CATEGORY
============================================================ */

function selectCategory(category){
  selectedCategory = category;
  ["catBooks","catInstruments","catAccessories","catStudy","catOther"].forEach(function(id){ if($(id)) $(id).classList.remove("active"); });
  const map={"Books":"catBooks","Medical Instruments":"catInstruments","Accessories":"catAccessories","Study Material":"catStudy","Other":"catOther"};
  if(map[category] && $(map[category])) $(map[category]).classList.add("active");

  const isBooks = category === "Books";
  const isSimple = category === "Medical Instruments" || category === "Accessories";
  if($("bookLimitCard")) $("bookLimitCard").style.display = isBooks ? "block" : "none";
  if($("bookSetCard")) $("bookSetCard").style.display = isBooks ? "block" : "none";
  if($("singlePhotoCard")) $("singlePhotoCard").style.display = isBooks ? "none" : "block";
  if($("singleItemFields")) $("singleItemFields").style.display = isBooks ? "none" : "block";
  if($("academicFields")) $("academicFields").style.display = isBooks ? "none" : "block";
  if($("subjectField")) $("subjectField").style.display = isSimple ? "none" : "block";
  if($("condition")) $("condition").style.display = isBooks ? "none" : "block";
  if($("priceCard")) $("priceCard").style.display = isBooks ? "none" : "block";
  if($("photoLimitText")) $("photoLimitText").textContent = isSimple ? "Add up to 2 photos" : "Add up to 10 photos";
  if($("photoInput")) $("photoInput").setAttribute("multiple", "");
  if(isBooks){ initBookSet(); loadBookLimit(); }
  else { if(bookEntries.length) bookEntries=[]; }
  updatePreview();
}

/* ============================================================
   CONDITION
============================================================ */

function selectCondition(condition){

  selectedCondition =
    condition;


  [
    "condLikeNew",
    "condGood",
    "condUsed"
  ]
  .forEach(
    function(id){

      $(id).classList.remove(
        "active"
      );

    }
  );


  if(condition === "Like New"){

    $("condLikeNew")
      .classList.add(
        "active"
      );

  }


  if(condition === "Good"){

    $("condGood")
      .classList.add(
        "active"
      );

  }


  if(condition === "Used"){

    $("condUsed")
      .classList.add(
        "active"
      );

  }


  updatePreview();

}


/* ============================================================
   DELIVERY
============================================================ */

function selectDelivery(delivery){

  selectedDelivery =
    delivery;


  [
    "deliveryPickup",
    "deliveryDelivery",
    "deliveryArrange"
  ]
  .forEach(
    function(id){

      $(id).classList.remove(
        "active"
      );

    }
  );


  if(
    delivery ===
    "Campus Pickup"
  ){

    $("deliveryPickup")
      .classList.add(
        "active"
      );

  }


  if(
    delivery ===
    "Delivery"
  ){

    $("deliveryDelivery")
      .classList.add(
        "active"
      );

  }


  if(
    delivery ===
    "Arrange with Seller"
  ){

    $("deliveryArrange")
      .classList.add(
        "active"
      );

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   NEGOTIABLE
============================================================ */

function toggleNegotiable(){

  isNegotiable =
    !isNegotiable;


  const button =
    $("negotiableToggle");


  if(isNegotiable){

    button.classList.add(
      "active"
    );

  }else{

    button.classList.remove(
      "active"
    );

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   PHOTOS
============================================================ */

function handlePhotos(event){
  const files=Array.from(event.target.files||[]);
  const max=selectedCategory === "Medical Instruments" || selectedCategory === "Accessories" ? 2 : 10;
  selectedPhotos=files.slice(0,max);
  if(files.length>max) showToast("Maximum "+max+" photos allowed for this category.");
  renderPhotoPreview();
  updatePreview();
}

function renderPhotoPreview(){

  const container =
    $("photoPreview");


  container.innerHTML =
    "";


  selectedPhotos.forEach(
    function(file,index){

      const url =
        URL.createObjectURL(
          file
        );


      const wrapper =
        document.createElement(
          "div"
        );


      wrapper.className =
        "photo-thumb";


      wrapper.innerHTML =
        '<img src="' +
        url +
        '" alt="">' +

        '<button class="photo-remove" ' +
        'onclick="removePhoto(' +
        index +
        ');return false;">×</button>';


      container.appendChild(
        wrapper
      );

    }
  );

}


function removePhoto(index){

  selectedPhotos.splice(
    index,
    1
  );

  renderPhotoPreview();

}


/* ============================================================
   DISCOUNT
============================================================ */

function updateDiscount(){

  const original =
    Number(
      $("originalPrice").value ||
      0
    );

  const selling =
    Number(
      $("sellingPrice").value ||
      0
    );

  let discount =
    0;


  if(
    original > 0 &&
    selling >= 0 &&
    selling < original
  ){

    discount =
      (
        (original - selling) /
        original
      ) *
      100;

  }


  $("discountText")
    .textContent =
      discount > 0
      ?
      Math.round(discount) +
      "% discount"
      :
      "";

}


/* ============================================================
   PREVIEW
============================================================ */

function updatePreview(){

  const title =
    $("itemTitle").value.trim();

  const original =
    Number(
      $("originalPrice").value ||
      0
    );

  const selling =
    Number(
      $("sellingPrice").value ||
      0
    );

  const course =
    $("course").value;

  const year =
    $("year").value;

  const subject =
    $("subject").value.trim();

  const condition =
    selectedCondition;


  if($("previewPhoto")){
    const first=selectedPhotos[0];
    if(first){const u=URL.createObjectURL(first);$("previewPhoto").innerHTML='<img src="'+u+'" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;" alt="">';}
    else $("previewPhoto").innerHTML='📚';
  }


  $("previewTitle")
    .textContent =
      title ||
      "Your item title";


  $("previewPrice")
    .textContent =
      money(
        selling ||
        0
      );


  const parts = [];


  if(course) parts.push(course);
  if(year) parts.push(year);
  if(subject) parts.push(subject);
  if(condition) parts.push(condition);


  if(
    original > 0 &&
    selling < original
  ){

    const discount =
      Math.round(
        (
          (original - selling) /
          original
        ) *
        100
      );


    if(discount > 0){

      parts.push(
        discount +
        "% OFF"
      );

    }

  }


  $("previewMeta")
    .textContent =
      parts.length
      ?
      parts.join(" • ")
      :
      "Add your item details above.";

}


/* ============================================================
   BOOK SELLING LIMIT
============================================================ */

async function loadBookLimit(){
  if($("bookLimitCard")) $("bookLimitCard").style.display = selectedCategory === "Books" ? "block" : "none";
  if(selectedCategory !== "Books") return;
  try{
    const id = Number(sellerId || 0);
    if(!id){ $("bookLimitText").textContent = "0 / 10 books listed"; return; }
    const response = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/seller/book-limit?seller_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id), {cache:"no-store"});
    const data = await response.json();
    if(!response.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Unable to load book limit.");
    $("bookLimitText").textContent = Number(data.active_books || 0) + " / " + Number(data.limit || MAX_ACTIVE_BOOK_LISTINGS) + " books listed";
  }catch(error){
    $("bookLimitText").textContent = "Maximum 10 active book listings";
  }
}


/* ============================================================
   BOOK SET BUILDER
============================================================ */

function initBookSet(){
  bookCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(bookCount)||1));
  renderBookCountButtons();
  setBookCount(bookCount, true);
}

function renderBookCountButtons(){
  const row=$("bookCountRow"); if(!row) return;
  row.innerHTML="";
  for(let i=1;i<=10;i++){
    const b=document.createElement("button"); b.type="button"; b.className="book-count-btn"+(i===bookCount?" active":""); b.textContent=String(i); b.onclick=function(){setBookCount(i);}; row.appendChild(b);
  }
}

function setBookCount(n, preserve){
  n=Math.max(1,Math.min(10,Number(n)||1));
  const old=bookEntries||[];
  bookCount=n; bookEntries=[];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const x=old[i]||{};
    bookEntries.push({name:x.name||"",description:x.description||"",edition_model:x.edition_model||"",condition:x.condition||"",subject:x.subject||"",course:x.course||"",year:x.year||"",original_price:x.original_price||"",selling_price:x.selling_price||"",photo:x.photo||null});
  }
  renderBookCountButtons(); renderBookEntries(); updateBookSetTotals(); updatePreview();
}

function renderBookEntries(){
  const box=$("bookSetEditor"); if(!box) return; box.innerHTML="";
  bookEntries.forEach(function(b,i){
    const wrap=document.createElement("div"); wrap.className="book-entry";
    wrap.innerHTML='<div class="book-entry-head"><div><div class="book-entry-title">Book '+(i+1)+'</div><div class="book-entry-sub">Individual details & one photo</div></div></div>'+
      '<div class="field"><label class="label">Book Name <span style="color:#718198;font-weight:600;">(optional)</span></label><input class="input" value="'+escapeHtml(b.name)+'" oninput="bookField('+i+',&quot;name&quot;,this.value)"></div>'+
      '<div class="field"><label class="label">Description <span style="color:#718198;font-weight:600;">(optional)</span></label><textarea class="textarea" oninput="bookField('+i+',&quot;description&quot;,this.value)">'+escapeHtml(b.description)+'</textarea></div>'+
      '<div class="field"><label class="label">Edition / Model <span style="color:#718198;font-weight:600;">(optional)</span></label><input class="input" value="'+escapeHtml(b.edition_model)+'" oninput="bookField('+i+',&quot;edition_model&quot;,this.value)"></div>'+
      '<div class="grid2"><div class="field"><label class="label">Course</label><select class="select" onchange="bookField('+i+',&quot;course&quot;,this.value)"><option value="">Select</option><option value="MBBS">MBBS</option><option value="BDS">BDS</option><option value="PG">PG</option><option value="Other">Other</option></select></div><div class="field"><label class="label">Year</label><select class="select" onchange="bookField('+i+',&quot;year&quot;,this.value)"><option value="">Select</option><option value="1st Year">1st Year</option><option value="2nd Year">2nd Year</option><option value="3rd Year">3rd Year</option><option value="4th Year">4th Year</option><option value="Other">Other</option></select></div></div>'+
      '<div class="field"><label class="label">Subject</label><input class="input" value="'+escapeHtml(b.subject)+'" oninput="bookField('+i+',&quot;subject&quot;,this.value)"></div>'+
      '<div class="field"><label class="label">Condition</label><select class="select" onchange="bookField('+i+',&quot;condition&quot;,this.value)"><option value="">Select</option><option value="Like New">Like New</option><option value="Good">Good</option><option value="Used">Used</option></select></div>'+
      '<div class="grid2"><div class="field"><label class="label">Original Price</label><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="'+escapeHtml(b.original_price)+'" oninput="bookField('+i+',&quot;original_price&quot;,this.value)"></div><div class="field"><label class="label">Selling Price</label><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="'+escapeHtml(b.selling_price)+'" oninput="bookField('+i+',&quot;selling_price&quot;,this.value)"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="book-photo-row"><div id="bookPhotoPreview'+i+'" class="book-photo-preview">📚</div><input class="book-photo-input" type="file" accept="image/*" onchange="handleBookPhoto(event,'+i+')"></div>';
    box.appendChild(wrap);
    const selects=wrap.querySelectorAll('select'); if(selects[0]) selects[0].value=b.course||''; if(selects[1]) selects[1].value=b.year||''; if(selects[2]) selects[2].value=b.condition||'';
    if(b.photo){ const u=URL.createObjectURL(b.photo); const ph=$("bookPhotoPreview"+i); if(ph) ph.innerHTML='<img src="'+u+'" alt="">'; }
  });
}

function bookField(i,key,value){ if(!bookEntries[i]) return; bookEntries[i][key]=value; updateBookSetTotals(); updatePreview(); }

function handleBookPhoto(event,i){
  const file=(event.target.files||[])[0]; if(!file) return;
  if(!file.type.startsWith("image/")){showToast("Please select an image file.");return;}
  bookEntries[i].photo=file; const ph=$("bookPhotoPreview"+i); if(ph){const u=URL.createObjectURL(file);ph.innerHTML='<img src="'+u+'" alt="">';}
}

function getBookTotals(){
  let original=0,selling=0,allOriginal=true;
  bookEntries.forEach(function(b){const o=Number(b.original_price);const p=Number(b.selling_price);if(Number.isFinite(o)&&b.original_price!==""&&o>=0){original+=o;}else{allOriginal=false;}if(Number.isFinite(p)&&p>=0)selling+=p;});
  return {original:allOriginal?original:null,selling:selling,discount:(allOriginal&&original>0&&selling<original)?((original-selling)/original)*100:0};
}

function updateBookSetTotals(){
  const t=getBookTotals(),box=$("bookSetTotals"); if(!box)return;
  box.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:10px;color:#9ba8b8;font-weight:800;">'+bookCount+' BOOK'+(bookCount===1?'':'S')+' • TOTAL</div><div class="book-set-total-price">'+money(t.selling)+'</div>'+(t.original!==null&&t.original>t.selling?'<div class="book-set-total-old">Original total '+money(t.original)+'</div><div class="book-set-discount">'+Math.round(t.discount)+'% OFF TOTAL</div>':'<div class="book-set-note">Add original prices to calculate the total discount.</div>');
}

async function saveBookSetDraft(){
  if(!bookEntries.length){showToast("Select at least 1 book.");return;}
  const t=getBookTotals();
  if(!Number.isFinite(t.selling)||t.selling<0){showToast("Enter valid selling prices for the books.");return;}
  for(let i=0;i<bookEntries.length;i++){
    const b=bookEntries[i];
    if(!b.photo){showToast("Please upload a photo for Book "+(i+1)+".");return;}
    const p=Number(b.selling_price),o=b.original_price===""?null:Number(b.original_price);
    if(!Number.isFinite(p)||p<0){showToast("Enter a valid selling price for Book "+(i+1)+".");return;}
    if(o!==null&&(!Number.isFinite(o)||o<0||p>o)){showToast("Check the original/selling price for Book "+(i+1)+".");return;}
  }
  const contactValues=[$("contactPhone")?.value.trim()||"",$("contactWhatsApp")?.value.trim()||"",$("contactInstagram")?.value.trim()||"",$("contactTelegram")?.value.trim()||"",$("contactSnapchat")?.value.trim()||""];
  if(!contactValues.some(Boolean)){showToast("Add at least one contact method: Phone, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram or Snapchat.");$("contactPhone")?.focus();return;}
  const button=document.querySelector(".save-btn"),oldText=button.textContent;button.disabled=true;button.textContent="Preparing Book Set...";
  try{
    const seller=await ensureSellerSession();
    const books=[]; let totalOriginal=0,totalSelling=0,allOriginal=true;
    for(let i=0;i<bookEntries.length;i++){
      const b=bookEntries[i], photo=await compressListingPhoto(b.photo); const p=Number(b.selling_price); const o=b.original_price===""?null:Number(b.original_price);
      if(o!==null) totalOriginal+=o; else allOriginal=false; totalSelling+=p;
      books.push({book_number:i+1,name:String(b.name||""),description:String(b.description||""),edition_model:String(b.edition_model||""),condition:String(b.condition||""),subject:String(b.subject||""),course:String(b.course||""),year:String(b.year||""),original_price:o,selling_price:p,photo_url:photo});
    }
    const discount=allOriginal&&totalOriginal>0&&totalSelling<totalOriginal?((totalOriginal-totalSelling)/totalOriginal)*100:0;
    if(!allOriginal) totalOriginal=null;
    const title=String($("bookSetTitle")?.value.trim()||("Book Set • "+bookCount+" Books"));
    const description=books.map(function(b,i){return ["Book "+(i+1),b.name,b.subject,b.course,b.year,b.edition_model,b.condition,b.description].filter(Boolean).join(" ");}).join(" | ");
    const payload={seller_id:Number(seller),category:"Books",title:title,description:description,edition_model:"",course:"",year:"",subject:"",condition:"",original_price:totalOriginal,selling_price:totalSelling,discount_percent:Number(discount.toFixed(2)),is_negotiable:isNegotiable?1:0,delivery_option:String(selectedDelivery||""),location_text:String($("locationText")?.value||"MRV Campus"),phone:$("contactPhone")?.value.trim()||"",whatsapp:$("contactWhatsApp")?.value.trim()||"",instagram:$("contactInstagram")?.value.trim()||"",telegram:$("contactTelegram")?.value.trim()||"",snapchat:$("contactSnapchat")?.value.trim()||"",photo_urls:books.map(function(b){return b.photo_url;}),book_set:books};
    const response=await fetch(API_BASE+"/api/items/create",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
    const data=await response.json(); if(!response.ok||!data.ok)throw new Error(data.error||"Unable to save book set.");
    currentPaymentItemId=Number(data.item_id);localStorage.setItem("med_exchange_pending_item_id",String(currentPaymentItemId));closeSell();await openPaymentScreen(currentPaymentItemId);
  }catch(error){console.error(error);showToast("❌ "+(error.message||"Unable to save book set."));}finally{button.disabled=false;button.textContent=oldText;}
}

/* ============================================================
   SELLER SESSION
============================================================ */

async function ensureSellerSession(){

  if(sellerId){

    const parsed =
      Number(
        sellerId
      );


    if(
      Number.isInteger(
        parsed
      ) &&
      parsed > 0
    ){

      return parsed;

    }

  }


  const response =
    await fetch(
      API_BASE +
      "/api/seller/session",
      {
        method:"POST",

        headers:{
          "Content-Type":
            "application/json"
        },

        body:
          JSON.stringify({
            name:"MRV Student",
            phone: $("contactPhone") ? $("contactPhone").value.trim() : "",
            whatsapp: $("contactWhatsApp") ? $("contactWhatsApp").value.trim() : "",
            instagram: $("contactInstagram") ? $("contactInstagram").value.trim() : "",
            telegram: $("contactTelegram") ? $("contactTelegram").value.trim() : "",
            snapchat: $("contactSnapchat") ? $("contactSnapchat").value.trim() : ""
          })
      }
    );


  const data =
    await response.json();


  if(
    !response.ok ||
    !data.ok
  ){

    throw new Error(
      data.error ||
      "Unable to create seller."
    );

  }


  sellerId =
    String(
      data.user_id
    );


  localStorage.setItem(
    "med_exchange_seller_id",
    sellerId
  );


  return Number(
    data.user_id
  );

}


/* ============================================================
   SAVE ITEM + OPEN PAYMENT
============================================================ */

async function saveItemDraft(){

  const title =
    $("itemTitle")
      .value
      .trim();


  const selling =
    Number(
      $("sellingPrice").value
    );


  const originalRaw =
    $("originalPrice").value;


  const original =
    originalRaw === ""
    ?
    null
    :
    Number(
      originalRaw
    );


  if(!selectedCategory){
    showToast("Please select a category.");
    return;
  }

  if(selectedCategory === "Books"){
    return saveBookSetDraft();
  }

  if(!title){
    // Item name is optional; use a harmless category fallback for storage.
    $("itemTitle").value = selectedCategory;
  }

  if(!title){
    // Optional item name: backend receives the category fallback below.
  }


  if(
    !Number.isFinite(
      selling
    ) ||
    selling < 0
  ){

    showToast(
      "Please enter a valid selling price."
    );

    $("sellingPrice").focus();

    return;

  }


  if(
    original !== null &&
    (
      !Number.isFinite(
        original
      ) ||
      original < 0
    )
  ){

    showToast(
      "Please enter a valid original price."
    );

    return;

  }


  if(
    original !== null &&
    selling > original
  ){

    showToast(
      "Selling price cannot exceed original price."
    );

    return;

  }

  const contactValues = [
    $("contactPhone") ? $("contactPhone").value.trim() : "",
    $("contactWhatsApp") ? $("contactWhatsApp").value.trim() : "",
    $("contactInstagram") ? $("contactInstagram").value.trim() : "",
    $("contactTelegram") ? $("contactTelegram").value.trim() : "",
    $("contactSnapchat") ? $("contactSnapchat").value.trim() : ""
  ];

  if(!contactValues.some(Boolean)){
    showToast("Add at least one contact method: Phone, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram or Snapchat.");
    $("contactPhone").focus();
    return;
  }


  const button =
    document.querySelector(
      ".save-btn"
    );


  const oldText =
    button.textContent;


  button.disabled =
    true;

  button.textContent =
    "Saving...";


  try{

    const seller =
      await ensureSellerSession();


    let discount =
      0;


    if(
      original !== null &&
      original > 0 &&
      selling < original
    ){

      discount =
        (
          (original - selling) /
          original
        ) *
        100;

    }


    let photoUrls = [];
    if(selectedPhotos.length) photoUrls = await Promise.all(selectedPhotos.map(compressListingPhoto));

    const payload = {

      seller_id:
        Number(
          seller
        ),

      category:
        String(
          selectedCategory
        ),

      title:
        String(
          title || selectedCategory
        ),

      description:
        String(
          $("itemDescription")
            .value ||
          ""
        ),

      edition_model:
        String(
          $("editionModel")
            .value ||
          ""
        ),

      course:
        String(
          $("course")
            .value ||
          ""
        ),

      year:
        String(
          $("year")
            .value ||
          ""
        ),

      subject:
        String(
          $("subject")
            .value ||
          ""
        ),

      condition:
        String(
          selectedCondition ||
          ""
        ),

      original_price:
        original === null
        ?
        null
        :
        Number(
          original
        ),

      selling_price:
        Number(
          selling
        ),

      discount_percent:
        Number(
          discount.toFixed(
            2
          )
        ),

      is_negotiable:
        isNegotiable
        ?
        1
        :
        0,

      delivery_option:
        String(
          selectedDelivery ||
          ""
        ),

      location_text:
        String(
          $("locationText")
            .value ||
          "MRV Campus"
        ),

      phone: $("contactPhone") ? $("contactPhone").value.trim() : "",
      whatsapp: $("contactWhatsApp") ? $("contactWhatsApp").value.trim() : "",
      instagram: $("contactInstagram") ? $("contactInstagram").value.trim() : "",
      telegram: $("contactTelegram") ? $("contactTelegram").value.trim() : "",
      snapchat: $("contactSnapchat") ? $("contactSnapchat").value.trim() : "",
      photo_urls: photoUrls

    };


    const response =
      await fetch(
        API_BASE +
        "/api/items/create",
        {
          method:"POST",

          headers:{
            "Content-Type":
              "application/json"
          },

          body:
            JSON.stringify(
              payload
            )
        }
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Unable to save item."
      );

    }


    currentPaymentItemId =
      Number(
        data.item_id
      );


    localStorage.setItem(
      "med_exchange_pending_item_id",
      String(
        currentPaymentItemId
      )
    );


    closeSell();


    await openPaymentScreen(
      currentPaymentItemId
    );


  }catch(error){

    console.error(error);

    showToast(
      "❌ " +
      (
        error.message ||
        "Unable to save item."
      )
    );


  }finally{

    button.disabled =
      false;

    button.textContent =
      oldText;

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   PAYMENT SCREEN
============================================================ */

async function openPaymentScreen(itemId){

  const id =
    Number(itemId);


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(id) ||
    id <= 0
  ){

    showToast(
      "Invalid item."
    );

    return;

  }


  currentPaymentItemId =
    id;


  localStorage.setItem(
    "med_exchange_pending_item_id",
    String(id)
  );


  $("paymentScreen").style.display =
    "block";

  document.body.style.overflow =
    "hidden";


  $("paymentItemId").textContent =
    "Item ID: ME-" +
    id;


  $("paymentStatus").className =
    "payment-status";


  $("paymentStatus").textContent =
    "";


  $("paymentUpload")
    .classList.remove(
      "show"
    );


  $("paymentScreenshotPreview")
    .classList.remove(
      "show"
    );


  $("paymentScreenshotInput")
    .value =
    "";


  paymentScreenshotData =
    "";

  paymentConfirmed =
    false;


  $("paidButton").disabled =
    false;


  $("paidButton").textContent =
    "I HAVE PAID ₹10";


  try{

    const itemResponse =
      await fetch(
        API_BASE +
        "/api/items/" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          id
        )
      );


    const itemData =
      await itemResponse.json();


    if(
      itemData.ok &&
      itemData.item
    ){

      $("paymentItemTitle")
        .textContent =
          itemData.item.title ||
          "Your Item";

    }


  }catch(error){

    $("paymentItemTitle")
      .textContent =
        "Your Item";

  }


  await loadPaymentQr();

  await loadPaymentStatus(
    id
  );

}


function closePaymentScreen(){

  $("paymentScreen").style.display =
    "none";

  document.body.style.overflow =
    "";

}


/* ============================================================
   LOAD QR
============================================================ */

async function loadPaymentQr(){

  const image =
    $("paymentQr");

  /*
   * EXACT PhonePe QR image supplied by the app owner.
   * Embedded directly so the payment screen always shows this
   * original QR without generating, redrawing, or replacing it.
   */

  image.src =
    "data:image/jpeg;base64,";

  image.alt =
    "PhonePe Payment QR";

}

/* ============================================================
   PAYMENT STATUS
============================================================ */

async function loadPaymentStatus(itemId){

  if(
    !sellerId ||
    !Number.isInteger(
      Number(sellerId)
    )
  ){

    return;

  }


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        API_BASE +
        "/api/payment/status?item_id=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          itemId
        ) +
        "&seller_id=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          sellerId
        )
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      return;

    }


    const status =
      String(
        data.payment_status ||
        ""
      );


    if(status === "VERIFIED"){

      paymentConfirmed =
        true;

      $("paidButton").disabled =
        true;

      $("paidButton").textContent =
        "✓ Payment Verified";


      showPaymentStatus(
        "success",
        "✓ Your ₹10 payment has been verified. Your item is now waiting for admin approval."
      );


      $("paymentUpload")
        .classList.remove(
          "show"
        );


      localStorage.removeItem(
        "med_exchange_pending_item_id"
      );


      return;

    }


    if(status === "SUBMITTED"){

      paymentConfirmed =
        true;

      $("paidButton").disabled =
        true;

      $("paidButton").textContent =
        "✓ Payment Submitted";


      showPaymentStatus(
        "warning",
        "⏳ Your payment screenshot has been submitted. Please wait for admin verification."
      );


      return;

    }


    if(status === "REJECTED"){

      paymentConfirmed =
        true;

      $("paidButton").disabled =
        false;

      $("paidButton").textContent =
        "I HAVE PAID ₹10 — RESUBMIT";


      $("paymentUpload")
        .classList.add(
          "show"
        );


      showPaymentStatus(
        "error",
        "❌ Your previous payment submission was rejected." +
        (
          data.admin_note
          ?
          " Admin note: " +
          data.admin_note
          :
          ""
        ) +
        " Please upload a new screenshot."
      );


      return;

    }


    if(status === "PENDING"){

      showPaymentStatus(
        "warning",
        "Your item is ready for the ₹10 payment."
      );

    }


  }catch(error){

    console.error(error);

  }

}


function showPaymentStatus(
  type,
  message
){

  const box =
    $("paymentStatus");


  box.className =
    "payment-status show " +
    (
      type ||
      ""
    );


  box.textContent =
    message;

}


/* ============================================================
   PAYMENT CONFIRMATION
============================================================ */

function confirmPaymentMade(){

  paymentConfirmed =
    true;


  $("paymentUpload")
    .classList.add(
      "show"
    );


  $("paidButton").disabled =
    true;


  $("paidButton").textContent =
    "✓ Payment Confirmed";


  showPaymentStatus(
    "warning",
    "Now upload your PhonePe payment screenshot and submit it for verification."
  );


  $("paymentUpload")
    .scrollIntoView({
      behavior:"smooth",
      block:"start"
    });

}


/* ============================================================
   COMPRESS PAYMENT SCREENSHOT
============================================================ */

function compressPaymentScreenshot(
  file
){

  return new Promise(
    function(resolve,reject){

      if(
        !file ||
        !file.type ||
        !file.type.startsWith(
          "image/"
        )
      ){

        reject(
          new Error(
            "Please select an image screenshot."
          )
        );

        return;

      }


      const reader =
        new FileReader();


      reader.onerror =
        function(){

          reject(
            new Error(
              "Unable to read screenshot."
            )
          );

        };


      reader.onload =
        function(){

          const img =
            new Image();


          img.onload =
            function(){

              const maxDimension =
                1100;


              let width =
                img.naturalWidth;


              let height =
                img.naturalHeight;


              if(
                width > maxDimension ||
                height > maxDimension
              ){

                const scale =
                  Math.min(
                    maxDimension / width,
                    maxDimension / height
                  );

                width =
                  Math.round(
                    width * scale
                  );

                height =
                  Math.round(
                    height * scale
                  );

              }


              const canvas =
                document.createElement(
                  "canvas"
                );


              canvas.width =
                width;

              canvas.height =
                height;


              const ctx =
                canvas.getContext(
                  "2d"
                );


              if(!ctx){

                reject(
                  new Error(
                    "Image compression is unavailable."
                  )
                );

                return;

              }


              ctx.fillStyle =
                "#ffffff";

              ctx.fillRect(
                0,
                0,
                width,
                height
              );


              ctx.drawImage(
                img,
                0,
                0,
                width,
                height
              );


              let dataUrl =
                canvas.toDataURL(
                  "image/jpeg",
                  .72
                );


              /*
               * Keep the D1 TEXT payload bounded.
               */

              if(
                dataUrl.length >
                900000
              ){

                dataUrl =
                  canvas.toDataURL(
                    "image/jpeg",
                    .58
                  );

              }


              if(
                dataUrl.length >
                900000
              ){

                reject(
                  new Error(
                    "Screenshot is too large. Please use a smaller screenshot."
                  )
                );

                return;

              }


              resolve({
                dataUrl:dataUrl,
                mime:"image/jpeg"
              });

            };


          img.onerror =
            function(){

              reject(
                new Error(
                  "Unable to decode screenshot."
                )
              );

            };


          img.src =
            reader.result;

        };


      reader.readAsDataURL(
        file
      );

    }
  );

}


/* ============================================================
   PAYMENT SCREENSHOT
============================================================ */

async function handlePaymentScreenshot(
  event
){

  const file =
    event.target.files &&
    event.target.files[0];


  if(!file){

    return;

  }


  try{

    showPaymentStatus(
      "warning",
      "Compressing screenshot..."
    );


    const result =
      await compressPaymentScreenshot(
        file
      );


    paymentScreenshotData =
      result.dataUrl;

    paymentScreenshotMime =
      result.mime;


    $("paymentScreenshotImage")
      .src =
        paymentScreenshotData;


    $("paymentScreenshotPreview")
      .classList.add(
        "show"
      );


    showPaymentStatus(
      "",
      "Screenshot ready. Tap Submit Payment for Verification."
    );


  }catch(error){

    paymentScreenshotData =
      "";


    $("paymentScreenshotPreview")
      .classList.remove(
        "show"
      );


    showPaymentStatus(
      "error",
      error.message ||
      "Unable to process screenshot."
    );

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   SUBMIT PAYMENT SCREENSHOT
============================================================ */

async function submitPaymentScreenshot(){

  if(
    !paymentConfirmed
  ){

    showPaymentStatus(
      "error",
      "Please tap I HAVE PAID ₹10 first."
    );

    return;

  }


  if(
    !paymentScreenshotData
  ){

    showPaymentStatus(
      "error",
      "Please upload your payment screenshot."
    );

    return;

  }


  const button =
    $("submitPaymentButton");


  button.disabled =
    true;

  button.textContent =
    "Submitting...";


  try{

    const seller =
      await ensureSellerSession();


    const response =
      await fetch(
        API_BASE +
        "/api/payment/submit",
        {
          method:"POST",

          headers:{
            "Content-Type":
              "application/json"
          },

          body:
            JSON.stringify({

              item_id:
                Number(
                  currentPaymentItemId
                ),

              seller_id:
                Number(
                  seller
                ),

              amount:
                10,

              screenshot_data:
                paymentScreenshotData,

              screenshot_mime:
                paymentScreenshotMime

            })
        }
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Unable to submit payment."
      );

    }


    showPaymentStatus(
      "success",
      "✓ Payment submitted successfully. Your screenshot is now waiting for admin verification."
    );


    button.textContent =
      "✓ Payment Submitted";


    $("paidButton").disabled =
      true;


    $("paidButton").textContent =
      "✓ Payment Submitted";


    localStorage.setItem(
      "med_exchange_pending_item_id",
      String(
        currentPaymentItemId
      )
    );


    showToast(
      "✓ Payment submitted for verification."
    );


  }catch(error){

    console.error(error);


    showPaymentStatus(
      "error",
      error.message ||
      "Unable to submit payment."
    );


    button.disabled =
      false;

    button.textContent =
      "Submit Payment for Verification";

  }

}

function resetSellForm(){

  selectedCategory = "";
  selectedCondition = "";
  selectedDelivery = "";
  isNegotiable = false;
  selectedPhotos = [];
  bookCount = 1;
  bookEntries = [];


  [
    "itemTitle",
    "itemDescription",
    "editionModel",
    "subject",
    "originalPrice",
    "sellingPrice",
    "contactPhone",
    "contactWhatsApp",
    "contactInstagram",
    "contactTelegram",
    "contactSnapchat"
  ]
  .forEach(
    function(id){

      if($(id)){
        $(id).value = "";
      }

    }
  );


  if($("bookSetTitle")) $("bookSetTitle").value = "";
  if($("bookSetEditor")) $("bookSetEditor").innerHTML = "";
  if($("bookCountRow")) $("bookCountRow").innerHTML = "";
  if($("bookSetTotals")) $("bookSetTotals").innerHTML = "";
  $("course").value = "";
  $("year").value = "";
  $("locationText").value = "MRV Campus";


  [
    "catBooks",
    "catInstruments",
    "catAccessories",
    "catStudy",
    "catOther",
    "condLikeNew",
    "condGood",
    "condUsed",
    "deliveryPickup",
    "deliveryDelivery",
    "deliveryArrange"
  ]
  .forEach(
    function(id){

      $(id).classList.remove(
        "active"
      );

    }
  );


  $("negotiableToggle")
    .classList.remove(
      "active"
    );


  $("photoPreview")
    .innerHTML =
      "";


  $("discountText")
    .textContent =
      "";


  updatePreview();

}

/* ============================================================
   MRV CONFESSIONS — ROMANTIC GEN-Z AFTER-DARK THEME
   Visual-only layer. Does not change chat/backend functionality.
============================================================ */
body.confessions-mode{background:#090612;color:#f8f0fb;--a:#ff78bd;--b:#a978ff;--p:rgba(255,255,255,.055);--l:rgba(255,190,235,.13);--m:#a99bb2}
body.confessions-mode:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-3;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 8% 12%,rgba(255,86,170,.20),transparent 28%),radial-gradient(circle at 92% 22%,rgba(155,91,255,.18),transparent 30%),radial-gradient(circle at 52% 88%,rgba(255,65,145,.12),transparent 32%),linear-gradient(135deg,#090612 0%,#12091b 48%,#07050d 100%)}
body.confessions-mode:after{content:"✦  ·  ♡  ·  ✦  ·  ♡  ·  ✦";position:fixed;left:-12%;right:-12%;bottom:14%;z-index:-2;text-align:center;font-size:54px;letter-spacing:18px;color:rgba(255,129,201,.035);transform:rotate(-8deg);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
body.confessions-mode .top{background:linear-gradient(rgba(9,6,18,.96),rgba(9,6,18,.55),transparent);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,150,215,.07)}
body.confessions-mode .top:after{content:"MRV AFTER DARK  •  SAY WHAT YOU CAN'T SAY";position:absolute;left:51px;bottom:0;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1.25px;color:rgba(255,154,211,.58);font-weight:900}
body.confessions-mode .brand{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd1eb,#ff79bd 48%,#b58cff);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
body.confessions-mode .back,body.confessions-mode .icon{background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);border-color:rgba(255,160,220,.14);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.20)}
body.confessions-mode #root>.card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(30,13,38,.82),rgba(12,8,21,.86));border:1px solid rgba(255,145,211,.16);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 22px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.42),0 0 50px rgba(192,77,154,.06);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
body.confessions-mode #root>.card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(255,139,204,.07),transparent 38%,rgba(157,116,255,.05))}
body.confessions-mode .confessions-head{position:relative;padding:3px 2px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,173,220,.08)}
body.confessions-mode .confessions-title{font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff0f8,#ff8ec8 55%,#b99aff);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
body.confessions-mode .confessions-head .sub{color:#bca9bd}
body.confessions-mode .pill{background:rgba(255,103,181,.09);border-color:rgba(255,131,198,.25);color:#ffc3e4}
body.confessions-mode .notice{background:rgba(255,112,186,.045);border-color:rgba(255,146,207,.11);color:#aa9aac;border-radius:15px;margin-top:10px}
body.confessions-mode .confessions-list{padding:10px 5px 8px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,120,190,.045),transparent 34%)}
body.confessions-mode .confession{max-width:92%;margin:10px 0;padding:12px 14px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(255,168,218,.13);border-radius:19px 19px 19px 7px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.065),rgba(255,255,255,.025));box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.22);position:relative;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);transition:transform .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease,border-color .16s ease}
body.confessions-mode .confession:nth-child(even){margin-left:auto;border-radius:19px 19px 7px 19px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(183,113,255,.075),rgba(255,255,255,.025));border-color:rgba(185,145,255,.14)}
body.confessions-mode .confession:before{content:"ANON • MRV";display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1.25px;font-weight:950;color:#e9a8ca;opacity:.72}
body.confessions-mode .confession>b{display:none}
body.confessions-mode .confession small{color:#8f8197;margin-top:7px}
body.confessions-mode .conf-delete{color:#9f91a4}
body.confessions-mode .conf-delete:hover{color:#ff83b8}
body.confessions-mode .confess-compose{padding:7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,160,216,.13);border-radius:17px;background:rgba(12,7,20,.72);box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.28);backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
body.confessions-mode .confess-compose .input{border-color:rgba(255,170,220,.10);background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);color:#fff1fa}
body.confessions-mode .confess-compose .input:focus{border-color:rgba(255,121,190,.48);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,99,177,.08)}
body.confessions-mode .confess-compose .input::placeholder{color:#87778b}
body.confessions-mode .confess-send{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff72b7,#a879ff);color:#180b1c;box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(255,92,174,.18)}
@media(max-width:600px){body.confessions-mode .top:after{left:49px;font-size:6px;letter-spacing:1px}.confessions-mode .confession{max-width:94%}}

function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}function esc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]})}function stop(){if(pollTimer){clearInterval(pollTimer);pollTimer=null}if(msgTimer){clearInterval(msgTimer);msgTimer=null}}function getId(){try{return Number(localStorage.getItem('mrv_chat_profile_id')||0)||0}catch(e){return 0}}function setId(v){try{localStorage.setItem('mrv_chat_profile_id',String(v))}catch(e){}}function prefs(){try{var x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mrv_chat_stage3')||'{}');theme=x.theme||'night';wall=x.wall||'moon';blocked=x.blocked||{};matchPreference=['OPPOSITE','SAME','ANY'].indexOf(x.matchPreference)>=0?x.matchPreference:'OPPOSITE'}catch(e){}}function savePrefs(){try{localStorage.setItem('mrv_chat_stage3',JSON.stringify({theme:theme,wall:wall,blocked:blocked,matchPreference:matchPreference}))}catch(e){}}function apply(){document.body.classList.toggle('day',theme==='day');document.body.classList.remove('stars','aurora');if(wall==='stars')document.body.classList.add('stars');if(wall==='aurora')document.body.classList.add('aurora');$('theme').textContent=theme==='day'?'☀':'☾'}
async function api(path,opt){opt=opt||{};var c=typeof AbortController!=='undefined'?new AbortController():null,t=null;if(c){opt.signal=c.signal;t=setTimeout(function(){try{c.abort()}catch(e){}},10000)}try{var r=await fetch(path,opt),d;try{d=await r.json()}catch(e){throw Error('Invalid server response.')}if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Request failed.');return d}catch(e){if(e.name==='AbortError')throw Error('Server timeout. Please try again.');throw e}finally{if(t)clearTimeout(t)}}

function wallVibeKey(v){return String(v||'OCEAN').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]+/g,'-').toLowerCase()}function wallVibeInfo(v){return ({OCEAN:['🌊','Ocean','☕ CAMPUS LIFE'],AFTER_DARK:['🌙','After Dark','👀 LATE NIGHT'],DREAM:['💜','Dream','💭 JUST THINKING'],ENERGY:['⚡','Energy','🔥 ENERGY'],SOFT:['🌸','Soft','🫶 WHOLESOME'],PARTY:['🪩','Party','😂 WEEKEND'],ICE:['🧊','Ice','🧊 CHILL'],GALAXY:['🌌','Galaxy','✨ VIBE']})[String(v||'OCEAN').toUpperCase()]||['🌊','Ocean','✨ VIBE']}function wallRender(posts){
 var el=$('wallFeed');if(!el)return;if(!posts.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="wall-empty">Nothing here yet 👀<br><span class="sub">Be the first to start the conversation.</span></div>';return}
 var h='';posts.forEach(function(p){var mine=Number(p.profile_id)===Number(profileId),vi=wallVibeInfo(p.vibe),vk=wallVibeKey(p.vibe);h+='<article class="wall-card vibe-'+vk+'"><div class="wall-meta"><div class="wall-avatar">'+esc(p.avatar||'🕶️')+'</div><div><div class="wall-name">'+esc(p.username||'Anonymous student')+'</div><div>'+esc(wallTime(p.created_at))+'</div></div><div class="wall-type">'+wallLabel(p.post_type)+'</div></div><div class="wall-vibe-row"><span class="wall-vibe">'+vi[0]+' '+esc(vi[1])+'</span><span class="wall-sticker">'+vi[2]+'</span></div><div class="wall-body">'+esc(p.body)+'</div>';
 if(p.post_type==='HOT_TAKE'){var total=(p.votes||[]).reduce(function(a,v){return a+Number(v.count||0)},0),a=((p.votes||[]).find(function(v){return v.vote_key==='AGREE'})||{}).count||0,d=((p.votes||[]).find(function(v){return v.vote_key==='DISAGREE'})||{}).count||0;h+='<div class="vote-row"><button class="vote-btn '+(p.my_vote==='AGREE'?'active':'')+'" data-wall-vote="'+p.id+'" data-vote-key="AGREE">🔥 '+esc(p.hot_take_agree||'Agree')+' '+(total?Math.round(Number(a)*100/total):0)+'%</button><button class="vote-btn '+(p.my_vote==='DISAGREE'?'active':'')+'" data-wall-vote="'+p.id+'" data-vote-key="DISAGREE">💀 '+esc(p.hot_take_disagree||'Disagree')+' '+(total?Math.round(Number(d)*100/total):0)+'%</button></div><div class="tiny">'+total+' vote'+(total===1?'':'s')+'</div>'}
 if(p.post_type==='POLL'){var total=Number(p.vote_count||0);(p.options||[]).forEach(function(o){var pct=total?Math.round(Number(o.vote_count||0)*100/total):0;h+='<button class="poll-option '+(String(p.my_vote)===String(o.id)?'active':'')+'" data-wall-vote="'+p.id+'" data-vote-key="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.option_text)+' <span style="float:right">'+pct+'%</span><div class="poll-bar"><div class="poll-fill" style="--pct:'+pct+'%"></div></div></button>'});h+='<div class="tiny">'+total+' vote'+(total===1?'':'s')+'</div>'}
 h+='<div class="wall-actions">';(p.reactions||[]).forEach(function(x){var on=(p.my_reactions||[]).indexOf(x.reaction)>=0;h+='<button class="wall-action '+(on?'active':'')+'" data-wall-react="'+p.id+'" data-reaction="'+esc(x.reaction)+'">'+esc(x.reaction)+' '+Number(x.count||0)+'</button>'});h+='<button class="wall-action" data-wall-react="'+p.id+'" data-reaction="👀">👀</button><button class="wall-action" data-wall-react="'+p.id+'" data-reaction="😂">😂</button><button class="wall-action" data-wall-react="'+p.id+'" data-reaction="💀">💀</button><button class="wall-action" data-wall-comments="'+p.id+'">💬 '+Number(p.comment_count||0)+'</button></div><div class="wall-tools">'+(mine?'<button class="wall-tool" data-wall-delete="'+p.id+'">Delete</button>':'')+'<button class="wall-tool" data-wall-report="'+p.id+'">Report</button></div><div id="wallComments'+p.id+'"></div></article>'});el.innerHTML=h;
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-wall-react]').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=async function(){try{await api('/api/chat/wall/react',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId,post_id:Number(b.getAttribute('data-wall-react')),reaction:b.getAttribute('data-reaction')})});wallLoad(wallType)}catch(e){toast(e.message)}}});
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-wall-vote]').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=async function(){try{await api('/api/chat/wall/vote',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId,post_id:Number(b.getAttribute('data-wall-vote')),vote_key:String(b.getAttribute('data-vote-key'))})});wallLoad(wallType)}catch(e){toast(e.message)}}});

 document.querySelectorAll('[data-wall-report]').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=async function(){try{await api('/api/chat/wall/report',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId,target_type:'POST',target_id:Number(b.getAttribute('data-wall-report')),reason:'User report'})});toast('Reported. Thank you.')}catch(e){toast(e.message)}}});
}
async function wallComments(postId){var box=$('wallComments'+postId);if(!box)return;if(wallCommentsOpen===postId){box.innerHTML='';wallCommentsOpen=0;return}wallCommentsOpen=postId;box.innerHTML='<div class="wall-loading">Loading comments…</div>';try{var d=await api('/api/chat/wall/comments?post_id='+postId),h='<div class="wall-comments">';(d.comments||[]).forEach(function(c){h+='<div class="wall-comment"><b>'+esc(c.avatar||'🕶️')+' '+esc(c.username||'Anonymous')+'</b><br>'+esc(c.body)+(Number(c.profile_id)===Number(profileId)?'<br><button class="wall-tool" data-wall-comment-delete="'+c.id+'">Delete</button>':'')+'</div>'});h+='<div class="compose-wall"><textarea id="wallCommentText'+postId+'" class="input" maxlength="300" placeholder="Add an anonymous comment…"></textarea><button class="primary" id="wallCommentSend'+postId+'">POST COMMENT</button></div></div>';box.innerHTML=h;$('wallCommentSend'+postId).onclick=async function(){var text=($('wallCommentText'+postId).value||'').trim();if(!text)return;try{await api('/api/chat/wall/comments',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId,post_id:postId,body:text})});wallCommentsOpen=0;wallLoad(wallType);setTimeout(function(){wallComments(postId)},150)}catch(e){toast(e.message)}};document.querySelectorAll('[data-wall-comment-delete]').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=async function(){try{await api('/api/chat/wall/comments/delete',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId,comment_id:Number(b.getAttribute('data-wall-comment-delete'))})});wallComments(postId)}catch(e){toast(e.message)}}})}catch(e){box.innerHTML='<div class="status">'+esc(e.message)+'</div>'}}
function wallComposer(){var r=$('root');stop();r.innerHTML='<div class="wall-head"><div class="eyebrow">ANONYMOUS POST</div><div class="wall-title">Post to Campus Wall</div><div class="wall-sub">Your real identity stays private.</div></div><div class="post-chooser" id="wallChoices"><button class="post-choice" data-post-type="TEA">☕ Spill Tea<span>Campus stories, moments and conversations.</span></button><button class="post-choice" data-post-type="CRUSH">💌 Crush Post<span>Say it anonymously and respectfully.</span></button><button class="post-choice" data-post-type="HOT_TAKE">🔥 Hot Take<span>Let the campus vote Agree or Disagree.</span></button><button class="post-choice" data-post-type="POLL">🗳️ Create Poll<span>Ask a question with 2–4 options.</span></button></div><button class="secondary" id="backWall">← BACK TO WALL</button>';$('backWall').onclick=function(){wallLoad(wallType)};document.querySelectorAll('[data-post-type]').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){wallPostForm(b.getAttribute('data-post-type'))}})}
function wallPostForm(type){var r=$('root'),extra='',vibe='OCEAN';if(type==='HOT_TAKE')extra='<label class="label">Agree button</label><input id="wallAgree" class="input" maxlength="40" value="Agree"><label class="label">Disagree button</label><input id="wallDisagree" class="input" maxlength="40" value="Disagree">';if(type==='POLL')extra='<label class="label">Poll options</label><input id="wallOpt1" class="input" maxlength="100" placeholder="Option 1"><input id="wallOpt2" class="input" maxlength="100" placeholder="Option 2"><input id="wallOpt3" class="input" maxlength="100" placeholder="Option 3 (optional)"><input id="wallOpt4" class="input" maxlength="100" placeholder="Option 4 (optional)">';var vibes=[['OCEAN','🌊 OCEAN'],['AFTER_DARK','🌙 AFTER DARK'],['DREAM','💜 DREAM'],['ENERGY','⚡ ENERGY'],['SOFT','🌸 SOFT'],['PARTY','🪩 PARTY'],['ICE','🧊 ICE'],['GALAXY','🌌 GALAXY']];var vh=vibes.map(function(x){return '<button type="button" class="vibe-choice '+(x[0]==='OCEAN'?'active':'')+'" data-vibe="'+x[0]+'">'+x[1]+'</button>'}).join('');r.innerHTML='<div class="card compose-wall"><div class="section">'+wallLabel(type)+'</div><div class="sub">Posting anonymously to MRV Campus.</div><div class="vibe-help">CHOOSE YOUR VIBE • your post gets its own atmosphere ✦</div><div class="vibe-chooser" id="vibeChooser">'+vh+'</div><label class="label">'+(type==='POLL'?'Question':'Your post')+'</label><textarea id="wallBody" class="input" maxlength="600" placeholder="'+(type==='TEA'?'What happened? 👀':type==='CRUSH'?'Say it respectfully…':type==='HOT_TAKE'?'Drop your hottest campus opinion…':'Ask the campus…')+'"></textarea>'+extra+'<button id="wallPublish" class="primary">PUBLISH ANONYMOUSLY</button><button id="wallCancel" class="secondary">CANCEL</button></div>';document.querySelectorAll('[data-vibe]').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){vibe=b.getAttribute('data-vibe');document.querySelectorAll('[data-vibe]').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('active',x===b)})}});$('wallCancel').onclick=function(){wallComposer()};$('wallPublish').onclick=async function(){var body={profile_id:profileId,post_type:type,body:($('wallBody').value||'').trim(),vibe:vibe};if(type==='HOT_TAKE'){body.agree_label=($('wallAgree').value||'Agree').trim();body.disagree_label=($('wallDisagree').value||'Disagree').trim()}if(type==='POLL')body.options=[1,2,3,4].map(function(n){var x=$('wallOpt'+n);return x?(x.value||'').trim():''}).filter(Boolean);try{var b=$('wallPublish');b.disabled=true;b.textContent='PUBLISHING…';await api('/api/chat/wall/posts',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)});toast('Posted anonymously ✦');wallLoad(type)}catch(e){toast(e.message);var b=$('wallPublish');if(b){b.disabled=false;b.textContent='PUBLISH ANONYMOUSLY'}}}}

function openTruthOrDare(){
  stop();var r=$('root'), date=v10ClientDate(), seed=v10Hash(date+'td'), truths=['What’s something you secretly judge people for? 👀','What’s something you pretend not to care about? 💀','What makes someone instantly more interesting? 👀','What’s your most random unpopular opinion? 🔥'], dares=['Describe your current life using only 3 emojis. 😂','Write a one-line plot twist about your life. 🎬','Describe your crush using only weather. 🌦️','Write something mysterious and refuse to explain it. 👀'];
  function render(type){var arr=type==='truth'?truths:dares, i=(seed+Math.floor(Math.random()*999))%arr.length;r.innerHTML='<div class="v9-card"><div class="v9-kicker">🎭 '+type.toUpperCase()+'</div><div class="truth-card">'+esc(arr[i])+'</div><div class="truth-actions"><button id="again" class="ghost">SKIP 🔄</button><button id="share" class="primary">USE THIS 🔥</button></div></div>';$('again').onclick=function(){render(type)};$('share').onclick=function(){toast('Challenge accepted 😭🔥')}}render('truth');setTimeout(function(){var old=$('root').innerHTML;},0); 
  // Add type switch after first render.
  var originalRender=render;
}
function v10ClientDate(){var d=new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Asia/Kolkata'}));return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}
function v10Hash(s){var n=2166136261;for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){n^=s.charCodeAt(i);n=Math.imul(n,16777619)>>>0}return n}
async function openCampusChallenge(){
  stop();var r=$('root');r.innerHTML='<div class="wall-loading">Loading today’s challenge… 🔥</div>';
  try{var d=await api('/api/chat/v10/challenge');r.innerHTML='<div class="v9-card"><div class="v9-kicker">🔥 TODAY’S CAMPUS CHALLENGE</div><div class="v9-title">'+esc(d.challenge)+'</div><textarea id="challengeBody" class="input" maxlength="400" placeholder="Your anonymous response…"></textarea><button id="challengePost" class="primary">JOIN CHALLENGE 🔥</button></div><div class="v9-card"><div class="section">Campus responses 👀</div>' +(d.answers||[]).map(function(a){return '<div class="daily-answer"><div class="daily-answer-meta">'+esc(a.avatar||'🕶️')+' '+esc(a.username||'Anonymous student')+'</div><div>'+esc(a.body)+'</div></div>'}).join('')+'</div>';
    $('challengePost').onclick=async function(){try{await api('/api/chat/v10/challenge',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId,body:$('challengeBody').value})});toast('Challenge joined 🔥');openCampusChallenge()}catch(e){toast(e.message)}};
  }catch(e){r.innerHTML='<div class="notice">'+esc(e.message)+'</div>'}
}

  $('openMystery').onclick=async function(){try{var d=await api('/api/chat/v10/play?profile_id='+encodeURIComponent(profileId||''));r.innerHTML='<div class="mystery-box"><div class="mystery-big">👀</div><div class="v9-kicker">TODAY’S MYSTERY</div><div class="truth-card">'+esc(d.content.mystery)+'</div><div class="v9-sub">Answer it in your head… or take the thought with you 😭</div></div>'}catch(e){toast(e.message)}}

async function playBored(){
  var r=$('root');r.innerHTML='<div class="bored-result">🎲 Spinning the campus…</div>';
  try{var d=await api('/api/chat/v10/bored'),x=d.result;setTimeout(function(){if(x.type==='daily')openDailyQuestion();else if(x.type==='after_dark')openAfterDark();else if(x.type==='this_or_that')openThisOrThat();else if(x.type==='truth_or_dare')openTruthOrDare();else if(x.type==='challenge')openCampusChallenge();else if(x.type==='mystery')openDailyMystery();else if(x.type==='wall'){setTab('wall');}else openCampusPlay()},500)}catch(e){toast(e.message);openCampusPlay()}
}

async function refresh(){if(!chatId)return;try{var box=$('msgs'),near=!box||box.scrollHeight-box.scrollTop-box.clientHeight<90;var d=await api('/api/chat/messages?profile_id='+profileId+'&chat_id='+chatId),a=d.messages||[];var changed=a.length!==lastCount;if(a.length>lastCount&&tab!=='chats')unread+=a.length-lastCount;lastCount=a.length;unreadUI();if(tab==='chats'&&changed){renderMessageList(a);if(!near){var nb=$('msgs');if(nb)nb.scrollTop=nb.scrollHeight}status()}else status()}catch(e){stop()}}async function deleteChatMessage(mid){if(!mid)return;if(!confirm('Delete this message?'))return;try{await api('/api/chat/message/delete',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId,message_id:Number(mid)})});await messages()}catch(e){alert(e.message||'Unable to delete message.')}}async function send(){var i=$('m'),m=(i.value||'').trim();if(!m)return;var keepKeyboard=document.activeElement===i;clearTimeout(typingTimer);typingBusy=false;try{await api('/api/chat/send',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId,chat_id:chatId,message:m})});i.value='';localStorage.removeItem('mrv_chat_draft_'+chatId);typing(false);await messages();if(keepKeyboard){setTimeout(function(){var ni=$('m');if(ni){ni.focus({preventScroll:true});}},60)}}catch(e){alert(e.message)}}async function end(){var cid=chatId;stop();chatId=0;if(cid)try{await api('/api/chat/end',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId,chat_id:cid})})}catch(e){}setTab('chats')}async function next(){await end();find()}async function del(){if(!confirm('Delete your Chit-Chat profile? Your Med Exchange account and listings stay untouched.'))return;try{await api('/api/chat/profile/delete',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({profile_id:profileId})});localStorage.removeItem('mrv_chat_profile_id');localStorage.removeItem('mrv_chat_profile_cache');profileId=0;chatId=0;setTab('home')}catch(e){alert(e.message)}}
document.querySelectorAll('.navbtn').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();setTab(b.getAttribute('data-tab'))})});$('theme').onclick=function(){theme=theme==='day'?'night':'day';savePrefs();apply()};prefs();profileId=getId();try{var cachedProfile=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mrv_chat_profile_cache')||'null');if(cachedProfile&&Number(cachedProfile.id)===Number(profileId)){gender=String(cachedProfile.gender||'PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY').toUpperCase()}}catch(e){}apply();async function bootChat(){if(profileId){setTab('home');startCampusPresence();try{var d=await api('/api/chat/profile?profile_id='+profileId);if(d.profile){gender=String(d.profile.gender||gender||'PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY').toUpperCase();try{localStorage.setItem('mrv_chat_profile_cache',JSON.stringify({id:profileId,username:d.profile.username||'',college:d.profile.college||'',gender:gender,hide_profile:Number(d.profile.hide_profile||0)===1}))}catch(x){}}}catch(e){/* Keep the saved local profile. A temporary API/network failure must not force profile creation again. */}return}setTab('home')}bootChat();
})();</script></body></html>`;

const ADMIN_PAGE = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

body{

.status{

  display:block;
}

.status.error{
  color:#ffaaaa;

}

.item{

.item-title{

}

.item-meta{
  color:#8c9bad;

}

.screenshot{
  width:100%;

  object-fit:contain;

}

.note{
  color:#aab7c6;

}

.badge{
  display:inline-block;

  border-radius:999px;

.hidden{

@media(max-width:600px){
