  }
}

</style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="page">

  <div class="header">

    <div>

      <div class="brand">
        Med <span>Exchange</span>
      </div>

      <div class="sub">
        MRV Admin Dashboard
      </div>

    </div>

    <button
      class="btn secondary"
      onclick="window.location.href='/'">
      ← Marketplace
    </button>

  </div>


  <div
    id="loginCard"
    class="card">

    <div class="section-title">
      Admin Login
    </div>

    <label class="label">
      ADMIN_SECRET
    </label>

    <input
      id="adminSecret"
      class="input"
      type="password"
      placeholder="Enter Worker ADMIN_SECRET">

    <div class="actions">

      <button
        id="loginButton"
        class="btn"
        onclick="login()">
        Open Dashboard
      </button>

    </div>

    <div class="note">
      The secret is stored only in this browser session and is never embedded in the Worker page.
    </div>

    <div
      id="loginStatus"
      class="status">
    </div>

  </div>


  <div
    id="dashboard"
    class="hidden">


    <!-- ======================================================
         PAYMENT VERIFICATION
    ====================================================== -->

    <div class="card">

      <div class="section-title">
        💳 Payment Verification
      </div>

      <div
        id="payments">
        <div class="note">
          Load pending payments.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="actions">

        <button
          class="btn"
          onclick="loadPayments()">
          Refresh Payments
        </button>

      </div>

    </div>


    <!-- ======================================================
         ITEM APPROVAL
    ====================================================== -->

    <div class="card">

      <div class="section-title">
        ✅ Item Approval
      </div>

      <div
        id="items">
        <div class="note">
          Load pending item approvals.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="actions">

        <button
          class="btn"
          onclick="loadApprovalItems()">
          Refresh Pending
        </button>

        <button
          class="btn secondary"
          onclick="loadPublishedItems()">
          🗂 Manage Published
        </button>

      </div>

    </div>


    <div class="card">

      <div class="section-title">
        🕶️ MRV Confessions
      </div>

      <div
        id="adminConfessions">
        <div class="note">Load campus confessions.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="actions">
        <button
          class="btn"
          onclick="loadAdminConfessions()">
          Refresh Confessions
        </button>
      </div>

    </div>


    <div class="card">

      <div class="section-title">
        🔐 Admin Session
      </div>

      <button
        class="btn danger"
        onclick="logout()">
        Log Out
      </button>

    </div>

  </div>

</div>


<script>

let adminSecret =
  sessionStorage.getItem(
    "med_exchange_admin_secret"
  ) || "";


/* ============================================================
   HELPERS
============================================================ */

function $(id){
  return document.getElementById(id);
}


function escapeHtml(value){

  return String(
    value == null
    ?
    ""
    :
    value
  )
  .replace(/&/g,"&amp;")
  .replace(/</g,"&lt;")
  .replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
  .replace(/"/g,"&quot;")
  .replace(/'/g,"&#039;");

}


function money(value){

  const n =
    Number(
      value || 0
    );

  return "₹" +
    n.toLocaleString(
      "en-IN",
      {
        maximumFractionDigits:2
      }
    );

}


function authHeaders(){

  return {

    "Content-Type":
      "application/json",

    "Authorization":
      "Bearer " +
      adminSecret

  };

}


function showStatus(
  id,
  message,
  type
){

  const box =
    $(id);

  box.textContent =
    message;

  box.className =
    "status show " +
    (
      type ||
      ""
    );

}


/* ============================================================
   LOGIN
============================================================ */

async function login(){

  const secret =
    $("adminSecret")
      .value
      .trim();


  if(!secret){

    showStatus(
      "loginStatus",
      "Enter ADMIN_SECRET.",
      "error"
    );

    return;

  }


  const button =
    $("loginButton");

  if(button){
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent =
      "Checking...";
  }


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/api/admin/auth",
        {
          method:"GET",
          headers:{
            "Authorization":
              "Bearer " +
              secret
          },
          cache:"no-store"
        }
      );


    let data =
      {};

    try{
      data =
        await response.json();
    }catch(error){
      data = {};
    }


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Invalid ADMIN_SECRET."
      );

    }


    adminSecret =
      secret;


    sessionStorage.setItem(
      "med_exchange_admin_secret",
      adminSecret
    );


    $("loginCard")
      .classList.add(
        "hidden"
      );


    $("dashboard")
      .classList.remove(
        "hidden"
      );


    await Promise.all([
      loadPayments(),
      loadApprovalItems(),
      loadAdminConfessions()
    ]);


  }catch(error){

    adminSecret = "";

    sessionStorage.removeItem(
      "med_exchange_admin_secret"
    );

    $("loginCard")
      .classList.remove(
        "hidden"
      );

    $("dashboard")
      .classList.add(
        "hidden"
      );

    showStatus(
      "loginStatus",
      error.message ||
        "Invalid ADMIN_SECRET.",
      "error"
    );

  }finally{

    if(button){
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent =
        "Open Dashboard";
    }

  }

}


async function loadAdminConfessions(){
  $("adminConfessions").innerHTML='<div class="note">Loading confessions...</div>';
  try{
    const r=await fetch('/api/admin/chat/confessions',{headers:authHeaders()});
    const d=await r.json();
    if(r.status===401||r.status===403){logout();return;}
    if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Unable to load confessions.');
    const a=d.confessions||[];
    $("adminConfessions").innerHTML=a.length?a.map(x=>'<div class="item"><span class="badge">ANONYMOUS</span><div class="item-meta" style="margin-top:8px">'+escapeHtml(x.message)+'</div><div class="item-meta">'+escapeHtml(x.created_at||'')+' • ID '+Number(x.id)+'</div><div class="actions"><button class="btn danger" onclick="adminDeleteConfession('+Number(x.id)+')">🗑 Delete Confession</button></div></div>').join(''):'<div class="note">No confessions.</div>';
  }catch(e){$("adminConfessions").innerHTML='<div class="note" style="color:#ffaaaa">'+escapeHtml(e.message||'Unable to load confessions.')+'</div>';}
}

async function adminDeleteConfession(confessionId){
  if(!confirm('Delete this confession permanently?'))return;
  try{
    const r=await fetch('/api/admin/chat/confessions/'+Number(confessionId)+'/delete',{method:'DELETE',headers:authHeaders()});
    const d=await r.json();
    if(r.status===401||r.status===403){logout();return;}
    if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Unable to delete confession.');
    loadAdminConfessions();
  }catch(e){alert(e.message||'Unable to delete confession.');}
}

function logout(){

  sessionStorage.removeItem(
    "med_exchange_admin_secret"
  );

  adminSecret =
    "";

  window.location.reload();

}


/* ============================================================
   PAYMENT LIST
============================================================ */

async function loadPayments(){

  $("payments").innerHTML =
    '<div class="note">Loading...</div>';


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/api/admin/payments?status=PENDING",
        {
          headers:
            authHeaders()
        }
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(
      response.status === 401 ||
      response.status === 403
    ){

      logout();
      return;

    }


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Unable to load payments."
      );

    }


    const payments =
      data.payments ||
      [];


    if(!payments.length){

      $("payments").innerHTML =
        '<div class="note">🎉 No pending payment verifications.</div>';

      return;

    }


    $("payments").innerHTML =
      payments.map(
        function(payment){

          const screenshot =
            payment.screenshot_data
            ?
            '<img class="screenshot" src="' +
            escapeHtml(
              payment.screenshot_data
            ) +
            '" alt="Payment screenshot">'
            :
            '<div class="note">No screenshot attached.</div>';


          return (

            '<div class="item">' +

              '<div class="item-title">' +
                escapeHtml(
                  payment.item_title ||
                  "Untitled Item"
                ) +
              '</div>' +

              '<div class="item-meta">' +

                '<b>Item:</b> ME-' +
                Number(
                  payment.item_id
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Seller:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  payment.seller_name ||
                  "MRV Student"
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Seller ID:</b> ' +
                Number(
                  payment.seller_id
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Amount:</b> ' +
                money(
                  payment.amount
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Submitted:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  payment.created_at ||
                  ""
                ) +

              '</div>' +

              screenshot +

              '<div class="actions">' +

                '<button class="btn success" ' +
                'onclick="verifyPayment(' +
                Number(
                  payment.id
                ) +
                ')">' +
                '✓ Verify Payment' +
                '</button>' +

                '<button class="btn danger" ' +
                'onclick="rejectPayment(' +
                Number(
                  payment.id
                ) +
                ')">' +
                '✕ Reject Payment' +
                '</button>' +

              '</div>' +

            '</div>'

          );

        }
      )
      .join("");


  }catch(error){

    console.error(error);


    $("payments").innerHTML =
      '<div class="note" style="color:#ffaaaa;">' +
      escapeHtml(
        error.message ||
        "Unable to load payments."
      ) +
      '</div>';

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   VERIFY PAYMENT
============================================================ */

async function verifyPayment(
  paymentId
){

  if(
    !confirm(
      "Verify this ₹10 payment?"
    )
  ){

    return;

  }


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/api/admin/payments/" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          paymentId
        ) +
        "/verify",
        {
          method:"POST",
          headers:
            authHeaders(),
          body:
            JSON.stringify({})
        }
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(
      response.status === 401 ||
      response.status === 403
    ){

      logout();
      return;

    }


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Unable to verify payment."
      );

    }


    alert(
      "Payment verified. Item moved to pending approval."
    );


    loadPayments();
    loadApprovalItems();


  }catch(error){

    alert(
      error.message ||
      "Unable to verify payment."
    );

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   REJECT PAYMENT
============================================================ */

async function rejectPayment(
  paymentId
){

  const note =
    prompt(
      "Reason for rejection (optional):",
      ""
    );


  if(note === null){

    return;

  }


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/api/admin/payments/" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          paymentId
        ) +
        "/reject",
        {
          method:"POST",
          headers:
            authHeaders(),
          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              admin_note:
                note
            })
        }
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(
      response.status === 401 ||
      response.status === 403
    ){

      logout();
      return;

    }


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Unable to reject payment."
      );

    }


    alert(
      "Payment rejected."
    );


    loadPayments();


  }catch(error){

    alert(
      error.message ||
      "Unable to reject payment."
    );

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   PENDING ITEM APPROVALS
============================================================ */

async function loadApprovalItems(){

  $("items").innerHTML =
    '<div class="note">Loading...</div>';


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/api/admin/items?status=PENDING_APPROVAL",
        {
          headers:
            authHeaders()
        }
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(
      response.status === 401 ||
      response.status === 403
    ){

      logout();
      return;

    }


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Unable to load items."
      );

    }


    const items =
      data.items ||
      [];


    if(!items.length){

      $("items").innerHTML =
        '<div class="note">🎉 No items waiting for approval.</div>';

      return;

    }


    $("items").innerHTML =
      items.map(
        function(item){

          const discount =
            Number(
              item.discount_percent ||
              0
            );


          return (

            '<div class="item">' +

              '<span class="badge">' +
              'PAYMENT VERIFIED' +
              '</span>' +

              '<div style="margin-top:8px;" class="item-title">' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.title ||
                  "Untitled Item"
                ) +
              '</div>' +

              '<div class="item-meta">' +

                '<b>Item:</b> ME-' +
                Number(
                  item.id
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Seller:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.seller_name ||
                  "MRV Student"
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Category:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.category ||
                  ""
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Course:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.course ||
                  ""
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Year:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.year ||
                  ""
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Subject:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.subject ||
                  ""
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Price:</b> ' +
                money(
                  item.selling_price
                ) +

                (
                  discount > 0
                  ?
                  ' • ' +
                  Math.round(
                    discount
                  ) +
                  '% OFF'
                  :
                  ""
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Condition:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.condition ||
                  ""
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Location:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.location_text ||
                  "MRV Campus"
                ) +

                '<br>' +

                '<b>Delivery:</b> ' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.delivery_option ||
                  ""
                ) +

              '</div>' +

              (
                item.description
                ?
                '<div class="note">' +
                escapeHtml(
                  item.description
                ) +
                '</div>'
                :
                ""
              ) +

              '<div class="actions">' +

                '<button class="btn success" ' +
                'onclick="approveItem(' +
                Number(
                  item.id
                ) +
                ')">' +
                '✓ Approve Item' +
                '</button>' +

                '<button class="btn danger" ' +
                'onclick="rejectItem(' +
                Number(
                  item.id
                ) +
                ')">' +
                '✕ Reject Item' +
                '</button>' +

                '<button class="btn danger" onclick="deleteItem(' + Number(item.id) + ')">' +
                '🗑 Delete' +
                '</button>' +

              '</div>' +

            '</div>'

          );

        }
      )
      .join("");


  }catch(error){

    console.error(error);


    $("items").innerHTML =
      '<div class="note" style="color:#ffaaaa;">' +
      escapeHtml(
        error.message ||
        "Unable to load items."
      ) +
      '</div>';

  }

}


async function loadPublishedItems(){
  $("items").innerHTML='<div class="note">Loading published listings...</div>';
  try{const r=await fetch('/api/admin/items?status=APPROVED',{headers:authHeaders()});const d=await r.json();if(r.status===401||r.status===403){logout();return;}if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Unable to load listings.');const a=d.items||[];$('items').innerHTML=a.length?a.map(x=>'<div class="item"><span class="badge">PUBLISHED</span><div style="margin-top:8px" class="item-title">'+escapeHtml(x.title||'Untitled')+'</div><div class="item-meta">ME-'+x.id+' • '+escapeHtml(x.category||'')+' • '+money(x.selling_price)+'<br>Seller: '+escapeHtml(x.seller_name||'MRV Student')+'</div><div class="actions"><button class="btn danger" onclick="deleteItem('+x.id+')">🗑 Delete Listing</button></div></div>').join(''):'<div class="note">No published listings.</div>';}catch(e){$('items').innerHTML='<div class="note" style="color:#ffaaaa">'+escapeHtml(e.message)+'</div>';}}

async function deleteItem(itemId){if(!confirm('Delete this listing permanently?'))return;try{const r=await fetch('/api/admin/items/'+itemId+'/delete',{method:'DELETE',headers:authHeaders()});const d=await r.json();if(r.status===401||r.status===403){logout();return;}if(!r.ok||!d.ok)throw Error(d.error||'Unable to delete.');alert('Listing deleted.');loadApprovalItems();}catch(e){alert(e.message||'Unable to delete listing.');}}

/* ============================================================
   APPROVE ITEM
============================================================ */

async function approveItem(
  itemId
){

  if(
    !confirm(
      "Approve this item and publish it to Med Exchange?"
    )
  ){

    return;

  }


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/api/admin/items/" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          itemId
        ) +
        "/approve",
        {
          method:"POST",
          headers:
            authHeaders(),
          body:
            JSON.stringify({})
        }
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(
      response.status === 401 ||
      response.status === 403
    ){

      logout();
      return;

    }


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Unable to approve item."
      );

    }


    alert(
      "✓ Item approved and published."
    );


    loadApprovalItems();


  }catch(error){

    alert(
      error.message ||
      "Unable to approve item."
    );

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   REJECT ITEM
============================================================ */

async function rejectItem(
  itemId
){

  const note =
    prompt(
      "Reason for item rejection (optional):",
      ""
    );


  if(note === null){

    return;

  }


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/api/admin/items/" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          itemId
        ) +
        "/reject",
        {
          method:"POST",
          headers:
            authHeaders(),
          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              admin_note:
                note
            })
        }
      );


    const data =
      await response.json();


    if(
      response.status === 401 ||
      response.status === 403
    ){

      logout();
      return;

    }


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Unable to reject item."
      );

    }


    alert(
      "Item rejected."
    );


    loadApprovalItems();


  }catch(error){

    alert(
      error.message ||
      "Unable to reject item."
    );

  }

}


/* ============================================================
   AUTO LOGIN FROM SESSION
============================================================ */

async function restoreAdminSession(){

  if(!adminSecret){
    return;
  }


  const savedSecret =
    adminSecret;


  try{

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/api/admin/auth",
        {
          method:"GET",
          headers:{
            "Authorization":
              "Bearer " +
              savedSecret
          },
          cache:"no-store"
        }
      );


    let data =
      {};

    try{
      data =
        await response.json();
    }catch(error){
      data = {};
    }


    if(
      !response.ok ||
      !data.ok
    ){

      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Admin session expired."
      );

    }


    $("adminSecret").value =
      savedSecret;

    $("loginCard")
      .classList.add(
        "hidden"
      );

    $("dashboard")
      .classList.remove(
        "hidden"
      );


    await Promise.all([
      loadPayments(),
      loadApprovalItems()
    ]);


  }catch(error){

    adminSecret = "";

    sessionStorage.removeItem(
      "med_exchange_admin_secret"
    );

    $("adminSecret").value =
      "";

    $("loginCard")
      .classList.remove(
        "hidden"
      );

    $("dashboard")
      .classList.add(
        "hidden"
      );

    showStatus(
      "loginStatus",
      "Admin session expired. Please enter ADMIN_SECRET again.",
      "error"
    );

  }

}


restoreAdminSession();

</script>
