/* ============================================================
   CORS
============================================================ */

function corsHeaders(){

  return {

    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin":
      "*",

    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods":
      "GET,POST,OPTIONS",

    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers":
      "Content-Type, Authorization"

  };

}


/* ============================================================
   JSON RESPONSE
============================================================ */

function json(
  data,
  status
){

  return new Response(

    JSON.stringify(
      data
    ),

    {
      status:
        status ||
        200,

      headers:{
        "Content-Type":
          "application/json; charset=UTF-8",

        ...corsHeaders()
      }

    }

  );

}


/* ============================================================
   GET MRV COLLEGE
============================================================ */

async function getMRVCollege(db){

  return await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  short_name
FROM med_exchange_colleges
WHERE short_name = ?
LIMIT 1
`
  )
  .bind(
    COLLEGE_SHORT_NAME
  )
  .first();

}


/* ============================================================
   PAYMENT SCHEMA
============================================================ */

let paymentSchemaPromise = null;


function ensurePaymentSchema(db){

  if(!paymentSchemaPromise){

    paymentSchemaPromise =
      db.batch([

        db.prepare(
`
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_payments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  seller_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  amount REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  screenshot_data TEXT,
  screenshot_mime TEXT,
  admin_note TEXT,
  verified_by TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(item_id)
)
`
        ),

        db.prepare(
`
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
idx_med_exchange_payments_status
ON med_exchange_payments(status)
`
        ),

        db.prepare(
`
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
idx_med_exchange_payments_item
ON med_exchange_payments(item_id)
`
        )

      ]);

  }


  return paymentSchemaPromise;

}


/* ============================================================
   GET ITEM
============================================================ */

async function getItem(
  db,
  itemId
){

  await ensureContactSchema(db);
  await ensureItemMediaSchema(db);

  if(
    !Number.isInteger(
      itemId
    ) ||
    itemId <= 0
  ){

    return {

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid item ID."

    };

  }


  const item =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  i.*,
  u.name AS seller_name,
  u.phone AS seller_phone,
  u.whatsapp AS seller_whatsapp,
  u.instagram AS seller_instagram,
  u.telegram AS seller_telegram,
  u.snapchat AS seller_snapchat
FROM med_exchange_items i
LEFT JOIN med_exchange_users u
  ON u.id = i.seller_id
WHERE i.id = ?
  AND i.status IN ('APPROVED','SOLD')
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      itemId
    )
    .first();


  if(!item){

    return {

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Item not found."

    };

  }


  let bookSet = [];


  if(
    item.set_id !== null &&
    item.set_id !== undefined
  ){

    try{

      const books =
        await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  set_id,
  book_number,
  name,
  description,
  subject,
  course,
  year,
  edition_model,
  condition,
  original_price,
  selling_price,
  discount_percent,
  photo_url,
  is_available,
  search_text
FROM med_exchange_set_books
WHERE set_id = ?
ORDER BY book_number ASC
`
        )
        .bind(
          Number(
            item.set_id
          )
        )
        .all();


      bookSet =
        books.results ||
        [];

    }catch(error){

      bookSet =
        [];

    }

  }


  try{

    await db.prepare(
`
UPDATE med_exchange_items
SET views_count =
  COALESCE(views_count,0) + 1
WHERE id = ?
`
    )
    .bind(
      itemId
    )
    .run();

  }catch(error){

  }


  return {

    ok:true,

    item:
      item,

    book_set:
      bookSet

  };

}


/* ============================================================
   LIST ITEMS
============================================================ */

async function listItems(
  db,
  url
){

  await ensureItemMediaSchema(db);

  const college =
    await getMRVCollege(
      db
    );


  if(!college){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "MRV college was not found."

    },500);

  }


  try{await db.prepare("DELETE FROM med_exchange_items WHERE status='SOLD' AND sold_at IS NOT NULL AND sold_at <= datetime('now','-30 days')").run();}catch(e){}

  const mode =
    (
      url.searchParams.get(
        "mode"
      ) ||
      "latest"
    ).trim();


  const q =
    (
      url.searchParams.get(
        "q"
      ) ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const category =
    (
      url.searchParams.get(
        "category"
      ) ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const course =
    (
      url.searchParams.get(
        "course"
      ) ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const year =
    (
      url.searchParams.get(
        "year"
      ) ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const subject =
    (
      url.searchParams.get(
        "subject"
      ) ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const deals =
    (
      url.searchParams.get(
        "deals"
      ) ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const maxPriceRaw =
    url.searchParams.get(
      "max_price"
    );


  let maxPrice =
    null;


  if(
    maxPriceRaw !== null &&
    maxPriceRaw !== ""
  ){

    const parsed =
      Number(
        maxPriceRaw
      );


    if(
      Number.isFinite(
        parsed
      ) &&
      parsed >= 0
    ){

      maxPrice =
        parsed;

    }

  }


  if(
    maxPrice === null &&
    q
  ){

    const match =
      q.match(
        /(?:under|below|less than|upto|up to|max(?:imum)?(?: price)?)\s*₹?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)/i
      );


    if(match){

      const parsed =
        Number(
          match[1]
        );


      if(
        Number.isFinite(
          parsed
        ) &&
        parsed >= 0
      ){

        maxPrice =
          parsed;

      }

    }

  }


  let searchText =
    q;


  if(q){

    searchText =
      q

      .replace(
        /(?:under|below|less than|upto|up to|max(?:imum)?(?: price)?)\s*₹?\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?/ig,
        " "
      )

      .replace(
        /₹\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?/g,
        " "
      )

      .replace(
        /\s+/g,
        " "
      )

      .trim();

  }


  let searchTokens = [];


  if(searchText){

    searchTokens =
      searchText
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(
          /[\s,./|•\-]+/
        )
        .map(
          function(token){

            return token.trim();

          }
        )
        .filter(
          function(token){

            return (
              token.length >= 2
            );

          }
        );

  }


  searchTokens =
    Array.from(
      new Set(
        searchTokens
      )
    );


  let sql = `
SELECT
  i.id,
  i.seller_id,
  i.college_id,
  i.campus_id,
  i.category,
  i.title,
  i.description,
  i.edition_model,
  i.course,
  i.year,
  i.subject,
  i.condition,
  i.original_price,
  i.selling_price,
  i.discount_percent,
  i.is_negotiable,
  i.delivery_option,
  i.location_text,
  i.photo_url,
  i.photo_urls,
  i.sold_at,
  i.status,
  i.listing_fee,
  i.payment_status,
  i.search_text,
  i.views_count,
  i.saves_count,
  i.contact_count,
  i.book_count,
  i.created_at,
  i.updated_at
FROM med_exchange_items i
WHERE i.college_id = ?
  AND i.status = 'APPROVED'
`;


  const bindings = [

    Number(
      college.id
    )

  ];


  if(category){

    sql += `
AND i.category = ?
`;

    bindings.push(
      category
    );

  }


  if(course){

    sql += `
AND (LOWER(COALESCE(i.course,'')) = LOWER(?) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM med_exchange_set_books sb WHERE sb.set_id=i.set_id AND LOWER(COALESCE(sb.course,'')) = LOWER(?)))
`;

    bindings.push(course, course);

  }


  if(year){

    sql += `
AND (LOWER(COALESCE(i.year,'')) = LOWER(?) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM med_exchange_set_books sb WHERE sb.set_id=i.set_id AND LOWER(COALESCE(sb.year,'')) = LOWER(?)))
`;

    bindings.push(year, year);

  }


  if(subject){

    sql += `
AND (LOWER(COALESCE(i.subject,'')) LIKE LOWER(?) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM med_exchange_set_books sb WHERE sb.set_id=i.set_id AND LOWER(COALESCE(sb.subject,'')) LIKE LOWER(?)))
`;

    bindings.push("%" + subject + "%", "%" + subject + "%");

  }


  for(
    let tokenIndex = 0;
    tokenIndex < searchTokens.length;
    tokenIndex++
  ){

    const token =
      searchTokens[
        tokenIndex
      ];


    sql += `
AND (
  LOWER(COALESCE(i.title,'')) LIKE ?
  OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.description,'')) LIKE ?
  OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.subject,'')) LIKE ?
  OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.course,'')) LIKE ?
  OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.year,'')) LIKE ?
  OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.category,'')) LIKE ?
  OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.edition_model,'')) LIKE ?
  OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.condition,'')) LIKE ?
  OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.search_text,'')) LIKE ?
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM med_exchange_set_books sb WHERE sb.set_id=i.set_id AND LOWER(COALESCE(sb.search_text,'')) LIKE ?)
)
`;


    const tokenSearch =
      "%" +
      token +
      "%";


    for(
      let fieldIndex = 0;
      fieldIndex < 10;
      fieldIndex++
    ){

      bindings.push(
        tokenSearch
      );

    }

  }


  if(maxPrice !== null){

    sql += `
AND i.selling_price <= ?
`;

    bindings.push(
      Number(
        maxPrice
      )
    );

  }


  if(
    deals === "1" ||
    deals.toLowerCase() === "true"
  ){

    sql += `
AND COALESCE(i.discount_percent,0) > 0
`;

  }


  if(mode === "deals"){

    sql += `
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(i.discount_percent,0) DESC,
  i.created_at DESC
`;

  }else if(
    mode === "price_low"
  ){

    sql += `
ORDER BY
  i.selling_price ASC,
  i.created_at DESC
`;

  }else if(
    mode === "price_high"
  ){

    sql += `
ORDER BY
  i.selling_price DESC,
  i.created_at DESC
`;

  }else{

    sql += `
ORDER BY
  i.created_at DESC
`;

  }


  sql += `
LIMIT 50
`;


  const statement =
    db.prepare(
      sql
    );


  const result =
    await statement
      .bind(
        ...bindings
      )
      .all();


  return json({

    ok:true,

    college:{

      id:
        Number(
          college.id
        ),

      name:
        college.name,

      short_name:
        college.short_name

    },

    mode:
      mode,

    search:
      q,

    category:
      category,

    course:
      course,

    year:
      year,

    subject:
      subject,

    max_price:
      maxPrice,

    deals:
      (
        deals === "1" ||
        deals.toLowerCase() ===
          "true"
      ),

    count:
      (
        result.results ||
        []
      ).length,

    items:
      result.results ||
      []

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   CONTACT SCHEMA / VALIDATION
============================================================ */

/* COMPATIBILITY SCHEMA — runs once per Worker isolate and fixes legacy photo_url. */
let compatibilitySchemaPromise = null;

async function ensureCompatibilitySchema(db){
  if(compatibilitySchemaPromise) return compatibilitySchemaPromise;
  compatibilitySchemaPromise = (async()=>{
    async function addColumns(table, columns){
      const info = await db.prepare("PRAGMA table_info(" + table + ")").all();
      const existing = new Set((info.results || []).map(x => String(x.name || "").toLowerCase()));
      for(const column of columns){
        if(existing.has(column.name.toLowerCase())) continue;
        await db.prepare("ALTER TABLE " + table + " ADD COLUMN " + column.name + " " + column.type).run();
        existing.add(column.name.toLowerCase());
      }
    }
    await addColumns("med_exchange_users", [
      {name:"phone",type:"TEXT"},{name:"whatsapp",type:"TEXT"},{name:"instagram",type:"TEXT"},{name:"telegram",type:"TEXT"},{name:"snapchat",type:"TEXT"},{name:"seller_course",type:"TEXT"},{name:"seller_year",type:"TEXT"},{name:"meetup_location",type:"TEXT"}
    ]);
    await addColumns("med_exchange_items", [
      {name:"photo_url",type:"TEXT"},{name:"photo_urls",type:"TEXT"},{name:"sold_at",type:"TEXT"},{name:"set_id",type:"INTEGER"},{name:"book_count",type:"INTEGER"}
    ]);
    await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_book_sets (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      title TEXT,
      book_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )`).run();
    await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_set_books (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      set_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      book_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
      name TEXT,
      description TEXT,
      subject TEXT,
      course TEXT,
      year TEXT,
      edition_model TEXT,
      condition TEXT,
      original_price REAL,
      selling_price REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      discount_percent REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      photo_url TEXT,
      is_available INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      search_text TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )`).run();
    await addColumns("med_exchange_book_sets", [
      {name:"item_id",type:"INTEGER"},{name:"title",type:"TEXT"},{name:"book_count",type:"INTEGER"}
    ]);
    await addColumns("med_exchange_set_books", [
      {name:"set_id",type:"INTEGER"},{name:"book_number",type:"INTEGER"},{name:"name",type:"TEXT"},{name:"description",type:"TEXT"},{name:"subject",type:"TEXT"},{name:"course",type:"TEXT"},{name:"year",type:"TEXT"},{name:"edition_model",type:"TEXT"},{name:"condition",type:"TEXT"},{name:"original_price",type:"REAL"},{name:"selling_price",type:"REAL"},{name:"discount_percent",type:"REAL"},{name:"photo_url",type:"TEXT"},{name:"is_available",type:"INTEGER"},{name:"search_text",type:"TEXT"}
    ]);
    return true;
  })().catch(error=>{ compatibilitySchemaPromise=null; throw error; });
  return compatibilitySchemaPromise;
}

async function ensureContactSchema(db){ return ensureCompatibilitySchema(db); }
async function ensureItemMediaSchema(db){ return ensureCompatibilitySchema(db); }

function hasContact(body){
  return [body && body.phone, body && body.whatsapp, body && body.instagram, body && body.telegram, body && body.snapchat]
    .some(v => String(v || "").trim().length > 0);
}


/* ============================================================
   SELLER BOOK LIMIT
============================================================ */

async function sellerBookLimit(db, url){
  const sellerId = Number(url.searchParams.get("seller_id") || 0);
  if(!Number.isInteger(sellerId) || sellerId <= 0) return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid seller ID."},400);
  const seller = await db.prepare("SELECT id FROM med_exchange_users WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1").bind(sellerId).first();
  if(!seller) return json({ok:false,error:"Seller account not found."},404);
  const result = await db.prepare(`
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(book_count,0) > 0 THEN book_count ELSE 1 END),0) AS count
FROM med_exchange_items
WHERE seller_id = ?
  AND category = 'Books'
  AND status NOT IN ('SOLD','PAYMENT_REJECTED')
`).bind(sellerId).first();
  const activeBooks = Number(result && result.count || 0);
  return json({ok:true,active_books:activeBooks,limit:MAX_ACTIVE_BOOK_LISTINGS,remaining:Math.max(0,MAX_ACTIVE_BOOK_LISTINGS-activeBooks)});
}


/* ============================================================
   CREATE SELLER
============================================================ */

async function createSeller(
  db,
  requestBody
){

  await ensureContactSchema(db);

  const body =
    requestBody ||
    {};
  const name=String(body.name||"").trim();
  const course=String(body.course||"").trim();
  const year=String(body.year||"").trim();
  const phone=String(body.phone||"").trim();
  const meetup=String(body.meetup_location||"").trim();
  if(name.length<2)return json({ok:false,error:"Full name is required."},400);
  if(!["MBBS","BDS","PG","Other"].includes(course))return json({ok:false,error:"Please select a valid course."},400);
  if(!["1st Year","2nd Year","3rd Year","4th Year","Intern","PG","Other"].includes(year))return json({ok:false,error:"Please select a valid year."},400);
  if(phone.replace(/\D/g,"").length<10)return json({ok:false,error:"A valid mobile number is required."},400);

  const college =
    await getMRVCollege(
      db
    );


  if(!college){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "MRV college was not found."

    },500);

  }


  const insert =
    await db.prepare(
`
INSERT INTO med_exchange_users (
  name, college_id, is_verified_student, is_admin, is_blocked,
  phone, whatsapp, instagram, telegram, snapchat, seller_course, seller_year, meetup_location
)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
`
    )
    .bind(

      name,

      Number(
        college.id
      ),

      0,

      0,

      0,

      phone || null,
      String(body.whatsapp || "").trim() || null,
      String(body.instagram || "").trim() || null,
      String(body.telegram || "").trim() || null,
      String(body.snapchat || "").trim() || null,
      course || null,
      year || null,
      meetup || null

    )
    .run();


  const userId =
    Number(
      insert.meta.last_row_id
    );


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(
      userId
    ) ||
    userId <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Unable to generate numeric seller ID."

    },500);

  }


  return json({

    ok:true,

    user_id:
      userId,

    college_id:
      Number(
        college.id
      ),

    name:
      name

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   CREATE ITEM
============================================================ */

async function createItem(
  db,
  body
){

  body =
    body ||
    {};

  await ensureContactSchema(db);
  await ensureItemMediaSchema(db);

  if(!hasContact(body)){
    return json({ok:false,error:"At least one contact method is required. Phone, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram or Snapchat."},400);
  }


  const sellerId =
    Number(
      body.seller_id
    );


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(
      sellerId
    ) ||
    sellerId <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid seller ID."

    },400);

  }


  const category =
    String(
      body.category ||
      ""
    )
    .trim();


  const title =
    String(
      body.title ||
      ""
    )
    .trim() || category || "Item";


  if(!category){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Category is required."

    },400);

  }


  // Item name is intentionally optional. A category fallback is stored when blank.


  const allowedCategories = [

    "Books",
    "Medical Instruments",
    "Accessories",
    "Study Material",
    "Other"

  ];


  if(
    allowedCategories.indexOf(
      category
    ) === -1
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid category."

    },400);

  }


  const seller =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  college_id,
  campus_id,
  is_blocked
FROM med_exchange_users
WHERE id = ?
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      sellerId
    )
    .first();


  if(!seller){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Seller account not found."

    },400);

  }


  if(
    Number(
      seller.is_blocked
    ) === 1
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "This account is blocked."

    },403);

  }


  const collegeId =
    seller.college_id !== null &&
    seller.college_id !== undefined
    ?
    Number(
      seller.college_id
    )
    :
    null;


  if(
    collegeId === null ||
    !Number.isInteger(
      collegeId
    ) ||
    collegeId <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Seller has no valid college ID."

    },400);

  }


  const college =
    await getMRVCollege(
      db
    );


  if(!college){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "MRV college was not found."

    },500);

  }


  if(
    Number(
      college.id
    ) !==
    Number(
      collegeId
    )
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Seller is not associated with MRV."

    },403);

  }


  let campusId =
    null;


  if(
    seller.campus_id !== null &&
    seller.campus_id !== undefined &&
    seller.campus_id !== ""
  ){

    const parsedCampus =
      Number(
        seller.campus_id
      );


    if(
      Number.isInteger(
        parsedCampus
      ) &&
      parsedCampus > 0
    ){

      campusId =
        parsedCampus;

    }

  }


  const incomingBookSet = category === "Books" && Array.isArray(body.book_set) ? body.book_set : [];
  if(category === "Books"){
    const countResult = await db.prepare(`
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(book_count,0) > 0 THEN book_count ELSE 1 END),0) AS count
FROM med_exchange_items
WHERE seller_id = ?
  AND category = 'Books'
  AND status NOT IN ('SOLD','PAYMENT_REJECTED')
`).bind(sellerId).first();
    const activeBooks = Number(countResult && countResult.count || 0);
    const incomingCount = incomingBookSet.length || 1;
    if(activeBooks + incomingCount > MAX_ACTIVE_BOOK_LISTINGS){
      return json({ok:false,error:"Book selling limit reached. You can have a maximum of 10 active books in total."},400);
    }
  }
  if(category === "Books" && incomingBookSet.length > 10){
    return json({ok:false,error:"A book set can contain a maximum of 10 books."},400);
  }
  if(category === "Books" && Array.isArray(body.book_set) && body.book_set.length < 1){
    return json({ok:false,error:"Select at least 1 book."},400);
  }


  const sellingPrice =
    Number(
      body.selling_price
    );


  if(
    !Number.isFinite(
      sellingPrice
    ) ||
    sellingPrice < 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid selling price."

    },400);

  }


  let originalPrice =
    null;


  if(
    body.original_price !== null &&
    body.original_price !== undefined &&
    body.original_price !== ""
  ){

    const parsedOriginal =
      Number(
        body.original_price
      );


    if(
      !Number.isFinite(
        parsedOriginal
      ) ||
      parsedOriginal < 0
    ){

      return json({

        ok:false,

        error:
          "Invalid original price."

      },400);

    }


    originalPrice =
      parsedOriginal;

  }


  if(
    originalPrice !== null &&
    sellingPrice > originalPrice
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Selling price cannot exceed original price."

    },400);

  }


  let discountPercent =
    0;


  if(
    originalPrice !== null &&
    originalPrice > 0 &&
    sellingPrice < originalPrice
  ){

    discountPercent =
      (
        (originalPrice - sellingPrice) /
        originalPrice
      ) *
      100;

  }


  discountPercent =
    Number(
      discountPercent.toFixed(
        2
      )
    );


  const isNegotiable =
    Number(
      body.is_negotiable
    ) === 1
    ?
    1
    :
    0;


  const description =
    String(
      body.description ||
      ""
    );


  const editionModel =
    String(
      body.edition_model ||
      ""
    );


  const course =
    String(
      body.course ||
      ""
    );


  const year =
    String(
      body.year ||
      ""
    );


  const subject =
    String(
      body.subject ||
      ""
    );


  const condition =
    String(
      body.condition ||
      ""
    );


  const deliveryOption =
    String(
      body.delivery_option ||
      ""
    );


  const locationText =
    String(
      body.location_text ||
      "MRV Campus"
    );


  const photoLimit = (category === "Medical Instruments" || category === "Accessories") ? 2 : 10;
  const photoUrls = Array.isArray(body.photo_urls) ? body.photo_urls.slice(0,photoLimit).map(x=>String(x||"")).filter(x=>/^data:image\//i.test(x) && x.length<=210000) : [];
  if(Array.isArray(body.photo_urls) && body.photo_urls.length > photoLimit) return json({ok:false,error:"Maximum "+photoLimit+" photos allowed for this category."},400);
  if(photoUrls.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.length,0)>1200000)return json({ok:false,error:"Listing photos are too large."},413);
  if(category === "Books" && incomingBookSet.length){
    if(incomingBookSet.length > 10) return json({ok:false,error:"A book set can contain a maximum of 10 books."},400);
    for(let i=0;i<incomingBookSet.length;i++){
      const b=incomingBookSet[i] || {};
      const ph=String(b.photo_url||"");
      if(!/^data:image\//i.test(ph) || ph.length>210000) return json({ok:false,error:"Each book must have one valid photo."},400);
    }
    if(incomingBookSet.reduce((n,b)=>n+String((b&&b.photo_url)||"").length,0)>1200000)return json({ok:false,error:"Book photos are too large."},413);
  }

  await db.prepare(`
UPDATE med_exchange_users
SET phone = ?, whatsapp = ?, instagram = ?, telegram = ?, snapchat = ?
WHERE id = ?
`).bind(
    String(body.phone || "").trim() || null,
    String(body.whatsapp || "").trim() || null,
    String(body.instagram || "").trim() || null,
    String(body.telegram || "").trim() || null,
    String(body.snapchat || "").trim() || null,
    sellerId
  ).run();


  const searchText = [

    title,
    description,
    editionModel,
    course,
    year,
    subject,
    condition,
    category

  ]
  .filter(Boolean)
  .join(" ");


  const listingFee =
    LISTING_FEE;


  const insert =
    await db.prepare(
`
INSERT INTO med_exchange_items (
  seller_id,
  college_id,
  campus_id,
  category,
  title,
  description,
  edition_model,
  course,
  year,
  subject,
  condition,
  original_price,
  selling_price,
  discount_percent,
  is_negotiable,
  delivery_option,
  location_text,
  photo_urls,
  set_id,
  book_count,
  status,
  listing_fee,
  payment_status,
  search_text,
  views_count,
  saves_count,
  contact_count
)
VALUES (
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  ?,
  'DRAFT',
  ?,
  'PENDING',
  ?,
  0,
  0,
  0
)
`
    )
    .bind(

      Number(sellerId),

      Number(collegeId),

      campusId === null
      ?
      null
      :
      Number(campusId),

      category,
      title,
      description,
      editionModel,
      course,
      year,
      subject,
      condition,

      originalPrice === null
      ?
      null
      :
      Number(originalPrice),

      Number(sellingPrice),

      Number(discountPercent),

      Number(isNegotiable),

      deliveryOption,
      locationText,
      photoUrls.length ? JSON.stringify(photoUrls) : null,
      null,
      category === "Books" ? (incomingBookSet.length || 1) : 0,

      Number(listingFee),

      searchText

    )
    .run();

  /* Keep the first image in the legacy photo_url column as well.
     This preserves compatibility with older listings/UI while the
     full 1–10 image gallery remains in photo_urls. */
  if(photoUrls.length){
    await db.prepare(`
      UPDATE med_exchange_items
      SET photo_url = ?
      WHERE id = ?
    `).bind(
      photoUrls[0],
      Number(insert.meta.last_row_id)
    ).run();
  }


  const itemId =
    Number(
      insert.meta.last_row_id
    );


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(
      itemId
    ) ||
    itemId <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Item was saved but no numeric ID was returned."

    },500);

  }

  if(category === "Books" && incomingBookSet.length){
    try{
      const setInsert = await db.prepare("INSERT INTO med_exchange_book_sets (item_id, title, book_count) VALUES (?,?,?)").bind(itemId,title,incomingBookSet.length).run();
      const setId = Number(setInsert.meta.last_row_id);
      if(!setId) throw new Error("Unable to create book set.");
      for(let i=0;i<incomingBookSet.length;i++){
        const b=incomingBookSet[i]||{};
        const o=(b.original_price===null||b.original_price===undefined||b.original_price==="")?null:Number(b.original_price);
        const p=Number(b.selling_price||0);
        const d=(o!==null&&o>0&&p<o)?((o-p)/o)*100:0;
        const search=[b.name,b.description,b.subject,b.course,b.year,b.edition_model,b.condition].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
        await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_set_books (set_id,book_number,name,description,subject,course,year,edition_model,condition,original_price,selling_price,discount_percent,photo_url,is_available,search_text) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1,?)`).bind(setId,i+1,String(b.name||""),String(b.description||""),String(b.subject||""),String(b.course||""),String(b.year||""),String(b.edition_model||""),String(b.condition||""),o,p,Number(d.toFixed(2)),String(b.photo_url||""),search).run();
      }
      await db.prepare("UPDATE med_exchange_items SET set_id=?, book_count=? WHERE id=?").bind(setId,incomingBookSet.length,itemId).run();
    }catch(error){
      try{await db.prepare("DELETE FROM med_exchange_items WHERE id=?").bind(itemId).run();}catch(e){}
      return json({ok:false,error:"Unable to save the book set. Please try again."},500);
    }
  }


  return json({

    ok:true,

    item_id:
      itemId,

    public_item_id:
      "ME-" +
      itemId,

    status:
      "DRAFT",

    listing_fee:
      LISTING_FEE,

    payment_status:
      "PENDING",

    message:
      "Your item has been saved."

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   ADMIN AUTH
============================================================ */

function requireAdmin(
  request,
  env
){

  const auth =
    request.headers.get(
      "Authorization"
    ) ||
    "";


  const token =
    auth.startsWith(
      "Bearer "
    )
    ?
    auth.slice(
      7
    ).trim()
    :
    "";


  if(
    !env.ADMIN_SECRET ||
    !token ||
    token !==
      env.ADMIN_SECRET
  ){

    return false;

  }


  return true;

}


/* ============================================================
   ADMIN — AUTH VALIDATION
============================================================ */

function adminAuthCheck(
  request,
  env
){

  if(
    !env.ADMIN_SECRET
  ){

    return json({
      ok:false,
      error:
        "ADMIN_SECRET is not configured on this Worker."
    },503);

  }


  if(
    !requireAdmin(
      request,
      env
    )
  ){

    return json({
      ok:false,
      error:
        "Invalid or expired admin session."
    },401);

  }


  return json({
    ok:true,
    authenticated:true
  });

}


/* ============================================================
   PAYMENT QR
============================================================ */

async function getPaymentQr(
  db,
  env
){

  /*
   * Priority 1:
   * PAYMENT_QR_URL
   */

  if(
    env.PAYMENT_QR_URL
  ){

    try{

      const response =
        await fetch(
          env.PAYMENT_QR_URL
        );


      if(
        response.ok
      ){

        const contentType =
          response.headers.get(
            "content-type"
          ) ||
          "image/png";


        const buffer =
          await response.arrayBuffer();


        return new Response(
          buffer,
          {
            status:200,
            headers:{
              "Content-Type":
                contentType,
              "Cache-Control":
                "public,max-age=300",
              ...corsHeaders()
            }
          }
        );

      }

    }catch(error){

      console.error(
        "PAYMENT_QR_URL ERROR:",
        error
      );

    }

  }


  /*
   * Priority 2:
   * PAYMENT_QR_FILE_ID
   */

  let fileId =
    env.PAYMENT_QR_FILE_ID ||
    "";


  /*
   * Priority 3:
   * Existing bot_settings
   */

  if(!fileId){

    try{

      const setting =
        await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  value
FROM bot_settings
WHERE key = ?
LIMIT 1
`
        )
        .bind(
          "payment_qr_file_id"
        )
        .first();


      if(
        setting &&
        setting.value
      ){

        fileId =
          String(
            setting.value
          ).trim();

      }

    }catch(error){

      console.error(
        "QR D1 SETTING ERROR:",
        error
      );

    }

  }


  if(!fileId){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Payment QR is not configured. Set PAYMENT_QR_URL, PAYMENT_QR_FILE_ID, or store payment_qr_file_id in bot_settings."

    },503);

  }


  if(
    !env.BOT_TOKEN
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "BOT_TOKEN is required to retrieve the stored Telegram QR."

    },503);

  }


  /*
   * Telegram getFile.
   */

  const telegramResponse =
    await fetch(
      "https://api.telegram.org/bot" +
      env.BOT_TOKEN +
      "/getFile?file_id=" +
      encodeURIComponent(
        fileId
      )
    );


  const telegramData =
    await telegramResponse.json();


  if(
    !telegramResponse.ok ||
    !telegramData.ok ||
    !telegramData.result ||
    !telegramData.result.file_path
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Unable to retrieve the stored payment QR from Telegram."

    },502);

  }


  const filePath =
    telegramData.result.file_path;


  const fileResponse =
    await fetch(
      "https://api.telegram.org/file/bot" +
      env.BOT_TOKEN +
      "/" +
      filePath
    );


  if(!fileResponse.ok){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Unable to download the payment QR."

    },502);

  }


  const buffer =
    await fileResponse.arrayBuffer();


  const contentType =
    fileResponse.headers.get(
      "content-type"
    ) ||
    "image/png";


  return new Response(
    buffer,
    {
      status:200,
      headers:{
        "Content-Type":
          contentType,
        "Cache-Control":
          "public,max-age=300",
        ...corsHeaders()
      }
    }
  );

}


/* ============================================================
   SUBMIT PAYMENT
============================================================ */

async function submitPayment(
  db,
  body
){

  await ensurePaymentSchema(
    db
  );


  body =
    body ||
    {};


  const itemId =
    Number(
      body.item_id
    );


  const sellerId =
    Number(
      body.seller_id
    );


  const amount =
    Number(
      body.amount
    );


  const screenshotData =
    String(
      body.screenshot_data ||
      ""
    );


  const screenshotMime =
    String(
      body.screenshot_mime ||
      "image/jpeg"
    );


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(itemId) ||
    itemId <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid item ID."

    },400);

  }


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(sellerId) ||
    sellerId <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid seller ID."

    },400);

  }


  if(
    amount !==
    LISTING_FEE
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid payment amount."

    },400);

  }


  if(!screenshotData){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Payment screenshot is required."

    },400);

  }


  /*
   * Hard server-side size protection.
   */

  if(
    screenshotData.length >
    900000
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Payment screenshot is too large. Please upload a smaller screenshot."

    },413);

  }


  if(
    !/^data:image\//i.test(
      screenshotData
    )
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid payment screenshot format."

    },400);

  }


  const item =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  i.id,
  i.seller_id,
  i.college_id,
  i.status,
  i.payment_status,
  i.listing_fee,
  i.title
FROM med_exchange_items i
WHERE i.id = ?
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      itemId
    )
    .first();


  if(!item){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Item not found."

    },404);

  }


  if(
    Number(
      item.seller_id
    ) !==
    sellerId
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "You are not the seller of this item."

    },403);

  }


  if(
    item.status ===
    "APPROVED"
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "This item has already been approved."

    },400);

  }


  /*
   * Existing pending submission cannot be
   * overwritten unless it was rejected.
   */

  const existing =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  status
FROM med_exchange_payments
WHERE item_id = ?
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      itemId
    )
    .first();


  if(
    existing &&
    String(
      existing.status
    ) === "PENDING"
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "A payment submission is already waiting for verification."

    },409);

  }


  if(
    existing &&
    String(
      existing.status
    ) === "VERIFIED"
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "This payment has already been verified."

    },409);

  }


  if(existing){

    await db.prepare(
`
UPDATE med_exchange_payments
SET
  seller_id = ?,
  amount = ?,
  status = 'PENDING',
  screenshot_data = ?,
  screenshot_mime = ?,
  admin_note = NULL,
  verified_by = NULL,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE item_id = ?
`
    )
    .bind(

      sellerId,
      LISTING_FEE,
      screenshotData,
      screenshotMime,
      itemId

    )
    .run();

  }else{

    await db.prepare(
`
INSERT INTO med_exchange_payments (
  item_id,
  seller_id,
  amount,
  status,
  screenshot_data,
  screenshot_mime
)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', ?, ?)
`
    )
    .bind(

      itemId,
      sellerId,
      LISTING_FEE,
      screenshotData,
      screenshotMime

    )
    .run();

  }


  await db.prepare(
`
UPDATE med_exchange_items
SET
  status = 'DRAFT',
  payment_status = 'SUBMITTED',
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = ?
`
  )
  .bind(
    itemId
  )
  .run();


  return json({

    ok:true,

    item_id:
      itemId,

    public_item_id:
      "ME-" +
      itemId,

    payment_status:
      "SUBMITTED",

    message:
      "Payment submitted for verification."

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   PAYMENT STATUS
============================================================ */

async function getPaymentStatus(
  db,
  url
){

  await ensurePaymentSchema(
    db
  );


  const itemId =
    Number(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "item_id"
      )
    );


  const sellerId =
    Number(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "seller_id"
      )
    );


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(itemId) ||
    itemId <= 0 ||
    !Number.isInteger(sellerId) ||
    sellerId <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid payment status request."

    },400);

  }


  const item =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  seller_id,
  status,
  payment_status,
  title
FROM med_exchange_items
WHERE id = ?
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      itemId
    )
    .first();


  if(!item){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Item not found."

    },404);

  }


  if(
    Number(
      item.seller_id
    ) !==
    sellerId
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Access denied."

    },403);

  }


  const payment =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  amount,
  status,
  admin_note,
  created_at,
  updated_at
FROM med_exchange_payments
WHERE item_id = ?
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      itemId
    )
    .first();


  return json({

    ok:true,

    item_id:
      itemId,

    item_status:
      item.status,

    payment_status:
      payment
      ?
      payment.status === "PENDING"
      ?
      "SUBMITTED"
      :
      payment.status
      :
      (
        item.payment_status ||
        "PENDING"
      ),

    amount:
      payment
      ?
      payment.amount
      :
      LISTING_FEE,

    admin_note:
      payment
      ?
      payment.admin_note
      :
      null,

    created_at:
      payment
      ?
      payment.created_at
      :
      null,

    updated_at:
      payment
      ?
      payment.updated_at
      :
      null

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   ADMIN — PENDING PAYMENTS
============================================================ */

async function adminPayments(
  db,
  url
){

  await ensurePaymentSchema(
    db
  );


  const status =
    (
      url.searchParams.get(
        "status"
      ) ||
      "PENDING"
    )
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();


  let sql = `
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.item_id,
  p.seller_id,
  p.amount,
  p.status,
  p.screenshot_data,
  p.screenshot_mime,
  p.admin_note,
  p.verified_by,
  p.created_at,
  p.updated_at,
  i.title AS item_title,
  i.category,
  i.course,
  i.year,
  i.subject,
  i.condition,
  i.original_price,
  i.selling_price,
  i.discount_percent,
  i.description,
  i.location_text,
  i.delivery_option,
  u.name AS seller_name
FROM med_exchange_payments p
LEFT JOIN med_exchange_items i
  ON i.id = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN med_exchange_users u
  ON u.id = p.seller_id
WHERE 1 = 1
`;


  const bindings = [];


  if(status){

    sql += `
AND p.status = ?
`;

    bindings.push(
      status
    );

  }


  sql += `
ORDER BY
  p.created_at ASC
LIMIT 100
`;


  const result =
    await db.prepare(
      sql
    )
    .bind(
      ...bindings
    )
    .all();


  return json({

    ok:true,

    count:
      (
        result.results ||
        []
      ).length,

    payments:
      result.results ||
      []

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   ADMIN — VERIFY PAYMENT
============================================================ */

async function adminVerifyPayment(
  db,
  paymentId,
  adminIdentity
){

  await ensurePaymentSchema(
    db
  );


  const id =
    Number(
      paymentId
    );


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(id) ||
    id <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid payment ID."

    },400);

  }


  const payment =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  item_id,
  seller_id,
  status
FROM med_exchange_payments
WHERE id = ?
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      id
    )
    .first();


  if(!payment){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Payment not found."

    },404);

  }


  if(
    String(
      payment.status
    ) !== "PENDING"
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "This payment is no longer pending."

    },409);

  }


  await db.batch([

    db.prepare(
`
UPDATE med_exchange_payments
SET
  status = 'VERIFIED',
  verified_by = ?,
  admin_note = NULL,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = ?
`
    )
    .bind(
      adminIdentity,
      id
    ),

    db.prepare(
`
UPDATE med_exchange_items
SET
  payment_status = 'VERIFIED',
  status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL',
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = ?
`
    )
    .bind(
      Number(
        payment.item_id
      )
    )

  ]);


  return json({

    ok:true,

    payment_id:
      id,

    item_id:
      Number(
        payment.item_id
      ),

    payment_status:
      "VERIFIED",

    item_status:
      "PENDING_APPROVAL",

    message:
      "Payment verified. Item is now pending approval."

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   ADMIN — REJECT PAYMENT
============================================================ */

async function adminRejectPayment(
  db,
  paymentId,
  body,
  adminIdentity
){

  await ensurePaymentSchema(
    db
  );


  const id =
    Number(
      paymentId
    );


  const note =
    String(
      body &&
      body.admin_note
      ?
      body.admin_note
      :
      ""
    )
    .trim()
    .slice(
      0,
      500
    );


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(id) ||
    id <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid payment ID."

    },400);

  }


  const payment =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  item_id,
  status
FROM med_exchange_payments
WHERE id = ?
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      id
    )
    .first();


  if(!payment){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Payment not found."

    },404);

  }


  if(
    String(
      payment.status
    ) !== "PENDING"
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "This payment is no longer pending."

    },409);

  }


  await db.batch([

    db.prepare(
`
UPDATE med_exchange_payments
SET
  status = 'REJECTED',
  admin_note = ?,
  verified_by = ?,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = ?
`
    )
    .bind(
      note ||
      null,
      adminIdentity,
      id
    ),

    db.prepare(
`
UPDATE med_exchange_items
SET
  payment_status = 'REJECTED',
  status = 'PAYMENT_REJECTED',
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = ?
`
    )
    .bind(
      Number(
        payment.item_id
      )
    )

  ]);


  return json({

    ok:true,

    payment_id:
      id,

    item_id:
      Number(
        payment.item_id
      ),

    payment_status:
      "REJECTED",

    item_status:
      "PAYMENT_REJECTED",

    message:
      "Payment rejected."

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   CAMPUS CHIT-CHAT — LAZY SERVER SCHEMA/API
   Nothing here runs for normal Marketplace requests.
============================================================ */
let chatSchemaPromise=null;
async function ensureChatSchema(db){
  if(!db)throw Error('Campus Chit-Chat database is not configured.');
  if(chatSchemaPromise)return chatSchemaPromise;
  chatSchemaPromise=(async()=>{
    await db.batch([
      db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_profiles (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, college TEXT NOT NULL, gender TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY', hide_profile INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_seen TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`),
      db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_queue (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, preferred_gender TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ANY', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'WAITING', chat_id INTEGER, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`),
      db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chats (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user1_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user2_id INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ended_at TEXT)`),
      db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, sender_id INTEGER NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, message_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TEXT', created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`),
      db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_match_locks (pair_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`),
      db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mrv_chat_queue_status ON med_exchange_chat_queue(status)`),
      db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mrv_chat_messages_chat ON med_exchange_chat_messages(chat_id,id)`),
      db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_confessions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`),
      db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mrv_chat_confessions_created ON med_exchange_chat_confessions(id)` )
    ]);
    var cols=await db.prepare(`PRAGMA table_info(med_exchange_chat_profiles)`).all();
    var names=(cols.results||[]).map(function(x){return String(x.name||'')});
    if(names.indexOf('gender')<0)await db.prepare(`ALTER TABLE med_exchange_chat_profiles ADD COLUMN gender TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY'`).run();
    if(names.indexOf('hide_profile')<0)await db.prepare(`ALTER TABLE med_exchange_chat_profiles ADD COLUMN hide_profile INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1`).run();
    if(names.indexOf('active')<0)await db.prepare(`ALTER TABLE med_exchange_chat_profiles ADD COLUMN active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1`).run();
    return true;
  })().catch(function(e){chatSchemaPromise=null;throw e});
  return chatSchemaPromise;
}
function chatClean(v,max){return String(v==null?'':v).trim().slice(0,max||500)}
async function chatProfile(db,b){
  await ensureChatSchema(db);
  var username=chatClean(b&&b.username,40).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]/g,'');
  var college=chatClean(b&&b.college,60);
  var hasGender=!!(b&&b.gender);var gender=String(b&&b.gender||'').toUpperCase();
  if(username.length<2)return json({ok:false,error:'Choose a username.'},400);
  if(!college)return json({ok:false,error:'Choose your college.'},400);
  var hide=b&&b.hide_profile===false?0:1;
  var id=Number(b&&b.profile_id||0);
  if(id){
    var own=await db.prepare('SELECT id,gender FROM med_exchange_chat_profiles WHERE id=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1').bind(id).first();
    if(!own)return json({ok:false,error:'Profile not found.'},404);
    if(!hasGender)gender=String(own.gender||'').toUpperCase();
    if(['MALE','FEMALE','PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY'].indexOf(gender)<0)return json({ok:false,error:'Please choose a valid gender.'},400);
    var clash=await db.prepare('SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chat_profiles WHERE username=? AND id<>? AND active=1 LIMIT 1').bind(username,id).first();
    if(clash)return json({ok:false,error:'That username is already in use.'},409);
    await db.prepare('UPDATE med_exchange_chat_profiles SET username=?,college=?,gender=?,hide_profile=?,last_seen=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=?').bind(username,college,gender,hide,id).run();
    return json({ok:true,profile:await db.prepare('SELECT id,username,college,gender,hide_profile FROM med_exchange_chat_profiles WHERE id=?').bind(id).first()});
  }
  if(!hasGender||['MALE','FEMALE','PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY'].indexOf(gender)<0)return json({ok:false,error:'Please choose your gender before creating your profile.'},400);
  var existing=await db.prepare('SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chat_profiles WHERE username=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1').bind(username).first();
   if(existing)return json({ok:false,error:'That username is already in use.'},409);
   var r=await db.prepare('INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_profiles(username,college,gender,hide_profile) VALUES(?,?,?,?)').bind(username,college,gender,hide).run();
   var pid=Number(r&&r.meta&&r.meta.last_row_id||0);
   if(!pid)return json({ok:false,error:'Unable to create profile.'},500);
  return json({ok:true,profile:await db.prepare('SELECT id,username,college,gender,hide_profile FROM med_exchange_chat_profiles WHERE id=?').bind(pid).first()});
}
async function chatFind(db,b){
  await ensureChatSchema(db);
  var pid=Number(b&&b.profile_id||0);
  var me=await db.prepare('SELECT id,gender,active FROM med_exchange_chat_profiles WHERE id=? LIMIT 1').bind(pid).first();
  if(!me||Number(me.active)!==1)return json({ok:false,error:'Create your Chit-Chat profile first.'},400);
  var requested=String(b&&b.match_preference||'OPPOSITE').toUpperCase();
  if(['OPPOSITE','SAME','ANY'].indexOf(requested)<0)requested='OPPOSITE';
  var myGender=String(me.gender||'PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY').toUpperCase();
  var desired=(requested==='ANY'||myGender==='PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY')?'ANY':(requested==='SAME'?myGender:(myGender==='MALE'?'FEMALE':'MALE'));
  await db.prepare("DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_match_locks WHERE created_at < datetime('now','-30 seconds')").run();
  var active=await db.prepare("SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chats WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND (user1_id=? OR user2_id=?) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").bind(pid,pid).first();
  if(active)return json({ok:true,status:'MATCHED',chat_id:Number(active.id)});
  var q=await db.prepare('SELECT id,status,chat_id FROM med_exchange_chat_queue WHERE profile_id=? LIMIT 1').bind(pid).first();
  if(q&&q.status==='MATCHED'&&q.chat_id)return json({ok:true,status:'MATCHED',chat_id:Number(q.chat_id)});
  if(q)await db.prepare("UPDATE med_exchange_chat_queue SET status='WAITING',preferred_gender=?,chat_id=NULL,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE profile_id=?").bind(desired,pid).run();
  else await db.prepare("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO med_exchange_chat_queue(profile_id,preferred_gender,status) VALUES(?,?,'WAITING')").bind(pid,desired).run();
  if(!q)await db.prepare("UPDATE med_exchange_chat_queue SET status='WAITING',preferred_gender=?,chat_id=NULL,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE profile_id=?").bind(desired,pid).run();
  var partner;
  if(desired==='ANY'){
    partner=await db.prepare("SELECT q.profile_id FROM med_exchange_chat_queue q JOIN med_exchange_chat_profiles p ON p.id=q.profile_id WHERE q.status='WAITING' AND q.profile_id<>? AND p.active=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM med_exchange_chat_blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id=? AND b.blocked_id=q.profile_id) OR (b.blocker_id=q.profile_id AND b.blocked_id=?)) ORDER BY q.created_at ASC LIMIT 1").bind(pid,pid,pid).first();
  }else{
    partner=await db.prepare("SELECT q.profile_id FROM med_exchange_chat_queue q JOIN med_exchange_chat_profiles p ON p.id=q.profile_id WHERE q.status='WAITING' AND q.profile_id<>? AND p.active=1 AND p.gender=? AND (q.preferred_gender=? OR q.preferred_gender='ANY') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM med_exchange_chat_blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id=? AND b.blocked_id=q.profile_id) OR (b.blocker_id=q.profile_id AND b.blocked_id=?)) ORDER BY q.created_at ASC LIMIT 1").bind(pid,desired,myGender,pid,pid).first();
    /* If opposite-gender matching is unavailable, fall back to the same gender.
       This keeps the requested MRV matching behavior from getting stuck forever. */
    if(!partner && myGender!=='PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY'){
      partner=await db.prepare("SELECT q.profile_id FROM med_exchange_chat_queue q JOIN med_exchange_chat_profiles p ON p.id=q.profile_id WHERE q.status='WAITING' AND q.profile_id<>? AND p.active=1 AND p.gender=? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM med_exchange_chat_blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id=? AND b.blocked_id=q.profile_id) OR (b.blocker_id=q.profile_id AND b.blocked_id=?)) ORDER BY q.created_at ASC LIMIT 1").bind(pid,myGender,pid,pid).first();
    }
  }
  if(!partner)return json({ok:true,status:'WAITING',preference:requested});
  var partnerId=Number(partner.profile_id);
  var low=Math.min(pid,partnerId),high=Math.max(pid,partnerId),pairKey=String(low)+':'+String(high);
  var lock=await db.prepare("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO med_exchange_chat_match_locks(pair_key) VALUES(?)").bind(pairKey).run();
  if(!lock.meta||Number(lock.meta.changes)!==1){
    var raced=await db.prepare("SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chats WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND ((user1_id=? AND user2_id=?) OR (user1_id=? AND user2_id=?)) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").bind(pid,partnerId,partnerId,pid).first();
    if(raced)return json({ok:true,status:'MATCHED',chat_id:Number(raced.id)});
    return json({ok:true,status:'WAITING'});
  }
  try{
    var existingPair=await db.prepare("SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chats WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND ((user1_id=? AND user2_id=?) OR (user1_id=? AND user2_id=?)) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").bind(pid,partnerId,partnerId,pid).first();
    if(existingPair)return json({ok:true,status:'MATCHED',chat_id:Number(existingPair.id)});
    var c=await db.prepare("INSERT INTO med_exchange_chats(user1_id,user2_id,status) VALUES(?,?,?)").bind(pid,partnerId,'ACTIVE').run();
    var cid=Number(c.meta.last_row_id);
    await db.batch([
      db.prepare("UPDATE med_exchange_chat_queue SET status='MATCHED',chat_id=? WHERE profile_id=?").bind(cid,pid),
      db.prepare("UPDATE med_exchange_chat_queue SET status='MATCHED',chat_id=? WHERE profile_id=?").bind(cid,partnerId)
    ]);
    return json({ok:true,status:'MATCHED',chat_id:cid,preference:requested});
  }finally{
    await db.prepare("DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_match_locks WHERE pair_key=?").bind(pairKey).run();
  }
}
async function chatRecent(db,u){
  await ensureChatStage3Schema(db);
  var pid=Number(u.searchParams.get('profile_id')||0);
  if(!pid)return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid profile.'},400);
  var r=await db.prepare(`SELECT c.id,c.user1_id,c.user2_id,c.status,c.created_at,c.ended_at, CASE WHEN c.user1_id=? THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END AS partner_id, p.username AS partner_username,mta.avatar AS partner_avatar, lm.id AS last_message_id,lm.sender_id AS last_sender_id,lm.message AS last_message,lm.created_at AS last_message_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM med_exchange_chat_messages x WHERE x.chat_id=c.id AND x.sender_id<>? AND x.id>COALESCE((SELECT last_read_message_id FROM med_exchange_chat_reads rr WHERE rr.chat_id=c.id AND rr.profile_id=?),0)) AS unread_count FROM med_exchange_chats c JOIN med_exchange_chat_profiles p ON p.id=(CASE WHEN c.user1_id=? THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END) LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profile_meta mta ON mta.profile_id=p.id LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_messages lm ON lm.id=(SELECT MAX(z.id) FROM med_exchange_chat_messages z WHERE z.chat_id=c.id) WHERE (c.user1_id=? OR c.user2_id=?) AND p.active=1 ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.id,c.id) DESC LIMIT 30`).bind(pid,pid,pid,pid,pid,pid).all();
  return json({ok:true,chats:r.results||[]});
}
async function chatMessages(db,u){

    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(reaction||':'||profile_id) FROM med_exchange_chat_message_reactions mr WHERE mr.message_id=m.id) AS reactions
    FROM med_exchange_chat_messages m WHERE m.chat_id=? ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT 200`).bind(cid).all();
  var partnerId=Number(c.user1_id)===pid?Number(c.user2_id):Number(c.user1_id);

  return json({ok:true,chat:c,partner:partner||null,messages:r.results||[]});
}

/* ============================================================
   CAMPUS CHIT-CHAT — STAGE 3 SOCIAL LAYER
   Uses separate tables so existing chat tables remain compatible.
============================================================ */
async function ensureChatStage3Schema(db){
  await ensureChatSchema(db);
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_profile_meta (profile_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, bio TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', avatar TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '🕶️', updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_blocks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, blocker_id INTEGER NOT NULL, blocked_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(blocker_id,blocked_id))`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_reports (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, reporter_id INTEGER NOT NULL, target_id INTEGER, chat_id INTEGER, reason TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN', created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mrv_chat_reports_status ON med_exchange_chat_reports(status)`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mrv_chat_blocks_pair ON med_exchange_chat_blocks(blocker_id,blocked_id)`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_message_reactions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, message_id INTEGER NOT NULL, profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL, reaction TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(message_id,profile_id,reaction))`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_reads (chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL, last_read_message_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY(chat_id,profile_id))`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_typing (chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY(chat_id,profile_id))`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mrv_chat_reactions_message ON med_exchange_chat_message_reactions(message_id)`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mrv_chat_typing_chat ON med_exchange_chat_typing(chat_id,updated_at)`)
  ]);
  return true;
}

async function chatReport(db,b){
  await ensureChatStage3Schema(db); const reporter=Number(b&&b.profile_id||0), target=Number(b&&b.target_profile_id||0)||null, cid=Number(b&&b.chat_id||0)||null, reason=chatClean(b&&b.reason,500);
  if(!reporter||!reason)return json({ok:false,error:'Report reason is required.'},400);
  if(target===reporter)return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid report target.'},400);
  if(cid){const c=await db.prepare('SELECT user1_id,user2_id FROM med_exchange_chats WHERE id=? LIMIT 1').bind(cid).first();if(!c||(Number(c.user1_id)!==reporter&&Number(c.user2_id)!==reporter))return json({ok:false,error:'Chat not found.'},404)}
  await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_reports(reporter_id,target_id,chat_id,reason) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`).bind(reporter,target,cid,reason).run();
  let targetId=target;if(!targetId&&cid){const c=await db.prepare('SELECT user1_id,user2_id FROM med_exchange_chats WHERE id=? LIMIT 1').bind(cid).first();if(c)targetId=Number(c.user1_id)===reporter?Number(c.user2_id):Number(c.user1_id)}
  return json({ok:true,target_profile_id:targetId||0});
}
async function chatBlock(db,b){
  await ensureChatStage3Schema(db); const me=Number(b&&b.profile_id||0), target=Number(b&&b.target_profile_id||0),cid=Number(b&&b.chat_id||0);
  if(!me)return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid profile.'},400); let tid=target;
  if(!tid&&cid){const c=await db.prepare('SELECT user1_id,user2_id FROM med_exchange_chats WHERE id=? LIMIT 1').bind(cid).first();if(c)tid=Number(c.user1_id)===me?Number(c.user2_id):Number(c.user1_id)}
  if(!tid||tid===me)return json({ok:false,error:'Unable to identify the person.'},400);
  await db.prepare(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO med_exchange_chat_blocks(blocker_id,blocked_id) VALUES(?,?)`).bind(me,tid).run();
  return json({ok:true,blocked_id:tid});
}
/* ============================================================
   DELETE COMPLETE USER ACCOUNT
   Removes both Med Exchange seller data and Campus Chit-Chat data.
============================================================ */
async function deleteCompleteUserAccount(db,body){
  body=body||{};
  const sellerId=Number(body.seller_id||0);
  const profileId=Number(body.profile_id||0);
  if(!sellerId&&!profileId)return json({ok:false,error:'No account identifier supplied.'},400);

  /* Make sure optional chat tables exist before deleting from them. */
  if(profileId){
    await ensureChatStage3Schema(db);
    try{await ensureChatV9Schema(db)}catch(e){}
    try{await ensureCampusWallSchema(db)}catch(e){}
  }

  /* Med Exchange seller/account data. */
  if(sellerId){
    await ensureItemMediaSchema(db);
    const items=await db.prepare('SELECT id,set_id FROM med_exchange_items WHERE seller_id=?').bind(sellerId).all();
    const itemRows=items.results||[];
    const setIds=[...new Set(itemRows.map(x=>Number(x.set_id||0)).filter(x=>x>0))];

    if(setIds.length){
      for(const setId of setIds){
        try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_set_books WHERE set_id=?').bind(setId).run()}catch(e){}
        try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_book_sets WHERE id=?').bind(setId).run()}catch(e){}
      }
    }
    try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_payments WHERE seller_id=?').bind(sellerId).run()}catch(e){}
    await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_items WHERE seller_id=?').bind(sellerId).run();
    await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_users WHERE id=?').bind(sellerId).run();
  }

  /* Campus Chit-Chat data. A chat is removed completely if this user
     participated in it, including the other participant's copy/history. */
  if(profileId){
    const chats=await db.prepare('SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chats WHERE user1_id=? OR user2_id=?').bind(profileId,profileId).all();
    const chatIds=(chats.results||[]).map(x=>Number(x.id)).filter(x=>x>0);

    for(const chatId of chatIds){
      try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_message_reactions WHERE message_id IN (SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chat_messages WHERE chat_id=?)').bind(chatId).run()}catch(e){}
      try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_messages WHERE chat_id=?').bind(chatId).run()}catch(e){}
      try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_reads WHERE chat_id=?').bind(chatId).run()}catch(e){}
      try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_typing WHERE chat_id=?').bind(chatId).run()}catch(e){}
      try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chats WHERE id=?').bind(chatId).run()}catch(e){}
    }

    /* Remove profile-owned and profile-referencing community data. */
    const profileDeletes=[
      ['med_exchange_chat_queue','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_confessions','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_profile_meta','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_blocks','blocker_id=? OR blocked_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_reports','reporter_id=? OR target_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_message_reactions','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_reads','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_typing','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_play_votes','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_play_challenge_answers','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_after_dark_posts','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_daily_answers','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_wall_comments','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_wall_votes','profile_id=?'],
      ['med_exchange_chat_wall_reports','reporter_profile_id=?']
    ];
    for(const entry of profileDeletes){
      try{
        if(entry[1].indexOf(' OR ')>=0) await db.prepare('DELETE FROM '+entry[0]+' WHERE '+entry[1]).bind(profileId,profileId).run();
        else await db.prepare('DELETE FROM '+entry[0]+' WHERE '+entry[1]).bind(profileId).run();
      }catch(e){}
    }

    /* Delete wall posts authored by this profile and their dependent rows. */
    try{
      const posts=await db.prepare('SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_posts WHERE profile_id=?').bind(profileId).all();
      for(const row of (posts.results||[])){
        const postId=Number(row.id||0); if(!postId)continue;
        try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions WHERE post_id=?').bind(postId).run()}catch(e){}
        try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_comments WHERE post_id=?').bind(postId).run()}catch(e){}
        try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_votes WHERE post_id=?').bind(postId).run()}catch(e){}
        try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_poll_options WHERE post_id=?').bind(postId).run()}catch(e){}
        try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_reports WHERE target_type=? AND target_id=?').bind('POST',postId).run()}catch(e){}
        try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_posts WHERE id=?').bind(postId).run()}catch(e){}
      }
    }catch(e){}

    /* Remove any remaining profile-linked data from tables added by later stages. */
    try{await db.prepare('DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_profiles WHERE id=?').bind(profileId).run()}catch(e){}
  }

  return json({ok:true,deleted:true});
}
