/* ============================================================
   ADMIN — PENDING ITEMS
============================================================ */

async function adminItems(
  db,
  url
){

  const status =
    (
      url.searchParams.get(
        "status"
      ) ||
      "PENDING_APPROVAL"
    )
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();


  let sql = `
SELECT
  i.id,
  i.seller_id,
  i.college_id,
  i.campus_id,
  i.category,
  i.title,
  i.description,
  i.edition_model,
  i.course,
  i.year,
  i.subject,
  i.condition,
  i.original_price,
  i.selling_price,
  i.discount_percent,
  i.is_negotiable,
  i.delivery_option,
  i.location_text,
  i.status,
  i.listing_fee,
  i.payment_status,
  i.created_at,
  i.updated_at,
  u.name AS seller_name
FROM med_exchange_items i
LEFT JOIN med_exchange_users u
  ON u.id = i.seller_id
WHERE i.status = ?
  AND i.payment_status = 'VERIFIED'
ORDER BY i.created_at ASC
LIMIT 100
`;


  const result =
    await db.prepare(
      sql
    )
    .bind(
      status
    )
    .all();


  return json({

    ok:true,

    count:
      (
        result.results ||
        []
      ).length,

    items:
      result.results ||
      []

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   ADMIN — APPROVE ITEM
============================================================ */

async function adminApproveItem(
  db,
  itemId
){

  await ensurePaymentSchema(
    db
  );


  const id =
    Number(
      itemId
    );


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(id) ||
    id <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid item ID."

    },400);

  }


  const item =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  seller_id,
  status,
  payment_status
FROM med_exchange_items
WHERE id = ?
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      id
    )
    .first();


  if(!item){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Item not found."

    },404);

  }


  if(
    String(
      item.payment_status
    ) !== "VERIFIED"
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Payment has not been verified."

    },400);

  }


  if(
    String(
      item.status
    ) !== "PENDING_APPROVAL"
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Item is not waiting for approval."

    },409);

  }


  await db.prepare(
`
UPDATE med_exchange_items
SET
  status = 'APPROVED',
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = ?
`
  )
  .bind(
    id
  )
  .run();


  return json({

    ok:true,

    item_id:
      id,

    public_item_id:
      "ME-" +
      id,

    status:
      "APPROVED",

    message:
      "Item approved and published."

  });

}


/* ============================================================
   ADMIN — REJECT ITEM
============================================================ */

async function adminRejectItem(
  db,
  itemId,
  body,
  adminIdentity
){

  const id =
    Number(
      itemId
    );


  const note =
    String(
      body &&
      body.admin_note
      ?
      body.admin_note
      :
      ""
    )
    .trim()
    .slice(
      0,
      500
    );


  if(
    !Number.isInteger(id) ||
    id <= 0
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Invalid item ID."

    },400);

  }


  const item =
    await db.prepare(
`
SELECT
  id,
  status,
  payment_status
FROM med_exchange_items
WHERE id = ?
LIMIT 1
`
    )
    .bind(
      id
    )
    .first();


  if(!item){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Item not found."

    },404);

  }


  if(
    String(
      item.status
    ) !==
    "PENDING_APPROVAL"
  ){

    return json({

      ok:false,

      error:
        "Item is not waiting for approval."

    },409);

  }


  await db.prepare(
`
UPDATE med_exchange_items
SET
  status = 'REJECTED',
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = ?
`
  )
  .bind(
    id
  )
  .run();


  /*
   * There is intentionally no change to
   * payment verification. The payment was
   * already verified; item rejection is
   * a separate moderation decision.
   */

  return json({

    ok:true,

    item_id:
      id,

    status:
      "REJECTED",

    admin_note:
      note ||
      null,

    admin:
      adminIdentity,

    message:
      "Item rejected."

  });

}





/* ============================================================
   CAMPUS CHIT-CHAT V10
   CAMPUS PLAY
   I'm Bored + This or That + Truth or Dare + Challenge + Mystery
============================================================ */
async function ensureCampusV10Schema(db){
  await ensureCampusV9Schema(db);
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_play_votes (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      play_key TEXT NOT NULL,
      choice TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(profile_id,play_key)
    )`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_play_challenge_answers (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      challenge_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      body TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(challenge_date,profile_id)
    )`)
  ]);
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_play_votes_key ON med_exchange_chat_play_votes(play_key)`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_play_challenge_date ON med_exchange_chat_play_challenge_answers(challenge_date,created_at)`)
  ]);
}
const V10_THIS_OR_THAT=[
  ["Pizza 🍕","Burger 🍔"],["Sleep 😴","Late-night scrolling 📱"],["Beach 🌊","Mountains ⛰️"],
  ["Introvert 🫣","Extrovert 🕺"],["Coffee ☕","Chai 🫖"],["Texting 💬","Calling 📞"],
  ["Early bird 🌅","Night owl 🌙"],["Movies 🎬","Series 📺"],["Library 📚","Cafeteria 🍟"],
  ["Crush first 💌","Career first 🚀"],["Stay in 😌","Go out 🕺"],["Sweet 🍫","Spicy 🌶️"]
];
const V10_TRUTHS=[
  "What's something you secretly judge people for? 👀",
  "What's the biggest green flag nobody talks about? 🌱",
  "What's something you pretend not to care about? 💀",
  "What's your most random unpopular opinion? 🔥",
  "What's one thing you wish someone understood about you?",
  "What's something that instantly gives you the ick? 😭",
  "What's the funniest lie you've told to avoid plans? 💀",
  "What makes someone instantly more interesting? 👀"
];
const V10_DARES=[
  "Describe your current life using only 3 emojis. 😂",
  "Post the first emoji that comes to your mind. Don't explain it. 👀",
  "Write a one-line plot twist about your life. 🎬",
  "Describe your crush using only weather. 🌦️",
  "Write the most dramatic sentence you can in 8 words. 💀",
  "Confess your most harmless chaotic habit. 😭",
  "Describe your week as a movie title. 🎬",
  "Write something mysterious and refuse to explain it. 👀"
];
const V10_CHALLENGES=[
  "Describe your week using only 3 emojis. 😂",
  "Write your current mood as a fake movie title. 🎬",
  "Describe college life in exactly five words. 💀",
  "Give the campus a completely ridiculous new rule. 😭",
  "Describe your crush without mentioning appearance. 👀",
  "Write the worst motivational quote imaginable. 😂",
  "Turn your day into a dramatic headline. 📰",
  "Describe your personality as a food order. 🍟"
];
function v10Seed(key,len){
  let n=2166136261;
  for(const ch of key){n^=ch.charCodeAt(0);n=Math.imul(n,16777619)>>>0}
  return n%len;
}
function v10DateKey(){return istDateKey()}
function v10TodayContent(){
  const k=v10DateKey();
  const pair=V10_THIS_OR_THAT[v10Seed(k+"vs",V10_THIS_OR_THAT.length)];
  return {
    date:k,
    pair,
    this_or_that_key:"vs:"+k,
    challenge:V10_CHALLENGES[v10Seed(k+"challenge",V10_CHALLENGES.length)],
    challenge_key:"challenge:"+k,
    mystery:V10_TRUTHS[v10Seed(k+"mystery",V10_TRUTHS.length)]
  };
}
async function v10PlayData(db,profileId){
  await ensureCampusV10Schema(db);
  const c=v10TodayContent();
  const key=c.this_or_that_key;
  const totals=(await db.prepare(`SELECT choice,COUNT(*) n FROM med_exchange_chat_play_votes WHERE play_key=? GROUP BY choice`).bind(key).all()).results||[];
  let a=0,b=0;
  totals.forEach(x=>{if(x.choice==='a')a=Number(x.n);if(x.choice==='b')b=Number(x.n)});
  let mine=null;
  if(profileId){const r=await db.prepare(`SELECT choice FROM med_exchange_chat_play_votes WHERE play_key=? AND profile_id=? LIMIT 1`).bind(key,profileId).first();mine=r?.choice||null}
  return json({ok:true,content:c,votes:{a,b,total:a+b,mine}});
}
async function v10Vote(db,body){
  await ensureCampusV10Schema(db);
  const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id);
  if(!profile) return json({ok:false,error:'Create your Campus Chit-Chat profile first.'},400);
  const choice=body.choice==='a'||body.choice==='b'?body.choice:null;
  if(!choice)return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid choice.'},400);
  const key=v10TodayContent().this_or_that_key;
  await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_play_votes(profile_id,play_key,choice) VALUES(?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(profile_id,play_key) DO UPDATE SET choice=excluded.choice,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`)
    .bind(profile.id,key,choice).run();
  return await v10PlayData(db,profile.id);
}
async function v10Challenge(db,body){
  await ensureCampusV10Schema(db);
  const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id);
  if(!profile) return json({ok:false,error:'Create your Campus Chit-Chat profile first.'},400);
  const date=v10DateKey(), answer=wallText(body.body,400);
  if(answer.length<2)return json({ok:false,error:'Write something first.'},400);
  await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_play_challenge_answers(challenge_date,profile_id,body) VALUES(?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(challenge_date,profile_id) DO UPDATE SET body=excluded.body,status='ACTIVE',created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`)
    .bind(date,profile.id,answer).run();
  return json({ok:true});
}
async function v10ChallengeData(db){
  await ensureCampusV10Schema(db);
  const date=v10DateKey();
  const rows=(await db.prepare(`SELECT a.*,COALESCE(p.username,'Anonymous student') username,COALESCE(pm.avatar,'🕶️') avatar
    FROM med_exchange_chat_play_challenge_answers a
    LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profiles p ON p.id=a.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profile_meta pm ON pm.profile_id=p.id
    WHERE a.challenge_date=? AND a.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 50`).bind(date).all()).results||[];
  return json({ok:true,date,challenge:v10TodayContent().challenge,answers:rows});
}
async function v10RandomBored(db){
  await ensureCampusV10Schema(db);
  const [wall,daily,dark,play]=await Promise.all([
    db.prepare(`SELECT id,post_type FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_posts WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1`).first(),
    db.prepare(`SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chat_daily_questions WHERE question_date=? LIMIT 1`).bind(istDateKey()).first(),
    db.prepare(`SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chat_after_dark_posts WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1`).first(),
    Promise.resolve(true)
  ]);
  const choices=[];
  if(wall)choices.push({type:'wall',id:wall.id,post_type:wall.post_type});
  if(daily)choices.push({type:'daily'});
  if(dark)choices.push({type:'after_dark'});
  choices.push({type:'this_or_that'},{type:'truth_or_dare'},{type:'challenge'},{type:'mystery'});
  return json({ok:true,result:choices[Math.floor(Math.random()*choices.length)]});
}


/* ============================================================
   CAMPUS CHIT-CHAT V9
   AFTER DARK + DAILY QUESTION + CAMPUS PULSE
============================================================ */
async function ensureCampusV9Schema(db){
  await ensureChatStage3Schema(db);
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_after_dark_posts (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      body TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_daily_questions (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      question_date TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      question TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_daily_answers (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      question_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      body TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(question_id,profile_id)
    )`)
  ]);
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_after_dark_created ON med_exchange_chat_after_dark_posts(created_at)`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_daily_answers_question ON med_exchange_chat_daily_answers(question_id,created_at)`)
  ]);
}
function campusNowIST(){
  return new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Asia/Kolkata'}));
}
function afterDarkState(){
  const d=campusNowIST(), h=d.getHours();
  const open=(h>=22 || h<4);
  return {open, hour:h, opens_at:'22:00', closes_at:'04:00'};
}
const V9_DAILY_PROMPTS=[
  "What's something everyone on campus pretends to like but actually doesn't? 👀",
  "What's the biggest green flag in a person? 🌱",
  "What is one campus moment you will never forget? 💀",
  "What is something you wish you could say out loud? 👀",
  "What's your most controversial harmless opinion? 🔥",
  "What's one thing students secretly struggle with? 🫶",
  "What instantly makes someone more attractive? 👀",
  "What is the funniest thing that happened to you recently? 😂",
  "What is one rule you would delete from college forever? 💀",
  "What's your biggest current obsession? 👀",
  "What is something people misunderstand about you?",
  "What's the most random thing that makes your day better?"
];
function istDateKey(){
  const d=campusNowIST();
  const y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}
async function v9DailyQuestion(db){
  await ensureCampusV9Schema(db);
  const date=istDateKey();
  let q=await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM med_exchange_chat_daily_questions WHERE question_date=? LIMIT 1`).bind(date).first();
  if(!q){
    let n=0; for(const ch of date) n=(n*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;
    const prompt=V9_DAILY_PROMPTS[n%V9_DAILY_PROMPTS.length];
    const r=await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_daily_questions(question_date,question) VALUES(?,?)`).bind(date,prompt).run();
    q={id:Number(r.meta.last_row_id),question_date:date,question:prompt};
  }
  const answers=(await db.prepare(`SELECT a.*,COALESCE(p.username,'Anonymous student') username,COALESCE(pm.avatar,'🕶️') avatar
    FROM med_exchange_chat_daily_answers a
    LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profiles p ON p.id=a.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profile_meta pm ON pm.profile_id=p.id
    WHERE a.question_id=? AND a.status='ACTIVE'
    ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 50`).bind(q.id).all()).results||[];
  return json({ok:true,question:q,answers});
}
async function v9DailyAnswer(db,body){
  await ensureCampusV9Schema(db);
  const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id);
  if(!profile) return json({ok:false,error:'Create your Campus Chit-Chat profile first.'},400);
  const date=istDateKey();
  let q=await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM med_exchange_chat_daily_questions WHERE question_date=? LIMIT 1`).bind(date).first();
  if(!q){ await v9DailyQuestion(db); q=await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM med_exchange_chat_daily_questions WHERE question_date=? LIMIT 1`).bind(date).first(); }
  const answer=wallText(body.body,400);
  if(answer.length<2) return json({ok:false,error:'Write an answer first.'},400);
  await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_daily_answers(question_id,profile_id,body) VALUES(?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(question_id,profile_id) DO UPDATE SET body=excluded.body,status='ACTIVE',created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`)
    .bind(q.id,profile.id,answer).run();
  return json({ok:true});
}
async function v9AfterDark(db,url,body){
  await ensureCampusV9Schema(db);
  const state=afterDarkState();
  if(body){
    const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id);
    if(!profile) return json({ok:false,error:'Create your Campus Chit-Chat profile first.'},400);
    if(!state.open) return json({ok:false,error:'After Dark opens at 10:00 PM 🌙'},400);
    const post=wallText(body.body,500);
    if(post.length<2) return json({ok:false,error:'Write something first.'},400);
    await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_after_dark_posts(profile_id,body) VALUES(?,?)`).bind(profile.id,post).run();
    return json({ok:true});
  }
  const rows=(await db.prepare(`SELECT d.*,COALESCE(p.username,'Anonymous student') username,COALESCE(pm.avatar,'🕶️') avatar
    FROM med_exchange_chat_after_dark_posts d
    LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profiles p ON p.id=d.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profile_meta pm ON pm.profile_id=p.id
    WHERE d.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 50`).all()).results||[];
  return json({ok:true,state,posts:rows});
}
async function v9Pulse(db){
  await ensureCampusV9Schema(db);
  const one=(sql)=>db.prepare(sql).first();
  const [posts,comments,answers,afterDark]=await Promise.all([
    one(`SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_posts WHERE created_at>=datetime('now','-24 hours') AND status='ACTIVE'`),
    one(`SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_comments WHERE created_at>=datetime('now','-24 hours') AND status='ACTIVE'`),
    one(`SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM med_exchange_chat_daily_answers WHERE created_at>=datetime('now','-24 hours') AND status='ACTIVE'`),
    one(`SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM med_exchange_chat_after_dark_posts WHERE created_at>=datetime('now','-24 hours') AND status='ACTIVE'`)
  ]);
  const activity=Number(posts?.n||0)+Number(comments?.n||0)+Number(answers?.n||0)+Number(afterDark?.n||0);
  return json({ok:true,activity,posts:Number(posts?.n||0),comments:Number(comments?.n||0),answers:Number(answers?.n||0),after_dark:Number(afterDark?.n||0),after_dark_open:afterDarkState().open});
}


/* ============================================================
   CAMPUS WALL V1
   Isolated social feed for Campus Chit-Chat.
============================================================ */
let campusWallVibeReady=false;
async function ensureCampusWallSchema(db){
  await ensureChatStage3Schema(db);
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_wall_posts (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      post_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(post_type IN ('TEA','CRUSH','HOT_TAKE','POLL')),
      body TEXT NOT NULL,
      hot_take_agree TEXT,
      hot_take_disagree TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      post_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      reaction TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(post_id,profile_id,reaction)
    )`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_wall_comments (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      post_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      body TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_wall_votes (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      post_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      vote_key TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(post_id,profile_id)
    )`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_wall_poll_options (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      post_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      option_text TEXT NOT NULL,
      sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    )`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS med_exchange_chat_wall_reports (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      reporter_profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      target_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      reason TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(reporter_profile_id,target_type,target_id)
    )`),
  ]);
  if(!campusWallVibeReady){ try{ await db.prepare(`ALTER TABLE med_exchange_chat_wall_posts ADD COLUMN vibe TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OCEAN'`).run(); }catch(e){} campusWallVibeReady=true; }
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wall_posts_type_created ON med_exchange_chat_wall_posts(post_type,created_at)`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wall_comments_post ON med_exchange_chat_wall_comments(post_id,created_at)`),
    db.prepare(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wall_reactions_post ON med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions(post_id)`)
  ]);
}
function wallText(v,max){ return String(v||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,max); }
async function wallProfile(db,profileId){
  const id=Number(profileId||0);
  if(!id) return null;
  return await db.prepare(`SELECT p.id,p.username,COALESCE(m.avatar,'🕶️') AS avatar FROM med_exchange_chat_profiles p LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profile_meta m ON m.profile_id=p.id WHERE p.id=? AND p.active=1 LIMIT 1`).bind(id).first();
}
async function wallPostCreate(db,body){
  await ensureCampusWallSchema(db);
  const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id);
  if(!profile) return json({ok:false,error:'Create your Campus Chit-Chat profile first.'},400);
  const type=String(body.post_type||'').toUpperCase();
  if(['TEA','CRUSH','HOT_TAKE','POLL'].indexOf(type)<0) return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid Wall post type.'},400);
  const text=wallText(body.body,600);
  if(text.length<2) return json({ok:false,error:'Write something before posting.'},400);
  const vibeKey=String(body.vibe||'OCEAN').toUpperCase();
  const vibe=['OCEAN','AFTER_DARK','DREAM','ENERGY','SOFT','PARTY','ICE','GALAXY'].indexOf(vibeKey)>=0?vibeKey:'OCEAN';
  let agree=null,disagree=null,options=[];
  if(type==='HOT_TAKE'){
    agree=wallText(body.agree_label||'Agree',40)||'Agree';
    disagree=wallText(body.disagree_label||'Disagree',40)||'Disagree';
  }
  if(type==='POLL'){
    options=(Array.isArray(body.options)?body.options:[]).map(x=>wallText(x,100)).filter(Boolean);
    options=[...new Set(options)];
    if(options.length<2 || options.length>4) return json({ok:false,error:'A poll needs 2 to 4 different options.'},400);
  }
  const r=await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_wall_posts(profile_id,post_type,body,hot_take_agree,hot_take_disagree,vibe) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`)
    .bind(profile.id,type,text,agree,disagree,vibe).run();
  const postId=Number(r.meta&&r.meta.last_row_id);
  if(type==='POLL'){
    await db.batch(options.map((opt,i)=>db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_wall_poll_options(post_id,option_text,sort_order) VALUES(?,?,?)`).bind(postId,opt,i)));
  }
  return json({ok:true,post_id:postId});
}
async function wallPosts(db,url){
  await ensureCampusWallSchema(db);
  const profileId=Number(url.searchParams.get('profile_id')||0);
  const type=String(url.searchParams.get('type')||'TRENDING').toUpperCase();
  const limit=Math.min(50,Math.max(1,Number(url.searchParams.get('limit')||30)));
  let where=`p.status='ACTIVE'`, binds=[];
  if(['TEA','CRUSH','HOT_TAKE','POLL'].includes(type)){ where+=` AND p.post_type=?`; binds.push(type); }
  let order=type==='TRENDING'
    ? `((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions r WHERE r.post_id=p.id)*2 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_comments c WHERE c.post_id=p.id AND c.status='ACTIVE')*3 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_votes v WHERE v.post_id=p.id)*2 + MAX(0, 48-((julianday('now')-julianday(p.created_at))*24))*0.15) DESC, p.created_at DESC`
    : `p.created_at DESC`;
  const rows=(await db.prepare(`SELECT p.*, COALESCE(pr.username,'Anonymous student') username, COALESCE(pm.avatar,'🕶️') avatar,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_comments c WHERE c.post_id=p.id AND c.status='ACTIVE') comment_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions r WHERE r.post_id=p.id) reaction_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_votes v WHERE v.post_id=p.id) vote_count
    FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_posts p LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profiles pr ON pr.id=p.profile_id LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profile_meta pm ON pm.profile_id=pr.id
    WHERE ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT ?`).bind(...binds,limit).all()).results||[];
  const ids=rows.map(x=>Number(x.id));
  let reactionRows=[],voteRows=[],optionRows=[];
  if(ids.length){
    const qs=ids.map(()=>'?').join(',');
    reactionRows=(await db.prepare(`SELECT post_id,reaction,COUNT(*) count FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions WHERE post_id IN (${qs}) GROUP BY post_id,reaction`).bind(...ids).all()).results||[];
    voteRows=(await db.prepare(`SELECT post_id,vote_key,COUNT(*) count FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_votes WHERE post_id IN (${qs}) GROUP BY post_id,vote_key`).bind(...ids).all()).results||[];
    optionRows=(await db.prepare(`SELECT o.*,COUNT(v.id) vote_count FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_poll_options o LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_wall_votes v ON v.post_id=o.post_id AND v.vote_key=CAST(o.id AS TEXT) WHERE o.post_id IN (${qs}) GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.sort_order`).bind(...ids).all()).results||[];
  }
  const myReactions=profileId&&ids.length ? ((await db.prepare(`SELECT post_id,reaction FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions WHERE profile_id=? AND post_id IN (${ids.map(()=>'?').join(',')})`).bind(profileId,...ids).all()).results||[]) : [];
  const myVotes=profileId&&ids.length ? ((await db.prepare(`SELECT post_id,vote_key FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_votes WHERE profile_id=? AND post_id IN (${ids.map(()=>'?').join(',')})`).bind(profileId,...ids).all()).results||[]) : [];
  return json({ok:true,posts:rows.map(p=>({...p,reactions:reactionRows.filter(r=>Number(r.post_id)===Number(p.id)),my_reactions:myReactions.filter(r=>Number(r.post_id)===Number(p.id)).map(r=>r.reaction),votes:voteRows.filter(v=>Number(v.post_id)===Number(p.id)),my_vote:(myVotes.find(v=>Number(v.post_id)===Number(p.id))||{}).vote_key||null,options:optionRows.filter(o=>Number(o.post_id)===Number(p.id))}))});
}
async function wallReact(db,body){
  await ensureCampusWallSchema(db);
  const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id); const postId=Number(body.post_id||0); const reaction=wallText(body.reaction,12);
  if(!profile||!postId||!reaction) return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid reaction.'},400);
  const existing=await db.prepare(`SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions WHERE post_id=? AND profile_id=? AND reaction=?`).bind(postId,profile.id,reaction).first();
  if(existing) await db.prepare(`DELETE FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions WHERE id=?`).bind(existing.id).run();
  else await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_wall_reactions(post_id,profile_id,reaction) VALUES(?,?,?)`).bind(postId,profile.id,reaction).run();
  return json({ok:true,active:!existing});
}
async function wallComments(db,url,body){
  await ensureCampusWallSchema(db);
  if(body){
    const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id), postId=Number(body.post_id||0), text=wallText(body.body,300);
    if(!profile||!postId||text.length<1) return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid comment.'},400);
    await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_wall_comments(post_id,profile_id,body) VALUES(?,?,?)`).bind(postId,profile.id,text).run();
    return json({ok:true});
  }
  const postId=Number(url.searchParams.get('post_id')||0);
  if(!postId) return json({ok:false,error:'Missing post.'},400);
  const rows=(await db.prepare(`SELECT c.*,COALESCE(p.username,'Anonymous student') username,COALESCE(pm.avatar,'🕶️') avatar FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_comments c LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profiles p ON p.id=c.profile_id LEFT JOIN med_exchange_chat_profile_meta pm ON pm.profile_id=p.id WHERE c.post_id=? AND c.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC`).bind(postId).all()).results||[];
  return json({ok:true,comments:rows});
}
async function wallVote(db,body){
  await ensureCampusWallSchema(db);
  const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id), postId=Number(body.post_id||0);
  if(!profile||!postId) return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid vote.'},400);
  const post=await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_posts WHERE id=? AND status='ACTIVE'`).bind(postId).first();
  if(!post) return json({ok:false,error:'Post not found.'},404);
  let key=wallText(body.vote_key,50);
  if(post.post_type==='HOT_TAKE'){
    if(['AGREE','DISAGREE'].indexOf(key)<0) return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid Hot Take vote.'},400);
  }else if(post.post_type==='POLL'){
    const opt=await db.prepare(`SELECT id FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_poll_options WHERE id=? AND post_id=?`).bind(Number(key),postId).first();
    if(!opt) return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid poll option.'},400);
    key=String(opt.id);
  }else return json({ok:false,error:'This post cannot be voted on.'},400);
  await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO med_exchange_chat_wall_votes(post_id,profile_id,vote_key,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT(post_id,profile_id) DO UPDATE SET vote_key=excluded.vote_key,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`).bind(postId,profile.id,key).run();
  return json({ok:true});
}
async function wallDelete(db,body){
  await ensureCampusWallSchema(db);
  const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id), postId=Number(body.post_id||0);
  if(!profile||!postId) return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid request.'},400);
  const post=await db.prepare(`SELECT profile_id FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_posts WHERE id=?`).bind(postId).first();
  if(!post||Number(post.profile_id)!==Number(profile.id)) return json({ok:false,error:'You can only delete your own post.'},403);
  await db.prepare(`UPDATE med_exchange_chat_wall_posts SET status='DELETED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=?`).bind(postId).run();
  return json({ok:true});
}
async function wallReport(db,body){
  await ensureCampusWallSchema(db);
  const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id), type=String(body.target_type||'').toUpperCase(), id=Number(body.target_id||0);
  if(!profile||!id||['POST','COMMENT'].indexOf(type)<0) return json({ok:false,error:'Invalid report.'},400);
  await db.prepare(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO med_exchange_chat_wall_reports(reporter_profile_id,target_type,target_id,reason) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`).bind(profile.id,type,id,wallText(body.reason,200)||null).run();
  return json({ok:true,message:'Reported. Thanks for helping keep Campus Wall safe.'});
}
async function wallCommentDelete(db,body){
  await ensureCampusWallSchema(db);
  const profile=await wallProfile(db,body.profile_id), id=Number(body.comment_id||0);
  const row=profile&&id?await db.prepare(`SELECT profile_id FROM med_exchange_chat_wall_comments WHERE id=?`).bind(id).first():null;
  if(!row||Number(row.profile_id)!==Number(profile.id)) return json({ok:false,error:'You can only delete your own comment.'},403);
  await db.prepare(`UPDATE med_exchange_chat_wall_comments SET status='DELETED' WHERE id=?`).bind(id).run();
  return json({ok:true});
}

/* ============================================================
   MAIN WORKER
============================================================ */

export default {

  async fetch(
    request,
    env
  ){

    try{

      /* --------------------------------------------------------
         OPTIONS
      -------------------------------------------------------- */

      if(
        request.method ===
        "OPTIONS"
      ){

        return new Response(
          null,
          {
            status:204,
            headers:
              corsHeaders()
          }
        );

      }


      /* --------------------------------------------------------
         DATABASE
      -------------------------------------------------------- */

      if(!env.DB){

        return json({

          ok:false,

          error:
            "D1 binding DB is missing."

        },500);

      }


      const url =
        new URL(
          request.url
        );


      const path =
        url.pathname;


      /* ========================================================
         HOME
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path === "/" ||
        path === "/index.html"
      ){

        return new Response(

          HOME_PAGE,

          {
            headers:{

              "Content-Type":
                "text/html;charset=UTF-8",

              ...corsHeaders()

            }

          }

        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         CAMPUS CHIT-CHAT PAGE
         No database work is performed here.
      ======================================================== */

      if(path === "/chat") {
        return new Response(CHAT_PAGE,{headers:{"Content-Type":"text/html;charset=UTF-8","Cache-Control":"no-store",...corsHeaders()}});
      }


      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN PAGE
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path === "/admin"
      ){

        return new Response(

          ADMIN_PAGE,

          {
            headers:{

              "Content-Type":
                "text/html;charset=UTF-8",

              "Cache-Control":
                "no-store",

              ...corsHeaders()

            }

          }

        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         HEALTH
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path === "/health"
      ){

        return json({

          ok:true,

          service:
            APP_NAME,

          database:
            true

        });

      }


      /* ========================================================
         MANIFEST
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/manifest.webmanifest"
      ){

        return new Response(

          JSON.stringify({

            name:
              "Med Exchange",

            short_name:
              "Med Exchange",

            start_url:
              "/",

            display:
              "standalone",

            background_color:
              "#07111f",

            theme_color:
              "#07111f",

            description:
              "Medical student marketplace"

          }),

          {
            headers:{

              "Content-Type":
                "application/manifest+json",

              ...corsHeaders()

            }

          }

        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         SERVICE WORKER
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path === "/sw.js"
      ){

        const sw =
`self.addEventListener("install",function(event){
  self.skipWaiting();
});

self.addEventListener("activate",function(event){
  self.clients.claim();
});

self.addEventListener("fetch",function(event){
  event.respondWith(
    fetch(event.request)
  );
});`;


        return new Response(

          sw,

          {
            headers:{

              "Content-Type":
                "application/javascript",

              ...corsHeaders()

            }

          }

        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         FAVICON
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/favicon.ico"
      ){

        return new Response(

          null,

          {
            status:204,

            headers:
              corsHeaders()

          }

        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         PAYMENT QR
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/payment/qr" &&
        request.method ===
        "GET"
      ){

        return await getPaymentQr(
          env.DB,
          env
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         PAYMENT SUBMIT
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/payment/submit" &&
        request.method ===
        "POST"
      ){

        let body;

        try{

          body =
            await request.json();

        }catch(error){

          return json({

            ok:false,

            error:
              "Invalid JSON request."

          },400);

        }


        return await submitPayment(
          env.DB,
          body
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         PAYMENT STATUS
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/payment/status" &&
        request.method ===
        "GET"
      ){

        return await getPaymentStatus(
          env.DB,
          url
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN AUTH CHECK
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path.startsWith(
          "/api/admin/"
        )
      ){

        if(
          !requireAdmin(
            request,
            env
          )
        ){

          return json({

            ok:false,

            error:
              "Unauthorized."

          },401);

        }

      }


      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN AUTH VALIDATION
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/admin/auth" &&
        request.method ===
        "GET"
      ){

        return adminAuthCheck(
          request,
          env
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN PAYMENTS
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/admin/payments" &&
        request.method ===
        "GET"
      ){

        return await adminPayments(
          env.DB,
          url
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN VERIFY PAYMENT
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        /^\/api\/admin\/payments\/\d+\/verify$/.test(
          path
        ) &&
        request.method ===
        "POST"
      ){

        const paymentId =
          Number(
            path.split(
              "/"
            )[4]
          );


        return await adminVerifyPayment(
          env.DB,
          paymentId,
          "ADMIN"
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN REJECT PAYMENT
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        /^\/api\/admin\/payments\/\d+\/reject$/.test(
          path
        ) &&
        request.method ===
        "POST"
      ){

        let body =
          {};


        try{

          body =
            await request.json();

        }catch(error){

          body =
            {};

        }


        const paymentId =
          Number(
            path.split(
              "/"
            )[4]
          );


        return await adminRejectPayment(
          env.DB,
          paymentId,
          body,
          "ADMIN"
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN MRV CONFESSIONS
      ======================================================== */
      if(path === "/api/admin/chat/confessions" && request.method === "GET") return await adminConfessions(env.DB);
      if(/^\/api\/admin\/chat\/confessions\/\d+\/delete$/.test(path) && request.method === "DELETE") return await adminDeleteConfession(env.DB,Number(path.split('/')[5]));


      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN ITEMS
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/admin/items" &&
        request.method ===
        "GET"
      ){

        return await adminItems(
          env.DB,
          url
        );

      }


      if(/^\/api\/admin\/items\/\d+\/delete$/.test(path) && request.method === 'DELETE') return await adminDeleteItem(env.DB,Number(path.split('/')[4]));

      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN APPROVE ITEM
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        /^\/api\/admin\/items\/\d+\/approve$/.test(
          path
        ) &&
        request.method ===
        "POST"
      ){

        const itemId =
          Number(
            path.split(
              "/"
            )[4]
          );


        return await adminApproveItem(
          env.DB,
          itemId
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         ADMIN REJECT ITEM
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        /^\/api\/admin\/items\/\d+\/reject$/.test(
          path
        ) &&
        request.method ===
        "POST"
      ){

        let body =
          {};


        try{

          body =
            await request.json();

        }catch(error){

          body =
            {};

        }


        const itemId =
          Number(
            path.split(
              "/"
            )[4]
          );


        return await adminRejectItem(
          env.DB,
          itemId,
          body,
          "ADMIN"
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         GET ITEMS
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/items" &&
        request.method ===
        "GET"
      ){

        return await listItems(
          env.DB,
          url
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         GET SINGLE ITEM
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        /^\/api\/items\/\d+$/.test(
          path
        ) &&
        request.method ===
        "GET"
      ){

        const itemId =
          Number(
            path.split(
              "/"
            ).pop()
          );


        return json(
          await getItem(
            env.DB,
            itemId
          )
        );

      }


      if(path === '/api/account/delete' && request.method === 'POST'){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await deleteCompleteUserAccount(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === '/api/seller/account' && request.method === 'GET') return await sellerAccount(env.DB,url);
      if(path === '/api/seller/account' && request.method === 'PUT'){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await sellerUpdateAccount(env.DB,body);}
if(/^\/api\/seller\/items\/\d+$/.test(path) && request.method === 'GET') return await sellerGetItem(env.DB,url,Number(path.split('/')[4]));
if(/^\/api\/seller\/items\/\d+$/.test(path) && request.method === 'PUT'){let body={};try{body=await request.json();}catch(e){}body.seller_id=Number(body.seller_id||0);return await sellerUpdateItem(env.DB,body,Number(path.split('/')[4]));}
if(/^\/api\/seller\/items\/\d+$/.test(path) && request.method === 'DELETE') return await sellerDeleteItem(env.DB,url,Number(path.split('/')[4]));
      if(/^\/api\/seller\/items\/\d+\/sold$/.test(path) && request.method === 'POST'){let body={};try{body=await request.json();}catch(e){}body.item_id=Number(path.split('/')[4]);return await sellerMarkSold(env.DB,body);}

      /* ========================================================
         SELLER BOOK LIMIT
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/seller/book-limit" &&
        request.method ===
        "GET"
      ){
        return await sellerBookLimit(env.DB, url);
      }


      /* ========================================================
         CREATE SELLER
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/seller/session" &&
        request.method ===
        "POST"
      ){

        let body =
          {};


        try{

          body =
            await request.json();

        }catch(error){

          body =
            {};

        }


        return await createSeller(
          env.DB,
          body
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         CREATE ITEM
      ======================================================== */

      if(
        path ===
        "/api/items/create" &&
        request.method ===
        "POST"
      ){

        let body;


        try{

          body =
            await request.json();

        }catch(error){

          return json({

            ok:false,

            error:
              "Invalid JSON request."

          },400);

        }


        return await createItem(
          env.DB,
          body
        );

      }


      /* ========================================================
         CAMPUS CHIT-CHAT API
         Schema is created only when one of these endpoints is used.
      ======================================================== */
      if(path === "/api/chat/profile" && request.method === "POST"){
        let body; try{body=await request.json()}catch(error){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}
        return await chatProfile(env.DB,body);
      }
      if(path === "/api/chat/find" && request.method === "POST"){
        let body; try{body=await request.json()}catch(error){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}
        return await chatFind(env.DB,body);
      }
      if(path === "/api/chat/recent" && request.method === "GET")return await chatRecent(env.DB,url);
      if(path === "/api/chat/messages" && request.method === "GET")return await chatMessages(env.DB,url);
      if(path === "/api/chat/read" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await chatRead(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/typing" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await chatTyping(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/status" && request.method === "GET")return await chatStatus(env.DB,url);
      if(path === "/api/chat/react" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await chatReact(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/message/delete" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await chatDeleteMessage(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/send" && request.method === "POST"){
        let body; try{body=await request.json()}catch(error){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}
        return await chatSend(env.DB,body);
      }
      if(path === "/api/chat/end" && request.method === "POST"){
        let body; try{body=await request.json()}catch(error){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}
        return await chatEnd(env.DB,body);
      }
      if(path === "/api/chat/confessions" && request.method === "GET") return await chatConfessions(env.DB,url);
      if(path === "/api/chat/confessions" && request.method === "POST"){let body;try{body=await request.json()}catch(error){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}return await chatConfessionSend(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/confessions/delete" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await chatConfessionDelete(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/presence" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await chatPresence(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/active-count" && request.method === "GET") return await chatActiveCount(env.DB);
      if(path === "/api/chat/profile" && request.method === "GET") return await chatProfileGet(env.DB,url);
      if(path === "/api/chat/profile/customize" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await chatProfileCustomize(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/discover" && request.method === "GET") return await chatDiscover(env.DB,url);
      if(path === "/api/chat/report" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await chatReport(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/block" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await chatBlock(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/profile/delete" && request.method === "POST"){
        let body; try{body=await request.json()}catch(error){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}
        return await chatDeleteProfile(env.DB,body);
      }



      /* ========================================================
         CAMPUS WALL V1 API
      ======================================================== */
      if(path === "/api/chat/wall/posts" && request.method === "GET") return await wallPosts(env.DB,url);
      if(path === "/api/chat/wall/posts" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}return await wallPostCreate(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/wall/react" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await wallReact(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/wall/comments" && request.method === "GET") return await wallComments(env.DB,url,null);
      if(path === "/api/chat/wall/comments" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await wallComments(env.DB,null,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/wall/comments/delete" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await wallCommentDelete(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/wall/vote" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await wallVote(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/wall/delete" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await wallDelete(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/wall/report" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){}return await wallReport(env.DB,body);}


      /* ========================================================
         CAMPUS V10 API
      ======================================================== */
      if(path === "/api/chat/v10/play" && request.method === "GET") return await v10PlayData(env.DB,Number(url.searchParams.get("profile_id")||0)||null);
      if(path === "/api/chat/v10/this-or-that/vote" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}return await v10Vote(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/v10/challenge" && request.method === "GET") return await v10ChallengeData(env.DB);
      if(path === "/api/chat/v10/challenge" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}return await v10Challenge(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/v10/bored" && request.method === "GET") return await v10RandomBored(env.DB);

      /* ========================================================
         CAMPUS V9 API
      ======================================================== */
      if(path === "/api/chat/v9/pulse" && request.method === "GET") return await v9Pulse(env.DB);
      if(path === "/api/chat/v9/daily-question" && request.method === "GET") return await v9DailyQuestion(env.DB);
      if(path === "/api/chat/v9/daily-question/answer" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}return await v9DailyAnswer(env.DB,body);}
      if(path === "/api/chat/v9/after-dark" && request.method === "GET") return await v9AfterDark(env.DB,url,null);
      if(path === "/api/chat/v9/after-dark" && request.method === "POST"){let body={};try{body=await request.json()}catch(e){return json({ok:false,error:"Invalid JSON request."},400)}return await v9AfterDark(env.DB,url,body);}

      /* ========================================================
         404
      ======================================================== */

      return json({

        ok:false,

        error:
          "Route not found."

      },404);


    }catch(error){

      console.error(
        "MED EXCHANGE ERROR:",
        error
      );


      return json({

        ok:false,

        error:
          error &&
          error.message
          ?
          error.message
          :
          "Internal server error."

      },500);

    }

  }

};
